title: Huawei convicted of money laundering, conspiracy to steal trade secrets, and fraud by US jury
zh_title: 华为被美国陪审团判洗钱、共谋窃取商业机密和欺诈罪
summary: 陪审团裁定华为犯有银行欺诈、电信欺诈、共谋洗钱、共谋窃取商业机密以及违反美国对伊朗制裁等罪。据彭博社报道，该判决是美国司法部起诉一家外国公司近三个月的审判结果。这种情况很少见，导致 12 项罪名中的 10 项被定罪，这家中国公司被洗清了串谋妨碍司法公正和串谋敲诈勒索的罪名。 “今天的判决明确表明，欺诈、逃避制裁和
content:
陪审团裁定华为犯有银行欺诈、电信欺诈、共谋洗钱、共谋窃取商业机密以及违反美国对伊朗制裁等罪。据彭博社报道，该判决是美国司法部起诉一家外国公司近三个月的审判结果。这种情况很少见，导致 12 项罪名中的 10 项被定罪，这家中国公司被洗清了串谋妨碍司法公正和串谋敲诈勒索的罪名。 “今天的判决清楚地表明，欺诈、逃避制裁和盗窃知识产权不是商业策略，而是严重犯罪，”负责对这家科技公司进行调查的联邦调查局纽约办事处助理主任詹姆斯·巴纳克尔 (James Barnacle) 告诉该刊物。 “华为的成功建立在欺骗和盗窃的基础上，联邦调查局将毫不犹豫地追捕那些通过违法行为获利的人。”华为长期以来一直是美国的攻击目标，该公司于 2018 年与其他中国电信硬件制造商一起被美国禁止入境。它甚至起诉美国政府，声称针对该公司的设备禁令违宪。尽管如此，华盛顿还是继续采取行动，并早在 2019 年就对该公司提起诉讼。
然而，由于 COVID-19 大流行，以及华为在案件开庭审理之前多次试图停止调查，调查工作多次被拖延。甚至有指控称，两名中国情报官员向一名美国执法官员提供了 61,000 美元的比特币，以获取有关该案的内幕信息。同样是在 2018 年，华为创始人兼公司首席财务官孟晚舟的女儿因涉嫌该公司试图规避美国对伊朗的制裁而在加拿大被捕。华盛顿甚至试图将她引渡到美国，但她在承认该公司在伊朗从事非法业务后于2019年返回中国。除此之外，美国司法部还提供了华为违规的其他例子，包括盗窃T-Mobile的触摸屏测试机器人，一名华为员工从T-Mobile的控制实验室偷走了该设备的一部分，复制思科路由器源代码，另一名华为员工拍摄富士通专有设备，以及使用通过美国天线制造商Quintel的保密协议收集的机密信息，这些信息随后被纳入华为的专利申请中。另一方面，该公司的首席辩护律师布莱恩·赫伯利格(Brian Heberlig)重点关注其两项指控的无罪释放。赫伯利格告诉彭博社：“我们刚刚听到的判决很难不让人产生复杂的情绪。”
敲诈勒索阴谋“指控该公司从上到下腐败，其企业文化和政策存在欺骗、盗窃和撒谎的现象，陪审团裁定该公司在这项指控上无罪。”该公司的量刑听证会定于 2027 年 9 月举行，但目前尚不清楚美国政府寻求何种处罚。中国外交部则表示，“中国政府坚决反对美国对中国企业的打压和围堵，坚定支持中国企业维护自身合法权益。”

【原文 English Original】
A jury has found Huawei guilty of bank fraud, wire fraud, money laundering conspiracy, conspiracy to steal trade secrets, and violations of the U.S. sanctions against Iran, among others. According to Bloomberg , the verdict was the result of a nearly three-month trial in which a foreign company has been prosecuted by the U.S. Department of Justice. This is a rare occurrence, resulting in a conviction of 10 out of 12 counts, with the Chinese company getting cleared of conspiracy to obstruct justice and racketeering conspiracy. “Today’s verdict makes clear that fraud, sanctions evasion, and the theft of intellectual property are not business strategies, they are serious crimes,” James Barnacle, the Assistant Director in Charge of the FBI New York Field Office, which conducted the investigation on the tech firm, told the publication. “Huawei’s success was built on deception and theft, and the FBI will never hesitate to pursue those who profit by breaking the law.” Huawei has long been in the crosshairs of the U.S., with the company getting banned from the country in 2018 alongside other Chinese telecommunications hardware manufacturers. It has even sued the U.S. government , claiming that the equipment ban against the company is unconstitutional. Nevertheless, Washington proceeded with the move and built a case against the company as early as 2019. This has been hit by multiple delays, though, owing to the COVID-19 Pandemic, as well as Huawei’s multiple attempts to halt the investigation even before the case went to trial. There was even an allegation that two Chinese intelligence officers offered $61,000 in Bitcoin to a U.S. law enforcement official to get insider information about the case. It was also in 2018 that the daughter of Huawei founder and company CFO Meng Wanzhou was arrested in Canada on suspicion of the firm’s attempt to circumvent U.S. sanctions on Iran. Washington even attempted to have her extradited to the U.S., but she was able to return to China in 2019 after admitting to the company’s illegal business in Iran. Aside from that, the U.S. Department of Justice provided other examples of Huawei’s violations, including the theft of T-Mobile’s robotic touch screen testing robot, with a Huawei employee stealing a part of the device from T-Mobile’s controlled lab, the copying of Cisco router source code, another Huawei employee photographing proprietary Fujitsu equipment, and using confidential information gathered through an NDA from Quintel, a U.S. antenna manufacturer, which was subsequently included in Huawei’s patent application. On the other hand, the company’s lead defense attorney, Brian Heberlig, focused on its acquittal on two of the charges. “It’s hard not to have profoundly mixed emotions from the verdict we just heard,” Heberlig told Bloomberg . The racketeering conspiracy “alleged that the company was corrupt from top to bottom, that it had a corporate culture and policy of cheating, stealing, and lying, and the jury found the company not guilty on that charge.” Sentencing hearing for the company is set for September 2027, although it’s still unclear what penalties the U.S. government is seeking. The Chinese Foreign Ministry, on the other hand, said, “The Chinese government firmly opposes the U.S. suppression and containment of Chinese companies and firmly supports Chinese companies in safeguarding their legitimate rights and interests.”

Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

summary: 孙说香港可以帮助内地企业获取全球创新资源中国劳工布告栏 星期三, 25 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 孙表示，香港可以帮助内地企业获取全球创新资源 香港创新局局长孙东表示，香港正在加快三大园区和五个研究院的创新科技布局。他指出，对于有意向香港拓展业务的内地企业，香港可以提供研究平台，帮助他们与香港创新局局长建立联系。
content:
孙说香港可以帮助内地企业获取全球创新资源中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 25 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
孙说香港可以帮助内地企业获取全球创新资源
香港创新科技局局长孙东表示，香港正在加快三大园区和五个研究院的创新科技布局。他表示，对于有意进军香港的内地企业，香港可以提供研究平台，帮助他们与香港建立联系。
香港创新科技及工业局局长孙东于2026年11月25日表示，香港正在加快发展创新科技景观，包括三大创新园区和五个研究机构。孙在安徽省合肥市举行的交流活动上表示，对于有意拓展香港业务的内地企业来说，香港不仅可以提供研究平台，还可以帮助他们联系顶尖科技人才和国际创新资源，提升研究能力。
孙指出，香港政府已支持约700家有兴趣在香港扩展或设立业务的潜在或开拓性创新科技企业。政府还推出三项100亿港元的基金，支持创新科技企业发展。
他还表示，政府正在建设沙岭数据中心园区，旨在逐步建立更加完善、稳定的计算基础设施，支持初创企业开发尖端技术，抓住人工智能带来的新机遇。
孙强调，皖港两地在推动科技创新和经济高质量发展方面优势互补。他表示，安徽近年来在新能源汽车、人工智能、量子技术等方面取得了长足进步，香港则拥有较强的基础研究能力、国际化的营商环境以及“一国两制”内外衔接的独特优势。
孙说，香港作为国际金融、航运、贸易中心，可以作为连接中国内地与全球市场的重要门户，充分发挥“超级联系人”和“超级增值者”作用。

Wednesday, 25 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong can help mainland firms access global innovation resources, Sun says
Hong Kong's innovation secretary Sun Dong said the city is accelerating its innovation and technology layout with three major parks and five research institutes. He noted that for mainland enterprises looking to expand to Hong Kong, the city can provide research platforms and help connect them with
Hong Kong's Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said on 25 November 2026 that the city is accelerating the development of its innovation and technology landscape, including three major innovation parks and five research institutes. Speaking at an exchange event in Hefei, Anhui province, Sun said that for mainland enterprises interested in expanding to Hong Kong, the city can not only provide research platforms but also help them connect with top scientific talent and international innovation resources to enhance their research capabilities.
Sun noted that the Hong Kong government has supported about 700 potential or pioneering innovation and technology enterprises that are interested in expanding or setting up operations in the city. The government has also launched three HK$10 billion funds to support the development of innovation and technology enterprises.
The secretary also said the government is building the Sha Ling data centre park, aiming to gradually establish more comprehensive and stable computing infrastructure to support start-ups in developing cutting-edge technologies and seizing new opportunities brought by artificial intelligence.
Sun highlighted the complementary advantages of Anhui and Hong Kong in promoting technological innovation and high-quality economic development. He noted that Anhui has achieved significant progress in new energy vehicles, artificial intelligence and quantum technology in recent years, while Hong Kong has strong basic research capabilities, an international business environment, and the unique advantages of connecting internally and externally under the 'one country, two systems' principle.
Sun said Hong Kong, as an international financial, shipping and trade centre, can serve as an important gateway connecting mainland China with the global market, fully playing its role as a 'super connector' and 'super value-adder'.

金管局在 66 周年晚宴上表彰企业卓越表现和可持续发展 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 25 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
金管局在66周年晚宴上表彰企业的卓越表现和可持续发展
香港管理专业协会举办晚宴并颁发可持续发展奖项，庆祝其成立 66 周年。行政长官李家超作为主宾出席，11家公司获得特许会员资格，太古地产荣获可持续发展最高荣誉。
香港管理专业协会（金管局）周二（11月24日）假合和酒店举行第66届周年院士晚宴暨可持续发展奖颁奖典礼，行政长官李家超担任主礼嘉宾。
金管局主席温弗里德·恩格布雷希特-布雷吉斯在开幕致辞中，结合国家“十五五”规划和香港首个五年规划，谈及香港的新发展时代。他重申协会致力于推进政府目标，包括吸引国际人才、深化与大湾区的融合以及加快北方都市圈的发展。
在颁奖典礼上，金管局向 11 家知名公司颁发特许会员资格，以表彰他们的卓越企业表现。获奖者包括启德体育园、奇华饼家、联想及平安数码银行。
2026年金管局可持续发展奖也已进入第八个年头。该奖项旨在表彰具有模范可持续商业实践的组织，今年吸引了来自亚洲各地的参赛者。推出了一项新的活动奖，以突出有影响力的举措。
信和置业副总经理（可持续发展与创新）郭美兰荣获“年度可持续发展领袖”奖。太古地产荣获“活动奖”类别的“金奖”和“组织奖”类别的“大奖”。

HKMA honours corporate excellence and sustainability at 66th anniversary dinner | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 25 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HKMA honours corporate excellence and sustainability at 66th anniversary dinner
The Hong Kong Management Association celebrated its 66th anniversary with a dinner and sustainability awards. Chief Executive John Lee attended as guest of honour, while 11 companies received charter memberships and Swire Properties won top sustainability honours.
The Hong Kong Management Association (HKMA) held its 66th Annual Fellowship Dinner and Sustainability Award Presentation Ceremony on Tuesday (Nov 24) at the Hopewell Hotel, with Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu attending as Guest of Honour.
In his opening address, HKMA chairperson Winfried Engelbrecht-Bresges spoke about Hong Kong's new era of development, referencing the National 15th Five-Year Plan and the city's inaugural Five-Year Plan. He reaffirmed the association's dedication to advancing government objectives, including attracting international talent, deepening integration with the Greater Bay Area, and accelerating the Northern Metropolis development.
During the ceremony, HKMA presented Charter Memberships to 11 prominent companies in recognition of their corporate excellence. The recipients included Kai Tak Sports Park, Kee Wah Bakery, Lenovo, and Ping An Digital Bank.
The HKMA Sustainability Award 2026, now in its eighth year, was also presented. The award honours organisations for exemplary sustainable business practices and this year attracted entries from across Asia. A new Campaign Award was introduced to spotlight impactful initiatives.
Melanie Kwok, deputy general manager (Sustainability & Innovation) at Sino Land, received the 'Sustainability Leader of the Year' award. Swire Properties was recognised with both the 'Gold Award' in the Campaign Awards category and the 'Grand Award' in the Organisation Awards category.

content:
休闲部门报告数据泄露影响 130 万用户 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 25 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
休闲部门报告数据泄露影响 130 万用户
香港康乐及文化事务署表示，一家外包承包商的数据泄露事件影响了约 130 万城市票务网络用户的姓名、电话号码和电子邮件地址。该部门已向警方和隐私部门报告了这一事件。
香港康乐及文化事务署（康文署）披露了一起影响城市票务网络的安全事件，该系统由一家为康乐及文化事务署场地提供票务服务的外包承包商开发和拥有。
该部门在 2026 年 11 月 25 日的一份声明中表示，初步调查显示，约 130 万用户的个人数据被泄露。泄露的信息包括用户名、全名、电话号码和电子邮件地址。该部门表示，该系统不会存储用户的身份证件号码，信用卡详细信息也被隐藏。
康文署表示正​​严肃处理事件，并已即时责令承办商深入调查并提交报告。该署亦已向警方报案，并通知保安局、数码政策办公室及个人资料私隐专员公署。
康乐及文化事务署表示，正在与承包商合作通知受影响的个人。该部门还正在征求隐私专员和数字政策办公室的意见，同时与承包商进行全面审查，以加强对城市票务网络系统的保护措施，并防止类似事件再次发生。

Leisure department reports data breach affecting 1.3 million users | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 25 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Leisure department reports data breach affecting 1.3 million users
Hong Kong's Leisure and Cultural Services Department says a data breach at an outsourced contractor hit about 1.3 million City Ticketing Network users, exposing names, phone numbers and email addresses. The department has reported the incident to police and privacy authorities.
Hong Kong's Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) has disclosed a security incident affecting the City Ticketing Network, a system developed and owned by an outsourced contractor that provides ticketing services for LCSD venues.
Preliminary investigations indicate that about 1.3 million users' personal data were involved in the breach, the department said in a statement on 25 November 2026. Exposed information includes usernames, full names, telephone numbers and email addresses. The department said the system does not store users' identity document numbers, and credit card details are masked.
The LCSD said it is taking the incident seriously and has immediately ordered the contractor to conduct an in-depth investigation and submit a report. The department has also filed a report with the police and notified the Security Bureau, the Office of the Digital Policy and the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data.
Working with the contractor, the LCSD said it is in the process of notifying affected individuals. The department is also seeking advice from the privacy commissioner and the digital policy office while conducting a full review with the contractor to strengthen protection measures for the City Ticketing Network system and prevent similar incidents from recurring.

content:
香港软雪糕样本细菌超标 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 25 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港软雪糕样本细菌含量超标
香港一家商店的软冰淇淋样本经检测，每克含有 180 万个细菌，远高于 5 万个限值。食物安全中心责令该店停止销售、清理库存并暂时关闭。该店已因无照经营而被起诉。
香港食物安全中心于2026年11月25日公布，从太子一间店铺采集的软雪糕样本，细菌总数为每克180万个，超出《冰冻甜点规例》（第132AC章）规定的每克5万个细菌的法定上限。
该中心发言人表示，该商店已被勒令立即停止销售和处置受影响的产品，并暂时停止营业。如果发现足够证据，中心将对检测结果不合格提出起诉。
根据食物环境卫生署记录，该店现正申请食品制造厂牌照及冰冻甜点制造厂牌照。这些申请仍在处理中。此前，该部门在巡查中发现该店涉嫌无照经营食品业务，并已提出检控。该部门证实该场所在 11 月 25 日没有营业。
食物环境卫生署强调，会继续严厉打击无牌食物经营场所，并呼吁经营者切勿违法。它还建议公众不要光顾此类场所。
中心表示将继续跟进案件，并采取适当行动，维护食品安全和公众健康。调查正在进行中。根据《冰冻甜点规例》，任何出售的冰冻甜点每克含有的细菌不得超过50,000个。根据该规例被定罪的罪犯，最高可被罚款港币 10,000 元及监禁三个月。中心指出，细菌数量超过法定标准表明卫生状况不理想，但并不一定意味着该产品会引起食物中毒。
根据《食品业规例》（第 132X 章），任何经营涉及制备和销售供场所外食用的食品的业务的人都必须持有食品工厂牌照。另外，根据《冰冻甜点规例》，任何生产冰冻甜点的场所（包括使用分配机制作软冰淇淋以供直接零售）都必须持有冰冻甜点工厂许可证。无牌经营食品业务属犯罪行为，最高可判处罚款港币 50,000 元及监禁六个月。

Hong Kong soft ice-cream sample exceeds legal bacteria limit | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 25 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong soft ice-cream sample exceeds legal bacteria limit
A soft ice-cream sample from a Hong Kong shop tested at 1.8 million bacteria per gram, far above the 50,000 limit. The Centre for Food Safety ordered the shop to stop sales, dispose of stock and close temporarily. The shop was already being prosecuted for operating without a licence.
The Centre for Food Safety of Hong Kong announced on 25 November 2026 that a soft ice-cream sample collected from a shop in Prince had a total bacterial count of 1.8 million per gram, exceeding the legal limit of 50,000 bacteria per gram set under the Frozen Confection Regulations (Cap. 132AC).
A spokesman for the centre said that the shop has been ordered to immediately stop selling and dispose of the affected product and to temporarily close its business. If sufficient evidence is found, the centre will prosecute for the unsatisfactory test result.
According to records of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, the shop was in the process of applying for a food factory licence and a frozen confection factory licence. Those applications were still being processed. Earlier, during an inspection, the department found the shop allegedly operating a food business without a licence and had already initiated a prosecution. The department confirmed that the premises were not operating on 25 November.
The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department stressed that it will continue to take strict action against unlicensed food premises and urged operators not to break the law. It also advised members of the public not to patronise such premises.
The centre said it will continue to follow up on the case and take appropriate action to safeguard food safety and public health. The investigation is ongoing. Under the Frozen Confection Regulations, any frozen confection offered for sale must not contain more than 50,000 bacteria per gram. An offender convicted under the regulations is liable to a maximum fine of HK$10,000 and imprisonment for three months. The centre noted that a bacterial count exceeding the legal standard indicates unsatisfactory hygiene conditions but does not necessarily mean the product will cause food poisoning.
Under the Food Business Regulations (Cap. 132X), anyone operating a business involving the preparation and sale of food for consumption outside the premises must hold a food factory licence. Separately, under the Frozen Confection Regulations, any premises that manufactures frozen confections – including using dispensing machines to make soft ice-cream for direct retail – must hold a frozen confection factory licence. Operating a food business without a licence is an offence punishable by a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for six months.

content:
第八次粤港澳法律会议推进湾区法治合作 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 25 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
第八次粤港澳法律会议推进湾区法治合作
粤港澳法律部门第八次联席会议同意进一步在调解、仲裁和立法协调等方面开展合作。湾区仲裁调解标准推广平台上线，已有十余家机构加入。香港的
粤港澳法律部门第八次联席会议于11月25日召开，会议讨论调解、仲裁、立法协调、法律人才培训等议题。会议宣布了制定和推广湾区标准、加强三地机制和规则对接的进展情况。
湾区仲裁调解标准推广平台正式成立。十余家仲裁调解机构已加入该平台，将与联席会议共同推广标准，收集用户和从业人员的反馈，完善跨境纠纷解决机制。旨在降低跨境纠纷解决成本，支持大湾区高质量发展。
香港律政司司长张浩然博士表示，该平台将使湾区标准体系更加全面，涵盖制定、推广和完善。他表示，标准不仅要制定出来，还要投入使用，并在实践中不断完善。
三方还就立法协调达成共识，同意推进相关研究。张博士表示，由他领导的一个工作组正在成立，以加速三个司法管辖区之间的规则和机制协调。工作小组将协调相关政策局，支持联席会议工作，推动“一国两制三法域”框架下的对接，响应国家“十五五”深化粤港澳大湾区发展规划。
调解方面，会议通过了2026年版粤港澳大湾区调解员名册，并修订了调解员资格标准、职业行为准则和跨境调解示范规则。在仲裁方面，三方就大湾区仲裁员名册的使用交换了意见，并商定了制定粤港澳大湾区仲裁规则示范规则的切实可行的路径，旨在实现各司法管辖区优势互补，为跨境业务提供更加稳定和可预测的环境。
会议还讨论了支持大湾区高质量发展的法律人才培养等举措。张博士表示，习近平主席在深圳举行的2026年亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上发表讲话时表示，湾区经济是开放的、协作的、具有溢出效应的。张建宗表示联席会议机制多年来已建立信任与合作，律政司会继续与粤澳紧密合作，落实商定的措施。

Eighth Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao legal meeting advances Bay Area rule-of-law cooperation | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 25 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Eighth Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao legal meeting advances Bay Area rule-of-law cooperation
The eighth joint meeting of legal departments from Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao agreed on further cooperation in mediation, arbitration and legislative coordination. A platform to promote Bay Area standards for arbitration and mediation was launched, with over ten institutions joining. Hong Kong's
The eighth joint meeting of legal departments from Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao was held on 25 November, with representatives discussing mediation, arbitration, legislative coordination and legal talent training. The meeting announced progress on developing and promoting Bay Area standards, and enhancing mechanism and rule alignment among the three jurisdictions.
A platform to promote Bay Area standards for arbitration and mediation was formally established. More than ten arbitration and mediation institutions have joined the platform, which will work with the joint meeting to promote the standards, collect feedback from users and practitioners, and improve mechanisms for cross-border dispute resolution. The aim is to lower the cost of resolving cross-border disputes and support high-quality development of the Greater Bay Area.
Dr Horace Cheung, Hong Kong's Secretary for Justice, said the platform would make the system for Bay Area standards more comprehensive, covering formulation, promotion and refinement. He said the standards would not only be created but also put into use and continuously improved through practice.
The three sides also reached a consensus on legislative coordination and agreed to advance related research. Dr Cheung said a task force he leads to accelerate rule and mechanism alignment among the three jurisdictions was being set up. The task force will coordinate relevant policy bureaux to support the joint meeting's work and promote alignment under the 'one country, two systems, three legal jurisdictions' framework, responding to national plans for deepening Greater Bay Area development under the 15th Five-Year Plan.
On mediation, the meeting approved the 2026 edition of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Mediator Register and revised the standards for mediator qualifications, the code of professional conduct and the model rules for cross-border mediation. On arbitration, the three sides exchanged views on the use of the Greater Bay Area Arbitrator Register and agreed on a practical path to develop model arbitration rules for the region, aiming to complement each jurisdiction's strengths and provide a more stable and predictable environment for cross-border business.
The meeting also discussed legal talent training and other measures to support high-quality development of the Greater Bay Area. Dr Cheung noted that President Xi Jinping, speaking at the 2026 APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen, had said that bay area economies are open, collaborative and have spill-over effects. Dr Cheung said the joint meeting mechanism had built trust and cooperation over the years, and the Department of Justice would continue to work closely with Guangdong and Macao to implement the agreed measures.

content:
香港中医医院与湖南大学医院签署战略协议 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 25 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港中医医院与湖南大学医院签署战略协议
香港中医院与湖南中医药大学第一附属医院在卫生官员见证下签署战略合作协议。交易内容涵盖人才交流、跨境案例讨论、药物相互作用数据库、学术研讨会和研究
香港中医院与湖南中医药大学第一附属医院于2026年11月25日在卫生局副局长温竹清医生及湖南省中医药管理局局长肖文明等见证下签署战略合作协议。
万博士表示，国家“十五五”规划强调推动中医药传承创新，完善中医药服务体系，发展中西医结合医疗服务。香港特区政府正在建设香港中医医院，以促进中西医合作、临床人才培训和中医药研究。
万博士补充说，战略合作伙伴关系将创建一个国际中医药人才和资源中心，以在全球范围内推广中医药文化。她表示，医院将利用香港“一国两制”的独特优势，与内地及国际医疗机构合作，打造纯中医、中西医结合的“香港模式”，成为全球标杆。
协议涵盖中医药人才交流、跨境远程病例讨论、建立共享药物相互作用预警数据库平台、中医药学术研讨会、建立研究网络等有利于香港与湖南中医药发展的医疗、教学和研究项目。
香港中医院此前已与22家机构签署战略协议，包括本地大学、澳门医院以及广东、北京、天津、江苏、山东、四川、河北、上海、河南等内地省份的医院，以及德国中医诊所和澳大利亚西悉尼大学。

Hong Kong Chinese Medicine Hospital signs strategic deal with Hunan university hospital | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 25 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Chinese Medicine Hospital signs strategic deal with Hunan university hospital
Hong Kong Chinese Medicine Hospital signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Hunan University of Chinese Medicine First Affiliated Hospital, witnessed by health officials. The deal covers talent exchange, cross-border case discussions, drug interaction databases, academic seminars and research
Hong Kong Chinese Medicine Hospital and Hunan University of Chinese Medicine First Affiliated Hospital signed a strategic cooperation agreement on 25 November 2026, witnessed by Dr Fanny Wan, Deputy Secretary for Health, and other officials including Xiao Wenming, Director of Hunan Provincial Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
Dr Wan said the national 15th Five-Year Plan emphasises promoting the inheritance and innovation of Chinese medicine, improving the Chinese medicine service system and developing integrated Chinese-Western medical services. The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government is building the Hong Kong Chinese Medicine Hospital to facilitate Chinese-Western medicine collaboration, clinical talent training and Chinese medicine research.
The strategic partnership will create an international hub for Chinese medicine talent and resources to promote Chinese medicine culture worldwide, Dr Wan added. She noted that the hospital will leverage Hong Kong's unique advantages under 'one country, two systems' to collaborate with mainland and international medical institutions, developing a 'Hong Kong model' of pure Chinese medicine and integrated Chinese-Western care as a global benchmark.
The agreement covers talent exchanges in Chinese medicine, cross-border remote case discussions, establishment of a shared drug interaction alert database platform, academic seminars on Chinese medicine, creation of research networks and other healthcare, teaching and research projects beneficial to Hong Kong-Hunan Chinese medicine development.
Hong Kong Chinese Medicine Hospital has previously signed strategic agreements with 22 institutions, including local universities, hospitals in Macau and mainland provinces such as Guangdong, Beijing, Tianjin, Jiangsu, Shandong, Sichuan, Hebei, Shanghai and Henan, as well as Klinik Chinesische Medizin in Germany and Western Sydney University in Australia.

summary: 中国已向天宫空间站发射了神舟二十四号载人飞船。该任务于世界标准时间 11 月 25 日 00:18 从酒泉卫星发射中心的长征 2F/G 升空。这一具有里程碑意义的任务标志着首次与国际宇航员的联合飞行，也是首次有外国人踏入国际空间站。两国于 2025 年 2 月签署协议后，两名巴基斯坦宇航员穆罕默德·泽山·阿里 (Muhammad Zeeshan Ali) 和库拉姆·达乌德 (Khurram Daud) 自 4 月起一直在北京的中国航天员研究训练中心接受训练。
content:
中国已向天宫空间站发射了神舟二十四号载人飞船。该任务于世界标准时间 11 月 25 日 00:18 从酒泉卫星发射中心的长征 2F/G 升空。这一具有里程碑意义的任务标志着首次与国际宇航员的联合飞行，也是首次有外国人踏入国际空间站。两国于 2025 年 2 月签署协议后，两名巴基斯坦宇航员穆罕默德·泽尚·阿里 (Muhammad Zeeshan Ali) 和胡拉姆·达乌德 (Khurram Daud) 自 4 月起一直在北京的中国航天员研究训练中心接受训练。穆罕默德·泽尚·阿里 (Muhammad Zeeshan Ali) 成为中巴建交 75 周年之际第一位进入轨道的巴基斯坦宇航员，而他的同事则被指定为后备宇航员。任务补丁的设计以巴基斯坦国花茉莉花为特色。神舟二十四号机组人员（从左到右：穆罕默德·泽山·阿里、唐洪波中校、吴仪）（图片来源：CMSA）作为有效载荷专家，阿里将在神舟二十三号飞船上停留约一周，返回。神舟二十三号指挥员朱扬柱将再留任六个月，成为中国首位单次在轨飞行一年的航天员。神舟二十四号于北京时间 11 月 25 日 08:18（世界标准时间 00:18）在酒泉卫星发射中心发射升空。一年前的今天，神舟二十二号无人发射，执行了一项同样值得注意的任务。
此次发射是中国继神舟二十号返回舱窗户出现裂缝后的首次“紧急响应”，疑似由碎片撞击造成。此次发射是在神舟二十一号发射17天后发射的，为该任务的机组人员提供救生艇，随后机组人员搭乘曾经空无一人的飞船返回家园。通常情况下，备用的长征运载火箭和神舟飞船将接近完工以应对这种情况，否则将用于后续任务。据此，神舟二十四号任务的运载火箭自4月份以来一直在酒泉卫星发射中心，并于5月份进行垂直集成和测试。穆罕默德·泽尚·阿里在发射彩排期间（图​​片来源：CCTV）中国载人航天工程局（CMSA）在发射前一天的新闻发布会上宣布了三名宇航员的名字。唐洪波指挥此次任务，成为第一位三次访问天宫的航天员。 2020 年 9 月，他被选为中国第三批航天员大队的飞行工程师，此前，他曾参加过神舟十二号和神舟十七号任务。穆罕默德·泽尚·阿里 (Muhammad Zeeshan Ali) 担任有效载荷专家，完成了为期一周左右的短期任务，然后搭乘神舟二十三号飞船返回地球。访问期间，他将进行中巴微重力实验，并安装样品和实验装置。
同样来自第三批航天员的吴仪，作为飞行工程师完成了他的首飞。 神舟二十四号标志着中国第十八次载人航天飞行，也是空间站“应用发展”阶段的第八个阶段。长征2F/G Y24总装楼及周边龙门架视图（来源：CCTV） 低温调整 针对11月份可能出现的低温天气，发射场采取了综合措施。其中包括增加发射架的环境气候控制以及火箭和航天器的隔热层。温暖稳定的温度是

【原文 English Original】
China has launched the Shenzhou-24 crewed spacecraft to the Tiangong (“heavenly palace”) space station. The mission lifted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center atop a Chang Zheng 2F/G on Nov. 25 at 00:18 UTC. This milestone mission marks the first joint flight with international astronauts, and the first time a foreign national has stepped into the station. Two Pakistani astronauts, Muhammad Zeeshan Ali and Khurram Daud, have been training since April at the China Astronaut Research and Training Center in Beijing, following a signed agreement between the two nations in February 2025. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has become the first Pakistani astronaut to reach orbit as China and Pakistan mark the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations, while his colleague was assigned as backup. The mission patch features Pakistan’s national flower, Jasmine, in the design. Shenzhou-24 crew (Left to Right: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, Commander Tang Hongbo, Wu Yi) (Credit: CMSA) Serving as payload specialist, Ali will stay for about a week, returning aboard the Shenzhou-23 craft. Shenzhou-23 Commander, Zhu Yangzhu, will stay on for a further six months and become China’s first astronaut to spend a year in orbit in a single visit. Shenzhou-24 launched from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center (JSLC) on Nov. 25 at 08:18 Beijing time (00:18 UTC). A year ago, to the day, Shenzhou-22 launched uncrewed on an equally notable mission. The launch was China’s first ’emergency response’, following the discovery of a crack in the window of the Shenzhou-20 return capsule, which was suspected to have been caused by a debris strike. The mission launched 17 days after Shenzhou-21 to provide a lifeboat for that mission’s crew, who later returned home on the once-empty spacecraft. It is customary for a standby Chang Zheng launch vehicle and Shenzhou craft to be near completion for such eventualities, otherwise being used for the subsequent mission. As such, the vehicles for the Shenzhou-24 mission have been at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center since April, with the stack undergoing vertical integration and testing in May. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali during launch rehearsals (Credit: CCTV) The China Manned Space Agency (CMSA) announced the names of the three astronauts at a news conference the day before launch. Tang Hongbo is commanding the mission and has become the first astronaut to visit Tiangong three times. He previously served on the Shenzhou-12 and Shenzhou-17 missions following his selection as a flight engineer in China’s third astronaut group in September 2020. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is serving as a payload specialist, completing a short-term mission lasting around a week before returning to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 craft. During his stay, he will conduct Sino-Pakistani experiments in microgravity and will install sample and experiment units. Wu Yi, also from the third batch of astronauts, took his inaugural flight, serving as Flight Engineer. Shenzhou-24 marks China’s 18th crewed spaceflight, and the eighth of the station’s ‘application and development’ phase. View of Chang Zheng 2F/G Y24 in the assembly building and surrounding gantries (Credit: CCTV) Low temperature adjustments Comprehensive measures were implemented at the launch site in response to the potential for low-temperature weather during November. These included adding environmental climate control for the launch gantry as well as insulation for the rocket and spacecraft. A warm stabilized temperature was achieved inside the tower using thermal insulation skirts to partition levels and through further gap-sealing treatments. A low-temperature adaptability analysis was conducted for all outdoor equipment at the site. On launch day, the sequence and deployment times of the gantry’s rotating arms could be adjusted in reaction to temperature conditions if necessary, to minimize the adverse effects of the cold environment on the vehicle. These tower arms rotated away from the vehicle and completed around 30 minutes prior to launch. JSLC’s Site 91 exclusively supports launches of the Chang Zheng 2F (CZ-2F) family of launch vehicles, carrying either crewed missions or China’s Chongfu Shiyong Shiyan Hangtian Qi experimental reusable spaceplane. For this mission, the launch site’s UDMH propellant loading pump was fully replaced after more than 20 years of service. The site also installed 19 voltage stabilization units to improve the reliability of power supply during refueling and launch. View from the launch pad at Site 91 looking back to the vehicle assembly building (Credit: CCTV) See Also Shenzhou-24 updates Chinese Spaceflight Forum NSF Store Click here to Join L2 The CZ-2F launch vehicle, carrying the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft inside its fairing, was rolled out to Launch Site 91 in the afternoon and evening of Nov. 17. The vehicle assembly moved out of the vertical integration and testing facility on its mobile platform and traveled along a dedicated 1.5 km rail line to the launch tower. In preparation to welcome the Shenzhou spacecraft, the Tiangong station adjusted its orbit and altitude on Nov. 23. On launch day, the three crew members departed the Wentian Pavilion astronauts’ quarters and formally reported to the Commander in Chief in the pavilion’s Yuanmeng (“dream fulfillment”) Garden Square. This ceremony, in which they are given the order to proceed, dates back to the Shenzhou-5 mission in 2003 and is one of several salutes as they make their way to the launch pad, just under three hours before launch. After traveling to the pad via bus, the crew entered their craft through a side hatch on the rocket via the ninth floor of the tower at around 60 meters high, with the Commander ingressing last. The hatch is closed around two hours before liftoff, after which teams conducted final pre-launch checks. Rotating arms of the Site 91 launch pad tower close around the Chang Zheng 2F/G carrying the Shenzhou-24 craft within its fairing (Credit: CCTV) While development continues on the Chang Zheng 10 rocket family and the next-generation Mengzhou spacecraft, the CZ-2F/G is currently China’s only crew-rated launch vehicle to have carried astronauts. Four boosters support the first stage of the vehicle, each with eight engines providing a combined thrust of approximately six meganewtons. All of the rocket’s engines burn dinitrogen tetroxide and unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine (UDMH). The Shenzhou-24 spacecraft docked to the Tianhe module’s forward port on the station around three and a half hours after launch at 03:56 UTC. This fast rendezvous and docking mode has become the preferred profile since Shenzhou-21, shaving three hours off the previous journey time. Shenzhou-23 Crew As the Shenzhou-23 crew’s six-month stay draws to an end, the trio have been conducting further experiments on brain function and sensory perception. Using EEG equipment to monitor how the brain’s networks change over time in space, the data will help researchers understand how long-duration stays in microgravity affect astronauts’ brain function, sense of touch, and fine motor control. Shenzhou-23 Astronauts aboard Tiangong – payload specialist Li Jiaying wears a VR headset while Zhang Zhiyuan floats horizontally beside her (Credit: CMSA) The crew conducted only one spacewalk, when Commander Zhu Yangzhu and Zhang Zhiyuan spent around five and a half hours outside the station on Aug. 28, with Li Jiaying supporting from inside. The pair installed debris shielding and carried out only the second external repair of a Tiangong solar array. The Commander is flying his second spaceflight, having previously served on the Shenzhou-16 mission in 2023. He was selected for China’s third astronaut group in 2020, while his two colleagues are completing their first trip to space. Zhang Zhiyuan and Li Jiaying will return aboard Shenzhou-23 along with Shenzhou-24’s Pakistani payload specialist after a handover of roughly a week, while Zhu will remain aboard to continue his year-long mission. The three are expected to land at the Dongfeng landing site in the Badain Jaran Desert, Inner Mongolia, roughly five and a half hours after undocking from the station. Shenzhou-24 mission patch (Credit: CMSA)   (Lead image: Chang Zheng 2FG Y24 carrying Shenzhou-24 spacecraft arrives at the launch site on November 17 – Credit: CMSA) The post Tiangong Space Station welcomes first international visitor appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com .

title: Hong Kong to impose citywide drone ban, harbour and road curbs for Interpol General Assembly next week
zh_title: 香港下周将在国际刑警组织大会上实施全市无人机禁令、港口和道路限制
summary: 香港将在下周主办国际刑警组织年度峰会时实施空中、海上和陆地限制，限制无人机和小型飞机的行动以及维多利亚港部分地区的海上交通。当局将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日第 94 届国际刑警组织大会期间在整个香港空域设立临时飞行限制区。图片：截图来自香港警方。国际刑警组织第94届大会将于11月30日至12月3日在香港举行，与会代表
content:
香港将在下周主办国际刑警组织年度峰会时实施空中、海上和陆地限制，限制无人机和小型飞机的行动以及维多利亚港部分地区的海上交通。当局将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日第 94 届国际刑警组织大会期间在整个香港空域设立临时飞行限制区。图片：截图来自香港警方。国际刑警组织第94届大会将于11月30日至12月3日在香港举行，来自196个成员国的代表将出席，探讨全球安全问题。警方行动组总警司黄志荣在周一的新闻发布会上表示，预计将有超过 1000 人参加此次活动，其中包括国际刑警组织成员国的警察局长以及政府高级官员。他表示，峰会期间，香港的整个空域将被指定为临时飞行限制区，禁止无人机、小型飞机和直升机以及滑翔伞、风筝和“大量气球”进行未经授权的操作。黄用粤语说：“但这些限制不会影响民用飞机的运营。”他补充说，民航处将向航空公司和飞行员公布航空限制的范围。
他警告居民，在下周的临时禁令期间，不要在未经许可的情况下操作无人机，并指出，根据《小型无人机令》，违法者最高可被处以10万港元罚款和两年监禁。 海上和陆地交通限制 当局将限制国际刑警组织峰会将在湾仔举行的香港会议展览中心附近的维多利亚港部分地区的海上交通，同时会场周围的道路也将被关闭。 2024 年 4 月 3 日，一名男子俯瞰香港维多利亚港。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港水上的士是一条深受游客欢迎的跨海路线，在峰会期间将跳过湾仔站。行人也将被禁止进入会展中心外的长廊。黄先生敦促居民注意交通限制并提前计划出行。他还敦促船只和巴士运营商提前计划，避免在国际刑警组织峰会场地附近接送乘客。黄补充说，警方将在活动期间协调港口和会场附近的海上和陆地交通。这是香港首次主办国际刑警组织大会，也是该活动第三次在中国举办。北京分别于1995年和2017年举办过两次。
上周，香港警方在邻近的中国城市深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织峰会期间逮捕了五名非法无人机操作男子，此前当局在香港北部领空的大部分地区实施了为期四天的禁飞区。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong will enforce air, sea and land restrictions when it hosts Interpol’s annual summit next week, limiting drone and small-aircraft operations as well as marine traffic in parts of Victoria Harbour. Authorities will impose a temporary restricted flying zone across the entire Hong Kong airspace for the duration of the 94th Interpol General Assembly from November 30 to December 3, 2026. Photo: Screenshot, via Hong Kong Police. The 94th International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) General Assembly is set to take place in Hong Kong from November 30 to December 3, with representatives from 196 member countries expected to attend to address global security issues. Wong Chi-wing, chief superintendent of the police’s operations wing, told a press conference on Monday that more than 1,000 people are expected to attend the event, including the police chiefs of Interpol’s member countries as well as senior government officials. He said Hong Kong’s entire airspace would be designated a temporary restricted flying zone for the duration of the summit, barring unauthorised operations of drones, small aircraft and helicopters, as well as paragliders, kites and “large numbers of balloons.” “But the restrictions will not affect civil aircraft operations,” Wong said in Cantonese, adding that the Civil Aviation Department would publicise the scope of the air restrictions for airlines and pilots. He warned residents against operating drones without a permit during the temporary ban next week, noting that offenders face a maximum penalty of a HK$100,000 fine and two years’ imprisonment under the Small Unmanned Aircraft Order. Sea and land traffic curbs Authorities will restrict marine traffic in parts of Victoria Harbour off the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, where the Interpol summit will take place, while roads surrounding the venue will also be closed. A man looks out over Victoria Harbour in Hong Kong, on April 3, 2024. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Hong Kong Water Taxi, a cross-harbour route popular with tourists, will skip its Wan Chai stop for the duration of the summit. Pedestrians will also be barred from entering the promenade outside the convention and exhibition centre. Wong urged residents to take note of the traffic restrictions and plan their journeys in advance. He also urged boat and bus operators to plan ahead and avoid picking up or dropping off passengers near the Interpol summit venue. Police will coordinate sea and land traffic in the harbour and near the venue for the duration of the event, Wong added. This will be the first time Hong Kong hosts the Interpol General Assembly and the third time the event has taken place in China. Beijing hosted it twice, in 1995 and 2017. Last week, Hong Kong police arrested five men over illegal drone operations during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the neighbouring Chinese city of Shenzhen, after authorities imposed a four-day restricted flying zone across much of Hong Kong’s northern airspace.

title: Hong Kong police arrest 38-year-old man over fatal Tsim Sha Tsui crash that killed Muslim community leader
zh_title: 香港警方因尖沙咀车祸导致穆斯林社区领袖死亡而逮捕38岁男子
summary: 周日，一辆汽车在尖沙咀驶上人行道，造成一人死亡、三人受伤，警方拘捕一名涉嫌酒后驾驶及危险驾驶致人死亡的38岁男子。 2026 年 11 月 22 日星期日下午 2:30 左右，一辆汽车冲上普拉特大道 (Prat Avenue) 的人行道，造成一人死亡、三人受伤。照片：由詹姆斯·奥肯登提供。据警方新闻稿称，事件发生在下午 2:30 左右，发生在 Prat Avenue。当地媒体分享了闭路电视和旁观者的镜头，显示司机和一名女乘客在事发后试图逃离现场。
content:
周日，一辆汽车在尖沙咀驶上人行道，造成一人死亡、三人受伤，警方拘捕一名涉嫌酒后驾驶及危险驾驶致人死亡的38岁男子。 2026 年 11 月 22 日星期日下午 2:30 左右，一辆汽车冲上普拉特大道 (Prat Avenue) 的人行道，造成一人死亡、三人受伤。照片：由詹姆斯·奥肯登提供。据警方新闻稿称，事件发生在下午 2:30 左右，发生在 Prat Avenue。当地媒体分享了闭路电视和旁观者的镜头，显示司机和一名女乘客在事故发生后试图逃离现场。总督察刘家恒在周日的警方新闻发布会上表示，有几名公众跟踪司机并向当局报警。 2026 年 11 月 22 日，总督察刘家恒（左）在新闻发布会上。图片：香港警务处截图，来自 Facebook。新闻稿称，一名53岁男性行人在昏迷不醒的情况下被送往伊丽莎白女王医院，并于下午3时23分证实死亡。新闻稿称：“经进一步调查，该名38岁私家车男司机因酒后驾驶及危险驾驶致人死亡被捕，现被拘留调查。” 2026 年 11 月 22 日星期日下午 2:30 左右，一辆汽车冲上普拉特大道 (Prat Avenue) 的人行道，造成一人死亡、三人受伤。照片：由詹姆斯·奥肯登提供。
警方补充，一名62岁非华裔男性行人头部受伤，两名年龄分别为31岁和70岁的女性行人四肢受伤。三人均在神志清醒的情况下被送往伊利沙伯医院。事故发生后，人行道和路边看到一串损坏的自行车、碎片和破损的栏杆。穆斯林领袖被杀 香港穆斯林理事会在社交媒体上发布的帖子称，受害者是当地主要伊斯兰教育组织 Khatme Nubuwwat 伊斯兰理事会有限公司的副主席贾维德·马哈茂德 (Javed Mahmood)。屏幕截图：香港穆斯林理事会，来自 X。酒后驾驶的最高处罚是罚款 25,000 港元和监禁三年。危险驾驶致人死亡罪名成立，可判处十年监禁及罚款港币五万元。没有报告交通意外亦违反《道路交通条例》。然而，警方周一告诉香港新闻社，目前还没有关于被捕男子可能面临的指控的最新消息。致命车祸发生后的第二天，警方的 Instagram 页面上出现了一幅人工智能生成的漫画，上面写着“现实生活不是游戏。喝酒吗？不要开车”，这显然是对新发布的视频游戏《侠盗猎车手 VI》的模仿。西九龙交通部第一特别调查队正调查案件。目击者或任何知情者请致电 3661 9188 与警方联系。

【原文 English Original】
Police have arrested a 38-year-old man on suspicion of drink-driving and dangerous driving causing death after a vehicle mounted a pavement in Tsim Sha Tsui on Sunday, leaving one person dead and three injured. A vehicle mounted a pavement on Prat Avenue at around 2:30pm on Sunday, November 22, 2026, leaving one dead and three injured. Photo: Courtesy of James Ockenden. The incident took place on Prat Avenue at around 2:30pm, according to a police press release. Local media shared CCTV and bystander footage appearing to show the driver and a female passenger attempting to flee the scene after the crash. Speaking at a police press briefing on Sunday, Chief Inspector Lau Ka-hang said several members of the public followed the driver and alerted authorities. Chief Inspector Lau Ka-hang (left) at a press briefing on November 22, 2026. Photo: HKPF screenshot, via Facebook. The press release said a 53-year-old male pedestrian was rushed to Queen Elizabeth Hospital unconscious and was certified dead at 3:23pm. “After further investigations, the 38-year-old private car male driver was arrested for drink driving and dangerous driving causing death and is being detained for enquiries,” the press release said. A vehicle mounted a pavement on Prat Avenue at around 2:30pm on Sunday, November 22, 2026, leaving one dead and three injured. Photo: Courtesy of James Ockenden. Police added that a 62-year-old non-ethnic Chinese male pedestrian sustained head injuries, while two female pedestrians, aged 31 and 70, suffered limb injuries. All three were taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital in a conscious state. A trail of damaged bicycles, debris and mangled railings was seen across the pavement and roadside following the crash. Muslim leader killed Social media posts by the Muslim Council of Hong Kong identified the victim as Javed Mahmood, the vice-chair of Khatme Nubuwwat Islamic Council Limited, a major local Islamic education organisation. Screenshot: Muslim Council of Hong Kong, via X. The maximum penalty for drink-driving is a HK$25,000 fine and three years behind bars. Those convicted of causing death by dangerous driving face 10 years’ imprisonment and a HK$50,000 fine. Failing to report a traffic accident is also a breach of the Road Traffic Ordinance. However, police told HKFP on Monday that there was no update yet on the charges the arrested man might face. A day after the fatal crash, an AI-generated cartoon appeared on the police Instagram page stating that “real life is not gaming. Drank? Don’t drive,” in an apparent parody of the newly released video game Grand Theft Auto VI. Special Investigation Team 1 of Traffic Kowloon West is investigating the case. Witnesses or anyone with information are urged to contact officers on 3661 9188.

title: Anatomy of a Chinese loanbook
zh_title: 中国贷款簿剖析
summary: ICIJ 的中国资本调查揭露了全球最大银行中国工商银行 (ICBC) 的伦敦分行如何例行公事地为企业提供资金以推动北京的地缘政治议程，有时甚至在此过程中藐视自己的合规规则。 ICIJ 与 23 家媒体合作伙伴合作，获得了工银伦敦泄露的 480 万份内部文件，包括贷款申请表、尽职调查报告、了解你的客户文件和内部电子邮件往来。为了更好地了解工行伦敦业务，ICIJ 数据团队剖析了 200 多个贷款机构
content:
ICIJ 的中国资本调查揭露了全球最大银行中国工商银行 (ICBC) 的伦敦分行如何例行公事地为企业提供资金以推动北京的地缘政治议程，有时甚至在此过程中藐视自己的合规规则。 ICIJ 与 23 家媒体合作伙伴合作，获得了工银伦敦泄露的 480 万份内部文件，包括贷款申请表、尽职调查报告、了解你的客户文件和内部电子邮件往来。为了更好地了解工行伦敦业务，ICIJ数据团队剖析了2010年至2024年期间的200多份贷款协议和修正案。ICIJ发现，在审查的协议和修正案中，工银伦敦至少与另一家中国国有商业银行合作。在中国的银行中，中国银行脱颖而出，成为工银伦敦分行的主要中方合作伙伴：双方签署了 102 项协议。 ICIJ 的分析显示，这家中国银行业巨头的伦敦分行通常与其他中国和国际银行合作，达成价值数亿美元甚至更多的贷款协议。 ICIJ 发现了 36 项贷款协议和修正案，其中一半或以上的资金是由中国贷方提供的。其中 16 个案例的财务承诺完全来自中资银行。
ICIJ 的一项审查发现，作为对该行客户尽职调查过程的一部分，中国工商银行准备的文件显示，该行有时会淡化合规问题，或以其他方式证明继续与其被归类为高风险的客户开展业务是合理的。 在赞比亚，中国工商银行在加剧该国债务负担、造成对中国贷款的依赖以及给赞比亚人造成多年困难方面发挥了作用。在英国，中国工商银行的银行管理人员无视其一位中国客户在美国法院面临的法律风险，以便该银行能够为该公司收购英国竞争对手并巩固其市场份额提供资金。下面的案例研究揭示了一家银行在中国党国议程的推进与其自身的全球商业野心之间取得平衡的内部运作方式。无视红灯 01 2024年5月，工商银行的高风险客户名单包括全球燃料贸易商和分销商Puma Energy的融资部门以及大股东Trafigura Pte.有限公司是一家注册并总部位于新加坡的贸易巨头，主要贸易业务位于瑞士，以及另外两家托克实体。尽管中国工商银行对 Puma 和 Trafigura 的担忧至少可以追溯到 2015 年，但 ICIJ 发现 2015 年至 2024 年间涉及 Puma 和 Trafigura 的 19 项银团信贷安排协议，总价值达 387 亿美元。 ICBC 的伦敦实体在这些贷款中总共承诺提供 14 亿美元。
2015年，工商银行加大了对Puma旗下融资工具Puma International Financing的尽职调查力度；在其2015年5月的强化尽职调查（EDD）报告中，将该公司的贿赂风险评为“高”。 当时，Puma的股东包括安哥拉国有石油公司Sonangol和Cochan Holdings LLC（一家由安哥拉总统顾问Leopoldino Fragoso do Nascimento创立并担任主席的投资公司）。该报告承认，媒体广泛报道了涉及安哥拉高级官员的贿赂和腐败行为，其中包括当时的总统若泽·爱德华多·多斯桑托斯及其子女，以及Sonangol、Cochan和Nascimento。尽管如此，工行仍对大部分逆回购进行了描述

【原文 English Original】
ICIJ’s China Capital investigation revealed how the London units of the world’s largest bank, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC), routinely financed companies to push Beijing’s geopolitical agenda, sometimes flouting their own compliance rules in the process. ICIJ, in collaboration with 23 media partners, obtained 4.8 million internal documents leaked from ICBC London, including loan application forms, due diligence reports, know-your-client documents and internal email exchanges. To better understand ICBC’s London operations, the ICIJ data team dissected more than 200 loan agreements and amendments dated from 2010 to 2024. ICIJ found that ICBC London partnered with at least one other Chinese state-owned commercial bank in more than half of the agreements and amendments reviewed. Among the Chinese lenders, Bank of China stands out as the main Chinese partner of ICBC London: They joined forces in 102 agreements. ICIJ’s analysis shows that the London units of the Chinese banking giant usually partnered with other Chinese and international banks on loan agreements often worth hundreds of millions of dollars—or more. ICIJ identified 36 loan agreements and amendments for which half or more of the money was provided by Chinese lenders. In 16 of those cases, the financial commitments were entirely from Chinese banks. ICBC documents prepared as part of the due diligence process on the bank’s clients show how the bank at times downplayed compliance problems or otherwise justified continued business with clients it had classified as high risk, an ICIJ review found. In Zambia, ICBC played a role in exacerbating the country’s debt burden, creating dependency on Chinese loans and contributing to years-long difficulties for Zambians. In the U.K., ICBC bank officers disregarded legal risks faced in a U.S. court by one of their Chinese clients so the bank could finance the company’s acquisition of a British competitor and consolidate its market share. The case studies below reveal the inner workings of a bank balancing the advancement of the agenda of the Chinese party-state with its own global commercial ambitions. Ignoring Red Lights 01 In May 2024, ICBC’s high-risk client list included the financing arm of global fuel trader and distributor Puma Energy, along with a major shareholder Trafigura Pte. Ltd., a trading giant registered and headquartered in Singapore with major trading operations in Switzerland, and two other Trafigura entities. Despite ICBC's concerns about Puma and Trafigura dating back to at least 2015, ICIJ identified 19 syndicated credit facility agreements involving Puma and Trafigura, between 2015 and 2024, with a combined value of $38.7 billion. ICBC's London entities committed a total of $1.4 billion across those facilities. In 2015, ICBC escalated its due diligence of Puma’s financing vehicle, Puma International Financing; in its May 2015 Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) report, it rated the company’s bribery risk as high. At the time, Puma's shareholders included Angola's state-owned oil company Sonangol and Cochan Holdings LLC, an investment company founded and chaired by Angolan presidential adviser Leopoldino Fragoso do Nascimento. The report acknowledged extensive adverse media coverage alleging bribery and corruption involving senior Angolan officials, including then-President José Eduardo dos Santos and his children, as well as Sonangol, Cochan and Nascimento. Still, ICBC characterized much of the adverse reporting as “rumour based and unfounded” and continued the relationship, subject to enhanced monitoring. In February 2020, ICBC’s EDD report again identified allegations centered on Nascimento’s close ties to former President dos Santos and speculation in media reports and elsewhere that he had used political connections to acquire a stake in Puma Energy while serving as a public official. The report also noted that Nascimento had faced investigations into alleged corruption, conflicts of interest and money laundering in several countries. Yet ICBC cited reasons for discounting the risks, noting that Nascimento did “not appear to have been convicted” of wrongdoing. In December 2021, the U.S. Treasury sanctioned Nascimento and Cochan, saying Nascimento and another Angolan official had embezzled billions from the Angolan government. In 2025, an Angolan court convicted Nascimento of fraud, document forgery, money laundering and influence peddling. Likewise, ICBC's October 2019 Enhanced Due Diligence report came after a highly public Brazilian corruption investigation into allegations that commodity traders, including Trafigura, had bribed employees of Petrobras, Brazil’s state-owned and state-controlled oil company. A month earlier, Reuters reported allegations that senior Trafigura executives Mike Wainwright and José Larocca knew about the bribes. But ICBC's EDD report referred only to "two high-ranking executives” at Trafigura, without identifying them, despite separately listing both men as key controllers of Trafigura. Wainwright's adverse-media assessment was marked "No." ICBC continued the relationship, citing Trafigura's status as a longstanding "strategic client," the participation of major international banks in syndicated loans, its compliance controls and the absence of suspicious activity detected by ICBC. In 2024, Trafigura Beheer B.V., the Dutch-registered former parent company of the Trafigura Group, pleaded guilty in the U.S. to conspiring to violate U.S. anti-bribery laws in a scheme that ran from approximately 2003 to 2014. The companies also reached a settlement agreement with Brazilian authorities. Read responses Responses Trafigura: In response to ICIJ's questions, a Trafigura spokesperson said lender due diligence was a normal part of doing business and that the company cooperated with lenders' reviews, supported by its public financial and sustainability disclosures. Regarding the Petrobras bribery case, the spokesperson referred to Trafigura's 2024 statement announcing the resolution of the U.S. investigation, in which the company said the misconduct involved former employees or agents and was inconsistent with its principles and code of conduct. The statement said U.S. authorities had recognized improvements to Trafigura's anti-corruption compliance procedures. Puma: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Nascimento: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Angolan government: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Cochan: ICIJ could not successfully contact Cochan for comment. Sonangol: Didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. A legal representative for Mike Wainwright didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. José Larocca: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. ICBC: Didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Main borrowers Puma International Financing S.A., Trafigura Group Pte. Ltd., Trafigura Pte. Ltd., Trafigura Trading LLC Amount $1.4 billionTotal loan commitments Start dates of loans 2015-2024 From the China Capital files PUMA In their own words: There is a wealth of adverse news in the public domain citing the Angolan Government's bribery and corruption and monopolisation of various industries in Angola.Risk From the China Capital files TRAFIGURA In their own words: The risks of money laundering, sanctions and bribery and corruption are heightened [...] and thus this poses an increased reputational risk to the Bank.Risk Trafigura is an existing and strategic client of the Bank.Mitigating factors Financing Kleptocrats 02 ICBC started lending to Socar, Azerbaijan’s state oil and gas concern, in 2015 when ICBC London took part in a revolving credit facility to one of the company’s subsidiaries, Socar Trading SA. Even though the bank decided to exit this facility in 2019 because of the company's “underperformance and ongoing restructuring," a review of ICBC documents shows that under the head office’s encouragement, ICBC’s London and Turkey offices maintained close connection with Socar. Bank officers in an internal memo noted “Azerbaijan's geopolitical importance in the area's political and economic landscape, and its longstanding partnership with super oil majors,” adding “SOCAR is a strategically important client for ICBC in view of supporting China's 2013 One-Belt One-Road policy." ICBC London committed to at least three additional loans, each between $25 million and $89 million, even as the bank continued to list Socar among high-risk clients, with one document stating: “the risks of money laundering, sanctions and bribery and corruption are heightened." Corporate bank officers underlined the risks presented by the nature of Socar’s business and its jurisdiction, Azerbaijan; the fact that all the members of its board of directors were, at the time, identified as politically exposed persons, including the president and 12 vice presidents; Socar’s lack of transparency and accountability; and that the company had recently featured in major international corruption scandals. Yet the same year that ICBC listed these risks, 2021, the bank agreed to lend Socar $89 million. ICBC and Socar had deepened their ties in 2018, when the bank’s London branch listed $1.58 billion worth of green bonds on the London Stock Exchange, and Azerbaijan's State Oil Fund, SOFAZ, decided to invest $150 million. Socar, which sells oil and gas on the state’s behalf, contributed about 90% of SOFAZ’s 2017 revenue. The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project later reported that leaked documents from inside British Petroleum exposed that two Socar subsidiaries were set to siphon off more than $1.7 billion from the Shah Deniz 2 gas project through padded contracts and fake charges. Socar denied the allegations. Read response Response Socar: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. SOFAZ: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. ICBC: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Main borrower Socar and its subsidiaries Amount $217 million (4 loans)Total loan commitments Start dates of loans 2015-2021 From the China Capital files In their own words: Given Azerbaijan’s geopolitical importance in the area’s political and economic landscape, and its longstanding partnership with super oil majors, SOCAR is a strategically important client for ICBC in view of supporting China’s 2013 One-Belt One-Road policy aimed at creating infrastructure and establishing links among the Eurasian countries.Risk Consolidating Market Share 03 ICBC records show bank risk management officials looking past the potentially illegal actions of a Chinese customer seeking a loan to buy out one of its competitors. In 2017 ICBC London Branch agreed to back China’s Hytera Communications Corp. Ltd.’s acquisition of Sepura PLC, a British telecommunications competitor in the mobile radio communications sector. Hytera designs and manufactures professional mobile communications devices commonly used by law enforcement agencies worldwide — including two-way radios, a market that at the time was expected to be worth $7.3 billion by 2025. The agreement with ICBC London, which was the only lender involved, allowed Hytera to borrow up to $57.1 million over three years. Sepura shareholders had approved the $92.7 million acquisition in January 2017 but antitrust authorities in the UK and Germany, where governments relied on Sepura’s technology, stalled the acquisition. Spanish antitrust authorities also assessed the transaction, which was eventually approved in May of that year. While conducting their due diligence work to approve the loan in early 2017, ICBC London employees discovered that Motorola Solutions Inc., another competitor in the mobile telecommunications market, had filed a lawsuit pending against Hytera in a U.S. federal court for alleged patent infringement and industrial espionage. The bank’s compliance officers allowed the loan to go forward anyway, adding a handwritten note on a printout of an article about the suit that the case wasn’t related to any major financial crime. The article mentioned, however, that Motorola accused Hytera of hiring ex-Motorola employees after they had allegedly stolen thousands of pages of confidential documents. By early 2020, while Hytera was repaying the loan ICBC employees flagged a problem — Hytera had lost its U.S. case. In a briefing note to the bank’s credit committee at the end of April, they wrote that the verdict “confirms that Hytera engaged in illegal trade secret theft and copyright infringement, validating Motorola's global litigation against Hytera.” Following the U.S. court verdict ICBC London received an injunction from a British court ordering the bank to freeze Hytera assets, potentially stopping the repayment of the loan. Seven Hytera employees were later indicted for their alleged roles in the thefts from Motorola; one pleaded guilty in 2022 to charges of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and is awaiting sentencing. Hytera pleaded guilty in 2025 to “conspiracy to steal trade secrets” and was fined $50 million. Hytera was also ordered to pay Motorola more than $400 million in a separate lawsuit. In 2021, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission published a list of Chinese manufacturers, including Hytera, which “pose an unacceptable risk to the national security of the United States.” The same year, the British government passed the National Security and Investment Act which gave heightened power to the government to proactively review acquisitions in 17 sensitive sectors, including communications. Hytera sold its entire shareholding in Sepura in July 2022. Read responses Responses Hytera: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. In an email to ICIJ, Sepura said that "neither Sepura PLC nor its shareholders or management at the time were involved in Hytera’s choice of funding for its acquisition of Sepura” and that the company “had no customer relationship with ICBC and held no accounts with the bank” following the acquisition. It also said that it was not “a party to the litigation brought by Motorola against Hytera concerning Motorola’s intellectual property” and that “the technology at issue was distinct from that developed and used by Sepura in its own products”. “Sepura's proprietary technology and IPR were ring-fenced by statutory undertakings, as mandated and defined by the UK government and accepted by Hytera.” Sepura said it “has had no further interaction with Hytera since the sale” in 2022. ICBC:didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Borrower Project Shortway Ltd. (ultimately owned by Hytera Communications Corp. Ltd.) Amount up to $57.1 millionTotal loan commitments Start date of loans May 2017 From the China Capital files In their own words Handwritten note on an article: Not major financial crime issues relatedRisk Buying your backyard 04 ICBC participated in syndicated loans — financing provided by a group of lenders who share the risk — for a Chinese commercial real estate venture that went bust and defaulted on its loans, according to internal loan agreements and property assessments reviewed by ICIJ. In 2017, Chinese real estate tycoon Chen Hongtian and his wife bought two office towers in London’s trendy Canary Wharf commercial district, hoping to convert their $900 million investment into a profitable venture. ICBC London described the area as “one of the world’s premier commercial districts,” with “24 office buildings with around 200 shops, bars, and restaurants” according to a 2022 assessment of 5 Churchill Place’s value by the real estate company managing the asset. The real estate firm’s assessment came as the bank and other creditors looked to liquidate the assets of the embattled tycoon who had found himself short on cash and unable to make payments. By then, ICBC London Branch had committed $205 million out of roughly half a billion in loans made with other banks to Chen’s companies in the British Virgin Islands, through which he and his family owned the London properties. One of those properties, at 20 Canada Square, was mainly occupied by two Western firms, according to a 2022 ICBC internal credit report. But the properties couldn’t compete with more modern and energy-efficient real estate, and their value plummeted. By April 2023 ICBC London had reclassified the loan to Cheung Pang Holdings Ltd., a BVI company through which Chen owned some units of the Canada Square property, as “non performing” and added the borrower to its watchlist. Around the same time that ICBC was reviewing the properties, the UK government passed the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act which required overseas entities that hold property in England and Wales to file beneficial ownership information with the company registry. A report published in 2017 by the U.S. Government Accountability Office warned that leasing space in foreign-owned buildings "could present security risks such as espionage and unauthorized cyber and physical access.” The UK’s National Security and Investment Act took effect in January 2022, but real estate was not among the sensitive sectors subject to its mandatory screening requirements for acquisitions. Read responses Responses Chen Hongtian/Cheung Kei group: The Cheung Kei group didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. In statement posted on its website in 2023 the group said that “like all heavy asset holders”, it was “experiencing a phase of cash problems” and that its “overall asset scale and asset quality” were “very high, with a low debt ratio among peers.” At the time the group was “selling some equity in some assets and actively negotiating repayment arrangements with relevant financial institutions” and said it “believed that subsequent financial institution issues will be properly resolved.” ICBC London: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Main borrowers Jovial Link Holdings Ltd. for 5 Churchill Place; Cheung Pang Holdings Ltd., Cheung Kwan Holdings Ltd. for 20 Canada Square (London properties) Start dates of loans 2022 Amount $61.7M / $143.5MTotal loan commitments From the China Capital files In their own words: About 5 Churchill Place, from a credit loan application: The deal as outlined herein offers ICBC London an ideal opportunity to assist an incoming Chinese client in the purchase of a major “trophy” asset that is both well let to tenants of significant covenant strengths and well located within the popular Canary Wharf developmentRisk Trapping In Debt 05 ICBC records on Zambia show a lender watching a borrower facing growing financial risks, while quietly putting protections in place for its own loans. ICBC financed a range of major projects in the country, providing loans for government-owned housing, a hospital, an airport and power projects running to hundreds of millions of dollars. Among them was a $285 million loan approved in 2010 to ZESCO, Zambia's state-owned power company, for two power transmission projects. Between 2015 and 2018, ICBC provided or participated in at least six more loans to ZESCO, totaling $1.2 billion according to AidData estimates, even as the bank was aware of mounting financial pressures on both Zambia and ZESCO. By 2017, a sovereign risk assessment in the bank's files described Zambia as facing limited financing options, rising interest costs, and substantial debt—and specifically pointed to financial pressures on ZESCO. Government net debt had climbed from 23% of GDP in 2013 to an estimated 57% in 2017, while debt costs consumed nearly a quarter of government revenue. ICBC had classified ZESCO as a high-risk client since 2018, citing Zambia's country risk, politically exposed persons and historical adverse media coverage including bribery and corruption allegations, according to a 2023 internal report. Despite these concerns, the bank continued its lending relationship with ZESCO, requiring annual reviews. ICBC built protections into its lending. ZESCO maintained a debt-service reserve account at ICBC London for repayments on the $285 million loan. Money deposited into the account could only be withdrawn by ICBC's head office, which was also the lender, agent and security trustee. ZESCO’s financial precarity triggered a cascade of credit problems. By March 2020, its failure to pay Maamba Collieries Ltd., a Zambian power supplier, had left Maamba unable to meet its own loan obligations to ICBC and other lenders. ICBC records show that lenders sent letters to Zambia's Ministry of Finance seeking government support, contacted Chinese state-owned insurer Sinosure and discussed restructuring the loan. ICBC officials warned that Maamba's loan would be classified as non-performing if payments remained overdue for more than 90 days. The documents offer a window into how the bank continued banking a financially strained borrower while using safeguards to limit its own losses. Read responses Responses ZESCO: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Zambian MOF: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. ICBC: didn’t respond to ICIJ’s request for comment. Main borrower ZESCO Amount $285 millionTotal loan commitments Start date of loans May 2011 From the China Capital files In their own words: The lenders have jointly sent two letters to Ministry of Finance (MOF), emphasizing the continuing non-payment by the ZESCO which may lead to Borrower’s default on the repayment of principal and interest, to seek support from MOF to solve this issue…Risk Contributors: Micael Pereira (Expresso); Scilla Alecci, Miguel Fiandor-Gutiérrez, Micah Reddy, Dean Starkman, Antonio Cucho Gamboa (ICIJ)

title: Hong Kong Telecom to end 3G service on 25 February 2028
zh_title: 香港电讯将于2028年2月25日终止3G服务
summary: 香港电讯将于2028年2月25日终止3G服务 |中国劳工布告栏 星期三, 25 11 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港电讯将于 2028 年 2 月 25 日终止 3G 服务 香港电讯宣布将于 2028 年 2 月 25 日终止其 3G 服务，将频谱重新分配给 5G，以满足人工智能和数字服务驱动的不断增长的需求。截至 2026 年 9 月，只有 0.37% 的移动客户仍在使用 3G。自 20 月底香港电讯于 2026 年 11 月 25 日宣布将终止其 3G 服务以来，该公司一直在通知受影响的用户。
content:
香港电讯将于2028年2月25日终止3G服务 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 25 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港电讯将于2028年2月25日终止3G服务
香港电讯宣布将于2028年2月25日终止其3G服务，并将频谱重新分配给5G，以满足人工智能和数字服务驱动的不断增长的需求。截至 2026 年 9 月，只有 0.37% 的移动客户仍在使用 3G。该公司自 20 月底以来一直在通知受影响的用户
香港电讯于2026年11月25日宣布将于2028年2月25日终止其3G服务，以优化频谱分配并满足对更先进移动服务日益增长的需求。目前用于3G网络的频谱将重新分配给5G网络，以增强网络的稳定性和流畅性。
该公司表示，随着人工智能（AI）应用的日益普及以及各种数字服务和技术的快速发展，当地消费者对5G移动通信网络和服务的需求也日益增长。
2026年上半年，香港电讯5G客户数量达220万户，同比增长16%，后付费客户渗透率达62%。与此同时，使用3G服务的客户数量持续下降，截至2026年9月仅占移动通信客户总数的0.37%。
该公司表示，现有3G服务将继续正常运营直至全面终止，并自2025年第四季度起，逐步通过短信通知受影响的客户升级其3G SIM卡、手机或设备，以确保顺利过渡到下一代移动服务。该公司将继续协助受影响的客户升级其3G手机、装置或SIM卡，并会为不打算升级的客户提供合适的安排。

Hong Kong Telecom to end 3G service on 25 February 2028 | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 25 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Telecom to end 3G service on 25 February 2028
Hong Kong Telecom announced it will terminate its 3G service on 25 February 2028, reallocating spectrum to 5G to meet rising demand driven by AI and digital services. Only 0.37 per cent of mobile customers still use 3G as of September 2026. The company has been notifying affected users since late 20
Hong Kong Telecom announced on 25 November 2026 that it will terminate its 3G service on 25 February 2028, in a move to optimise spectrum allocation and meet growing demand for more advanced mobile services. The spectrum currently used for the 3G network will be reallocated to the 5G network to enhance network stability and smoothness.
The company said that with the increasing popularity of artificial intelligence (AI) applications and the rapid development of various digital services and technologies, local consumers' demand for 5G mobile communication networks and services is also growing day by day.
Hong Kong Telecom's 5G customer numbers reached 2.2 million in the first half of 2026, up 16 per cent year-on-year, with penetration reaching 62 per cent of post-paid customers. Meanwhile, the number of customers using 3G services has continued to decline, accounting for only 0.37 per cent of total mobile communication customers as of the end of September 2026.
The company said that existing 3G services will continue to operate normally until the full termination, and that since the fourth quarter of 2025, it has been gradually notifying affected customers via SMS to upgrade their 3G SIM cards, mobile phones or devices to ensure a smooth transition to next-generation mobile services. It will continue to help affected customers upgrade their 3G handsets, devices or SIM cards, and will provide suitable arrangements for those who do not plan to upgrade.

title: Community-Focused Academic Brings AI Tools to Colorado Farmers
zh_title: 以社区为中心的学术界为科罗拉多州农民带来人工智能工具
