title: In Taiwan, investors ‘really happy’ at Jensen Huang’s return
zh_title: 在台湾，投资者对黄仁勋的回归“非常高兴”
summary: 周二，台湾投资者欣喜若狂，因为黄仁勋在突然退出导致股价暴跌不到两周后重返英伟达，台湾以科技股为主的股市飙升逾 9%。台北 101 大楼上的一条信息写着：“台湾爱 Jensen。”照片：@VVTing2026，来自 X. 黄出生于台湾，在访问期间像摇滚明星一样受到欢迎，为这个处于全球人工智能热潮中心的岛屿创造了巨额财富。今年岛上的投资者纷纷涌入股市，其中越来越多的人借钱购买繁荣的股票
content:
周二，台湾投资者欣喜若狂，因为黄仁勋在突然退出导致股价暴跌不到两周后重返英伟达，台湾以科技股为主的股市飙升逾 9%。台北 101 大楼上的一条信息写着：“台湾爱 Jensen。”照片：@VVTing2026，来自 X. 黄出生于台湾，在访问期间像摇滚明星一样受到欢迎，为这个处于全球人工智能热潮中心的岛屿创造了巨额财富。今年，随着基准指数创下历史新高，岛上的投资者纷纷涌入股市，越来越多的人借钱购买蓬勃发展的科技行业的股票。尽管许多人对黄与一名美国官员怀疑为中国情报机构工作的女性的恋情持悲观态度，但他们更担心的是丑闻对其投资的影响。 “看到他回来让我真的很高兴，”33 岁的教育行业工作人员安迪·陈 (Andy Chen) 说。 “网上大家都在开玩笑，‘黄爸爸事件’给了很多人抄底的机会。” Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 5 月 19 日在台湾台北举行的 Computex 2025 上发表主题演讲。照片：Nvidia。台交所上周暴跌 17.5%，促使政府出手干预稳定市场。但周二，在芯片巨头台积电和联发科股价上涨 10% 的推动下，该指数飙升逾 9%。
英伟达在纽约的股价飙升了 31.5%，使该公司的市值增加了超过 9000 亿美元。“前天和前几天，每个人都非常痛苦，因为我们的净资产缩水了，”30 岁的财务经理 Jennifer Lin 告诉法新社。林说，黄回到英伟达“是一个非常好的决定”。 “我的股票回来了，我的股票市值也恢复了……心情真好。”尽管英伟达的回归似乎稳定了这家芯片巨头以及更广泛的股市和人工智能生态系统，但到底发生了什么仍然存在疑问。有人猜测黄的外遇和突然离开公司是一个阴谋的一部分。 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 出席在华盛顿特区安德鲁·W·梅隆礼堂举行的白宫人工智能峰会。 2025 年 7 月 23 日。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。 36 岁的制药公司员工雪莉·施 (Sherry Shih) 告诉法新社：“一个企业家的私生活会对全球经济产生如此巨大的影响，我感到非常惊讶。” “整个事情发展得如此之快，让你觉得幕后有什么事情吗？”林更加强调：“我认为有人陷害了他。”陈说，英伟达最近的惊人业绩让这家科技巨头的董事会“别无选择，只能要求他回来”。 “当然，他的私人道德行为很糟糕，”陈承认。 “但生意归生意，个人归个人。
他的个人行为并不能抹杀他对公司运营、对世界、对台湾的贡献。”

【原文 English Original】
Taiwanese investors rejoiced on Tuesday as the island’s tech-heavy stock market soared more than nine percent following Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia less than two weeks after his abrupt exit sent shares plummeting. A message on Taipei 101 reads, “Taiwan loves Jensen.” Photo: @VVTing2026, via X. Huang, who was born in Taiwan and feted like a rock star during his visits, has generated huge amounts of wealth for the island at the centre of the global AI boom. Investors on the island have piled into the stock market this year, a growing number of them borrowing money to buy shares in the booming tech sector, as the benchmark index hit record highs. Though many took a dim view of Huang’s affair with a woman US officials suspect was working for Chinese intelligence, their greater concern was the scandal’s impact on their investments. “Seeing him come back makes me really happy,” said Andy Chen, 33, who works in the education industry. “Everyone online is joking that the ‘Papa Huang incident’ gave a lot of people a chance to bottom‑fish and buy in.” Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang gives a keynote speech at Computex 2025 in Taipei, Taiwan, on May 19, 2025. Photo: Nvidia. The Taiex plunged 17.5 percent last week, prompting the government to intervene to stabilise the market. But it soared more than nine percent Tuesday, boosted by gains of 10 percent in chip giants TSMC and MediaTek. Nvidia rocketed an eye-watering 31.5 percent in New York, adding more than US$900 billion to the firm’s market value. “Everyone was really miserable the day before yesterday and the previous few days, because our net worth shrank,” Jennifer Lin, a 30-year-old finance manager, told AFP. Huang’s return to Nvidia “is a very good decision”, Lin said. “My stock has come back, the market value of my shares has recovered too… I’m in a really good mood.” While the return to Nvidia appears to have stabilised the chip giant and the broader stock market and AI ecosystem, there are still questions over what really happened. Some people speculated that Huang’s affair and sudden departure from the company had been part of a conspiracy. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at the White House AI Summit at Andrew W. Mellon Auditorium in Washington, DC. on July 23, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. “I feel it’s quite surprising that the private life of a single entrepreneur could have such a huge impact on the global economy,” Sherry Shih, 36, a pharmaceutical company employee told AFP. “The way the whole thing has developed so quickly just makes you think is there something going on behind the scenes?” Lin was more emphatic: “I think someone set him up.” Nvidia’s recent blockbuster results had given the tech giant’s board “no choice but to ask him to come back”, Chen said. “Of course, his private moral conduct is bad,” Chen conceded. “But business is business, personal is personal. His personal behaviour doesn’t erase his contributions to the company’s operations, to the world, and to Taiwan.”

title: In Pictures: Time-honoured Hong Kong saucemaker to close, ceding land to Northern Metropolis megaproject
zh_title: 图片：香港历史悠久的酱料制造商将关闭，将土地割让给北都大型项目
summary: 在被称为“鹅颈桥”的铜锣湾立交桥一侧，在“坏人打人”的节奏喧嚣声中，顾客们涌入当地一家调味品制造商的商店，该商店位于北部乡村的工厂被清理干净，其所在的土地现已割让给一个庞大的开发项目。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。购物车里装满了老抽、黑醋和甜豆酱，所有这些都自豪地被吹捧为本地制造，而工人们则将啤酒厂剩余的库存从后面运进啤酒厂。
content:
在被称为“鹅颈桥”的铜锣湾立交桥一侧，在“坏人打人”的节奏喧嚣声中，顾客们涌入当地一家调味品制造商的商店，该商店位于北部乡村的工厂被清理干净，其所在的土地现已割让给一个庞大的开发项目。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。购物车里装满了老抽、黑醋和甜酱油，所有这些都被自豪地标榜为本地制造，而工人们则从后面将啤酒厂剩余的库存推入车内，顾客与白发苍苍的店主亲切地交谈着。继位于香港新界北部的桂利酱和果脯厂址被驱逐和清理后，这家拥有 90 年历史的酱料制造商正在倒计时，直到出售剩余库存并永远关闭铜锣湾店面。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该公司现已关闭的工厂位于古洞，这是新界的一个农村地区，是北方都市大型项目下开发的地区，该项目旨在实现香港乡村边疆的现代化，并加深与中国大陆的融合。 1936 年开业的工厂关闭，结束了这家酱料制造商的“香港制造”传统。
乔安妮·陈 (Joanne Chan) 是一位忠实顾客，她在商店关门前来到这家商店储备酱汁，对她来说，啤酒厂的倒闭象征着开发项目的损失，从村民的流离失所到对新科技中心需求的怀疑。2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “这些传统品牌已经经营了几十年，但政府没有计划让他们继续经营。相反，他们被迫关闭，”她说。该工厂在上个月的驱逐行动后现已被封锁，位于古洞北新发展区，占地 447 公顷，将为公共和私人住宅开发、商业设施和新地铁站让路。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这家酱料制造商的工厂距离香港和邻近的中国城市深圳之间最近的边境管制站仅 15 分钟车程。整个北都城项目旨在拉近香港与内地的距离，将约 300 平方公里（约占该市土地的三分之一）转变为创新科技中心。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
陈氏家族九十年的经营经历跨越了三代人，他们于 1940 年代在九龙城开设了第一家酿酒厂，当时是当地酿酒商的中心。 1960 年代的城市重建迫使李氏和其他调味品制造商进入新界，该酿酒厂一直留在新界，直到上个月被驱逐。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。事实证明，农村环境对调味品制造商来说是一个福音，因为大片土地使他们能够继续使用传统的露天方法在阳光下发酵和氧化大豆。但大部分酱厂从香港市中心迁往北部腹地

【原文 English Original】
Off to the side of the Causeway Bay flyover known as Goose Neck Bridge, over the polyrhythmic din of “villain hitting,” customers crowded into a local condiment maker’s shop after its factory in the rural north was cleared, the land it stood on now ceded to a gargantuan development project. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Shopping trolleys were filled with dark soy sauce, black vinegar, and sweet soybean paste, all proudly touted as locally made, while workers carted in what remained of the brewer’s stock through the back and customers exchanged friendly words with grey-haired shopkeepers. Following the eviction and clearance of Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s factory site in Hong Kong’s northern New Territories, the 90-year-old saucemaker is counting down the days until it sells off its remaining inventory and closes its Causeway Bay storefront for good. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Its now-shuttered factory was in Kwu Tung, a rural area in the New Territories tapped for development under the Northern Metropolis megaproject, which aims to modernise Hong Kong’s rustic frontier and deepen its integration with mainland China. The closure of the factory, opened in 1936, brings the saucemaker’s “Made in Hong Kong” legacy to an end. For Joanne Chan, a loyal customer who came by the shop to stock up on sauces ahead of its closure, the brewer’s end is emblematic of the development project’s toll, from the displacement of villagers to doubts over the demand for a new tech hub. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “These traditional brands have operated for decades, but the government has no plan to let them keep going. Instead, they’re being forced to close,” she said. The factory, now sealed off after an eviction operation last month, falls within the Kwu Tung North New Development Area, which spans 447 hectares and will make way for both public and private residential developments, as well as commercial facilities and a new MTR station. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The saucemaker’s factory was just a 15-minute drive from the closest border control point between Hong Kong and the neighbouring Chinese city of Shenzhen. The entire Northern Metropolis project is meant to draw Hong Kong closer to the mainland, transforming about 300 square kilometres — roughly a third of the city’s land — into an innovation and technology hub. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Kui Lee’s nine decades in business have spanned three generations of the Chan family, who opened their first brewing yard in the 1940s in Kowloon City, then a hub for local brewers. Urban redevelopment in the 1960s forced Kui Lee, along with other condiment makers, into the New Territories, where the brewer remained until last month’s eviction. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The rural surroundings proved to be a boon for condiment makers, as the large swathes of land allowed them to keep using traditional open-air methods to ferment and oxidise soybeans under sunlight. But most of the sauce factories that moved from Hong Kong’s urban core to its northern hinterland in the mid-20th century are now facing eviction for the Northern Metropolis. One saucemaker, Koon Chun, is fortunate enough to continue operating after the megaproject clears out its current site. Moving to its new facility, however, will take about a decade. Yuet Wo Soy Sauce, Kui Lee’s neighbour in Kwu Tung, is looking for a new site in a Tsuen Wan industrial building to stay in business. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Rural villages, sawmills, and carp farms are also on their way out — with some already evicted — as deadlines loom for the Northern Metropolis project. With the October clearance operation, the family also moved out of their homes on the Kwu Tung site, according to a South China Morning Post report, which noted that power was cut off and water pipes were severed two days ahead of the clearance deadline. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Joanne Chan spoke of her own experience of being evicted from a village house in Tuen Mun some two decades ago to make way for a railway line. “I understand the pain that land resumption and eviction causes; I’m strongly opposed to it,” she said. “You could grow your own fruit trees in your own yard, but after the eviction, all you get is a few hundred square feet,” she said, referring to government resettlement policies. “Those university towns and tech parks aren’t what we need as ordinary citizens.” Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Go ahead, ask her,” she said, pointing to another middle-aged customer browsing the store’s wares. “Do you think she wants [artificial intelligence]?” Other customers also lamented the store’s impending closure, including a new mother buying ingredients for pork knuckle and ginger stew, a traditional postpartum dish made with sweetened black vinegar. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “I don’t know where I’m going to find soy sauce when they close, especially dark soy sauce,” said another customer, Tsang, who works nearby. The condiment – darker and less salty than its counterparts and mainly used to give dishes a deeper colour – is among Kui Lee’s most well-known products. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Shops like these are getting harder to come by these days. Once one of them closes, there won’t be another to take its place. Of course, it’s a pity, but in this day and age, there’s nothing that can be done,” she said.

title: Compact and Covert
zh_title: 紧凑、隐蔽
summary: 法国土伦——法国海军的潜艇码头位于巴黎最大海军基地的有顶干船坞内和厚厚的混凝土墙后面。这个戒备森严的设施是核攻击潜艇中队最强大、最现代化的攻击艇的所在地，不被窥探。上个月，USNI News 参观了法国海军的一艘 Suffren 级核攻击潜艇 FS Duguay-Trouin (S636)，当时该潜艇正在进行维护。这艘核攻击潜艇于 2023 年服役，是海军 Suffren 级的第二艘，将成为法国海军的支柱。
content:
法国土伦——法国海军的潜艇码头位于巴黎最大海军基地的有顶干船坞内和厚厚的混凝土墙后面。这个戒备森严的设施是核攻击潜艇中队最强大、最现代化的攻击艇的所在地，不被窥探。上个月，USNI News 参观了法国海军的一艘 Suffren 级核攻击潜艇 FS Duguay-Trouin (S636)，当时该潜艇正在进行维护。这艘核攻击潜艇于 2023 年服役，是法国海军 Suffren 级的第二艘核潜艇，将成为未来几十年法国水下战争的支柱。 “对我们来说，冷战从未真正结束，”一位退役的法国海军潜艇指挥官在参观期间谈到他从 20 世纪 90 年代到 2010 年代的服役时光时说道。法国与北大西洋公约组织伙伴英国、德国和美国一起，一直在与俄罗斯海军进行水下对峙。从北大西洋的GIUK海峡到地中海沿岸，法国潜艇在日益恶化的安全局势中坚守岗位。随着俄罗斯对欧洲的威胁重新抬头，以及对法国在印度太平洋地区领土的新担忧，巴黎的攻击艇比以往任何时候都更加重要。这艘重 4,765 吨的潜艇停泊在有顶棚的干船坞内，让人们得以一睹法国海军旨在解决的能力和任务。
与现代中国、俄罗斯和美国的核攻击艇相比，紧凑型“苏弗伦”号的船员数量约为一半，排水量也显着减轻。紧凑型船员总数为 70 人，其中包括 15 名军官和 55 名士官，他们可以在鱼雷室后面的食堂享用面包店的新鲜法棍面包和配给的葡萄酒。 Duguay-Trouin 号的高度自动化特性可以从其武器舱中看出，攻击艇的执行官声称武器舱可由两名男子操作。与上一代红宝石级潜艇相比，萨弗伦级潜艇现在可以发射远程巡航导弹打击，承载专门的特种部队行动，并支持欧洲战区以外的扩展部署。从捍卫威慑到新的常规任务 2026 年 10 月 7 日，一艘拥有 38 年船龄的 FS Améthyste (S605) 核攻击艇在倾盆大雨中驶入土伦海军基地。USNI 新闻照片 灰色的阴天被土伦湾的倾盆大雨所取代。雨中出现了一艘潜艇的轮廓，指挥塔上挤满了模糊的人影。小船护送缓慢移动的 FS Améthyste (S605) 进入海湾。这艘冷战时期的攻击艇是法国红宝石级的最后一艘，也是法国海军服役的苏弗伦级之前的第一艘核攻击潜艇。与 Duguay-Trouin 相比，Améthyste 的排水量仅为 2,400 吨，并且是为不同时代而设计的。
与当时的西方和东方同类潜艇相比，红宝石级潜艇在武器装备和排水量上都明显较轻。这种设计理念反映了法国海军最初涉足核攻击艇及其在北大西洋和地中海的作战重点区域。冷战期间，法国海军的前线潜艇部队依赖于十几艘达芙妮级和阿戈斯塔级柴电推进攻击艇。 2026 年 10 月 6 日，SNLE Le Vigilant 首次发射 51.3 导弹。DGA 照片 核心任务之一

【原文 English Original】
TOULON, France — The French Navy’s submarine quay resides within covered dry docks and behind thick concrete walls at Paris’ largest naval base. Concealed from prying eyes, this closely guarded facility is home to the Squadron of Nuclear Attack Submarines’ most capable and modern attack boats. Last month, USNI News visited one of the French Navy’s Suffren-class nuclear attack submarines, FS Duguay-Trouin (S636), while the boat was undergoing maintenance. Commissioned in 2023, the nuclear attack submarine is the second of the sea service’s Suffren class and will form the backbone of French undersea warfare in the coming decades. “For us, the Cold War never really ended,” a retired French Navy submarine commander remarked during the tour about his time serving from the 1990s to 2010s. France, alongside North Atlantic Treaty Organization partners Britain, Germany and the U.S., has been engaged in a constant underwater standoff against the Russian Navy. From the North Atlantic waters of GIUK gap to the littorals of the Mediterranean, French submarines have stood guard amid an increasingly deteriorating security situation. With the resurgence of Russian threats to Europe and new concerns regarding French possessions in the Indo-Pacific, Paris’ attack boats are more relevant than ever. Resting within a covered dry dock, the 4,765-ton submarine provided a glimpse at the capabilities and missions that the French Navy aims to address. Compared to modern Chinese, Russian and American nuclear attack boats, the compact Suffren’s have roughly half the crew and displace considerably less weight. The compact crew complement of 70 personnel, divided between 15 officers and 55 petty officers, can enjoy their fresh baguettes from the bakery and wine ration at the mess behind the torpedo room. Duguay-Trouin’s highly automated nature can be seen within its weapons bay, which the attack boat’s executive officer claimed can be operated by two men. Compared to the previous generation of Rubis-class boats, the Suffren class can now launch long-range cruise missile strikes, host dedicated special forces operations and support extended-deployments beyond the European theater. From Defending the Deterrent to New Conventional Missions The 38-year-old FS Améthyste (S605) nuclear attack boat pulls into Toulon Naval Base under a torrential downpour on Oct. 7, 2026. USNI News photo A gray overcast sky gave way to a torrential downpour across Toulon Bay. A submarine silhouette emerged from the rain with hazy figures crowding the conning tower. Small boats escorted the slow moving FS Améthyste (S605) into the bay. The Cold War-era attack boat is the last of France’s Rubis-class, which was also the first class of nuclear attack submarines in French Navy service before the Suffren class. In contrast to Duguay-Trouin , Améthyste displaced only 2,400-tons and was created for a different era. Compared to its Western and Eastern counterparts at the time, Rubis-class submarines were notably lighter in both armament and displacement. This design philosophy reflected the French Navy’s initial foray into nuclear attack boats and its operational focus areas in the North Atlantic and Mediterranean. During the Cold War, the French Navy’s frontline submarine force relied on more than a dozen diesel-electric propelled attack boats from the Daphné and Agosta classes. The first firing of a 51.3 missile from the SNLE Le Vigilant on Oct. 6, 2026. DGA photo One of the core missions for the Rubis, and now Suffren class, was the escort of the French sea-based nuclear deterrent. Today, the French Navy operates four Triomphant-class submarines, each equipped with 16 M51 submarine-launched ballistic missiles. Alongside air-launched supersonic missiles carried by French Air Force and Navy Rafale fighters, the submarines form the pillars of Paris’ nuclear deterrent. France previously operated a full nuclear triad, but decommissioned its ground-based silos in the 1990s. On the morning of USNI News’ tour of Duguay-Trouin , France held its first at-sea test of a SLBM from FS Le Vigilant (S618) in the Atlantic Ocean. A M51.3 missile soared over the Atlantic in an event presided over by President Emmanuel Macron on a nearby frigate. French defense, military and industry leadership repeatedly highlighted this capability as Europe’s “only sovereign deterrent.” Aside from defending the country’s SSBNs, the Suffren-class brings new capabilities for French undersea warfare. At the front of the attack boat within its highly automated weapons room, the Suffren-class can deploy France’s first-ever submarine-launched cruise missiles. The domestic Naval Cruise Missile program’s roots can be traced to Paris’ failed attempt to procure Tomahawk cruise missiles from the U.S. in the early 2000s. Since 2017, the domestic long-range cruise missiles have enabled French frigates and submarines to strike targets out to 1,000 to 1,400 kilometers. Duguay-Trouin launches the cruise missiles from its four 533mm torpedo tubes. While French Navy frigates debuted the Naval Cruise Missile in combat during a joint operation with the U.S. and U.K. in 2018 against Syrian chemical weapon facilities, a Suffren-class sub first fired the cruise missile in a 2020 test. The FREMM Aquitaine and an SSN simultaneously fired an MdCN missile, shared in April of 2024. French Navy photo The initial production run of the Naval Cruise Missile only assembled 200 munitions, of which only 50 could be fired from the Suffren-class boats. However, the French military announced a new order for the latest variant of the cruise missile earlier this month at Euronaval 2026. This procurement comes amid a new focus by the French military in long-range precision fires influenced by lessons in the Ukraine conflict. Beyond conventional deep strike potential, the submarines also bring a new deployment method for French Navy special forces and the service’s growing hybrid fleet concept. A complement of Commando Marines can deploy from the submarine while submerged via a dry deck shelter module that can be attached for certain missions. The Suffren-class boats can also support swimmer delivery vehicles for these clandestine operations. Within the command center, 10 multi-functional display consoles flank an elevated captain’s seat and central tactical planning table. Each of these displays can be configured for different roles, a capability that can be useful depending on the mission tasked to Duguay-Trouin . French government-controlled shipbuilder Naval Group hopes to use submarines from the Suffren class and their command and control capabilities to support drone mesh networks in a hybrid fleet concept. At a demonstration at a nearby Naval Group facility, the shipbuilder showcased the potential benefits of operating extra-large unmanned underwater vehicles and aerial drones from the same consoles seen aboard Duguay-Trouin . The French Navy has already experimented with the deployment of UUVs, including a Spring 2026 test that saw the launch and recovery of a U.S. Navy Razorback UUV. In contrast to the highly autonomous vision of unmanned systems integration by fleets aboard, France is taking a more conservative force enabler approach in its hybrid fleet concept. French defense and industry officials want their drones to extend the surveillance reach of their manned assets. During the demonstration, the concept helped a French submarine detect targets in the Red Sea to enable an enhanced picture for a commander.

中国正在加大自力更生力度，但国产芯片仍落后
新加坡/北京 — — 黄仁勋可能会重新执掌英伟达，但他的回归并没有给依赖美国先进芯片的中国人工智能公司带来什么喘息的机会。
分析人士表示，11 月 19 日生效的美国新规定使中国企业更难从海外数据中心租用计算能力，从而在短期内对中国人工智能发展造成重大挫折。
但这些限制措施可能会给中国多年来推动技术自力更生的努力增添新的紧迫性，将企业曾经视为后备计划的开发本土芯片和计算系统变成优先事项。
中国的人工智能行业知道，它不能再依赖黄仁勋来帮助确保获得英伟达的先进芯片。 11 月 23 日恢复担任首席执行官的黄仁勋曾是华盛顿最强烈主张继续向中国销售芯片的人之一。
新加坡南洋理工大学经济学名誉教授陈光炎表示：“对中国来说，最重要的教训是，它不能依赖个别美国企业领导人的善意，无论他们的商业影响力或与中国接触的意愿如何。”
总部位于华盛顿的咨询公司亚洲集团 (The Asia Group) 负责数字业务的合伙人乔治·陈 (George Chen) 指出，英伟达董事会已经成立了一个新委员会，负责监督国家安全风险和出口管制合规情况。
“英伟达肯定会在合规方面加倍努力，因为它不想再次被指责与中国过于亲密，”陈告诉海峡时报。
美国商务部工业与安全局11月16日宣布的新规定禁止美国境外的数据中心为具有强大计算能力的中国客户提供服务，除非获得美国政府许可。
由于远程访问占中国公司人工智能计算能力的近三分之一，科技巨头已经警告称，美国的限制可能会扰乱他们的计划。
腾讯表示，先进计算能力的减少可能会延长开发下一代混元人工智能模型所需的时间。腾讯总裁刘炽平在 11 月 18 日的财报电话会议上表示：“这让中国的每个人都感到沮丧。”
一天后，阿里巴巴首席执行官埃迪·吴表示，该公司可能会缩减其长期数据中心扩张目标。
这种不确定性也影响到了贷方。银行家已暂停一项拟议的 4.8 亿美元（6.18 亿新元）贷款，该贷款旨在支付马来西亚数据中心 Nvidia 芯片的费用，该数据中心将为 TikTok 的中国所有者字节跳动提供服务。

【原文 English Original】
China’s AI chip crunch deepens after US curbs | The Straits Times
Jensen Huang is back, but China’s AI chip crunch is far from over
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
China’s AI industry knows it can no longer lean on Jensen Huang to help secure access to Nvidia’s advanced chips.
Published Nov 25, 2026, 09:40 PM
Updated Nov 25, 2026, 09:40 PM
New US rules will curb Chinese access to advanced chips and overseas data centres, likely slowing AI model development
Chinese firms such as Tencent and Alibaba warn of delays and possible cuts to expansion plans
China is pushing harder for self-reliance, but homegrown chips still lag behind
SINGAPORE/BEIJING – Jensen Huang may be back at the helm of Nvidia, but his return offers little reprieve to Chinese artificial intelligence firms that rely on advanced US chips.
Analysts say new US rules, which took effect on Nov 19, deal a significant setback to China’s AI development in the near term by making it harder for Chinese firms to rent computing power from overseas data centres.
But the curbs are likely to add fresh urgency to China’s years-long push for technological self-reliance, turning what firms once saw as a back-up plan – developing home-grown chips and computing systems – into a priority.
China’s AI industry knows it can no longer lean on Huang to help secure access to Nvidia’s advanced chips. Huang, who was reinstated as chief executive on Nov 23, was once one of the most vocal advocates in Washington of continued chip sales to China.
“The most important lesson for China is that it cannot depend on the goodwill of individual American corporate leaders, regardless of their commercial influence or willingness to engage with China,” said Tan Kong Yam, an emeritus professor of economics at Singapore’s Nanyang Technological University.
George Chen, a partner who leads the digital practice at The Asia Group, a Washington-based consultancy, noted that Nvidia’s board has set up a new committee to oversee national security risks and compliance with export controls.
“Nvidia will surely double down on compliance, because it won’t want to be accused again of being too cosy with China,” Chen told The Straits Times.
The new rules announced by the US Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security on Nov 16 prohibit data centres outside the US from serving Chinese clients with significant computing power, unless licensed by the US government.
With remote access accounting for nearly a third of AI computing power for Chinese firms, tech giants have already warned that the US curbs could disrupt their plans.
Tencent said reduced access to advanced computing power could lengthen the time it takes to develop a future generation of its Hunyuan AI model. “It sets everyone back in China,” said Tencent president Martin Lau on a Nov 18 earnings call.
A day later, Alibaba chief executive Eddie Wu said the company could scale back its long-term data centre expansion target.
The uncertainty has reached lenders, too. Bankers had paused work on a proposed US$480 million (S$618 million) loan sought to pay for Nvidia chips at a Malaysian data centre that would serve ByteDance, the Chinese owner of TikTok.
Benjamin Ho, lead research strategist for Hong Kong and China equities at Maybank Investment Banking Group, notes how at least two of Nvidia’s server partners have suspended deliveries to customers in South-east Asia amid the new US curbs.
“I think model iteration and rollouts will slow down significantly, and you will probably see this become more severe in the coming months,” he told ST.
Since Washington began restricting exports of advanced Nvidia chips to China in 2022, Chinese tech firms have increasingly rented computing power from overseas data centres.
Even before the November restrictions, Chinese companies were scrambling to secure overseas computing capacity, Reuters reported on Nov 12.
Overseas data centres supply roughly 30 per cent of the AI computing power available to Chinese firms, estimates Sigrid Wang, lead technology analyst at Hutong Research, an independent Chinese advisory firm.
Before the Nov 16 curbs, the Washington-based Institute for Progress (IFP) think-tank projected that the computing power Chinese firms could tap through overseas data centres would nearly triple, from the equivalent of about one million Nvidia H100 chips at the end of 2026 to 2.8 million a year later.
Ho of Maybank expects a fierce fight to ensue among Chinese AI companies for scarce domestic computing resources, noting how top Chinese chipmaker SMIC is already operating at 98% capacity and buyers like DeepSeek are facing wait times of more than a year for the latest chips.
In such a battle, Ho said tech giants like Baidu, Tencent and Alibaba are best positioned thanks to early investments in domestic data centres and hardware. Pure AI start-ups like Moonshot AI and MiniMax, on the other hand, are the most vulnerable as they would need to rent computing capacity from their rivals.
In the AI race with the US, this is the one advantage China has
As US ups stakes on AI, can China win over the world with open-weight models?
Access to Nvidia chips inside China remains uncertain. Nvidia has confirmed it stopped shipping its H200 processors to China despite receiving some US export licences.
Beijing has also urged Chinese firms to use home-grown chips, and withheld approval for a shipment of about 600,000 H200s to enter from Hong Kong, according to a Nov 5 Reuters report.
“Were Nvidia to stop supplying China with its H20 and H200 chips altogether, Chinese chipmakers would have a huge gap to fill,” Wang said, adding that Nvidia accounted for 55 per cent of China’s AI chips market in 2025.
Chinese firms including Huawei, Baidu, Alibaba and Cambricon have made strides in designing AI processors. But China has limited capacity to manufacture them.
This manufacturing bottleneck could tighten further, said Guo Shan, a partner at Hutong, if the US Congress passes the MATCH Act. The bill seeks to press allies such as the Netherlands and Japan to tighten controls on sales to China of the equipment used to make advanced chips.
While Huawei has built clusters known as supernodes that connect many chips at high speed, allowing them to train and run large AI models together, they remain prohibitively costly.
Wang, the Hutong analyst, said Huawei’s Cloudmatrix 384 can rival Nvidia’s GB200 NVL72 system on some measures, but its eye-popping price of US$8 million puts it out of reach for smaller Chinese AI developers.
Jensen Huang is back, but it won’t be business as usual for Taiwan’s tech industry
US chip curbs put South-east Asia’s data centre ambitions to the test
There is also a trade-off. Linking more processors can help close the performance gap, but it strains China’s already limited supply of home-grown chips.
A scholar who advises the Chinese government on AI policy acknowledged that his country’s chips and computing systems still lagged behind America’s, but remained optimistic about China’s long-term potential.
He spoke with ST on condition of anonymity because he was not authorised to speak to the media.
“Instead of bemoaning how the US curbs will handicap us, we would rather see them as giving us a window period to grow ourselves,” he said.
Kok Yufeng is a China correspondent at The Straits Times based in Beijing.
Yew Lun Tian is an Assistant Foreign Editor at The Straits Times.

content:
香港船东欢呼航运税改革 - Splash247
香港船东协会（HKSOA）欢迎一系列旨在吸引更多航运和大宗商品贸易企业来到香港的税收改革，其中包括针对实物大宗商品贸易商的新的半税率利得税优惠。
该措施于周三返回立法会审议，将把合资格商品贸易活动的利得税税率从16.5%下调至8.25%，同时扩大对船舶租赁、船舶管理、船舶代理和经纪业务的现有优惠。
该立法还为经合组织全球最低税率规则涵盖的合格航运公司和大宗商品贸易商引入了可选的 15% 税率，使他们能够简化 BEPS 2.0 框架下的合规工作。
对于船舶出租人来说，这些变化包括更广泛地扣除船舶购置成本和融资费用，以及租赁安排的更大灵活性。
商品贸易特许权旨在吸引更多贸易公司来到香港，并产生对本地航运服务的额外需求。
根据拟议的框架，符合资格的贸易商必须满足最低营业额和本地运营要求，包括将海事服务支出与香港供应商联系起来的条件。
政府此前估计，这些特许权可以通过鼓励大宗商品贸易商在香港建立或扩大业务来产生 46 亿港元（5.9 亿美元）的经济效益。
HKSOA主席Richard Hext表示，这些措施体现了政府、立法者和航运业之间的合作。
“航运业是一个竞争激烈的行业，需要许多社区利益相关者的支持，包括政府和立法者，”赫克斯说。
“新的税收措施是公私合作的一个很好的例子。每一项此类举措都增加了香港作为全球海事之都的吸引力。”
该协会代表 200 多家航运和海事相关企业，表示将与税务局合作，帮助该行业适应新要求。
自2020年以来，香港一直向合格的船舶出租商提供优惠税收待遇，并在随后的几年中向船舶租赁管理公司和其他商业海事服务提供商提供优惠。最新的改革是政府为加强该市作为海事金融、航运和大宗商品贸易中心的作用而做出的更广泛努力的一部分。

Hong Kong shipowners hail shipping tax overhaul - Splash247
The Hong Kong Shipowners Association (HKSOA) has welcomed a package of tax reforms aimed at attracting more shipping and commodity trading businesses to the city, including a new half-rate profits tax concession for physical commodity traders.
The measures, which returned to the Legislative Council for consideration on Wednesday, would reduce the profits tax rate on qualifying commodity trading activities from 16.5% to 8.25%, while expanding existing concessions for ship leasing, shipmanagement, ship agency and broking businesses.
The legislation also introduces an optional 15% tax rate for qualifying shipping companies and commodity traders covered by the OECD’s global minimum tax rules, allowing them to simplify compliance under the BEPS 2.0 framework.
For ship lessors, the changes include broader deductions for vessel acquisition costs and financing expenses, alongside greater flexibility in leasing arrangements.
The commodity trading concession is designed to bring more trading houses to Hong Kong and generate additional demand for local shipping services.
Under the proposed framework, eligible traders must meet minimum business turnover and local operating requirements, including conditions linking expenditure on maritime services to Hong Kong-based providers.
The government has previously estimated that the concessions could generate HK$4.6bn ($590m) in economic benefits by encouraging commodity traders to establish or expand their operations in the city.
HKSOA chairman Richard Hext said the measures reflected cooperation between the government, legislators and the shipping industry.
“The shipping sector is a highly competitive industry, requiring the support of many community stakeholders, including the government and legislators,” Hext said.
“The new tax measures are an excellent example of public-private partnership. Each and every such initiative adds to Hong Kong’s attraction as a global maritime capital.”
The association, which represents more than 200 shipping and maritime-related businesses, said it would work with the Inland Revenue Department to help the industry adapt to the new requirements.
Hong Kong has been offering preferential tax treatment to qualifying ship lessors since 2020, extending concessions to ship leasing managers and other commercial maritime service providers in subsequent years. The latest reforms form part of the government’s wider effort to strengthen the city’s role as a maritime finance, shipping and commodity trading centre.

content:
香港一家法院下令环保活动人士谢伟业支付律师费，此前他放弃了对政府在香港与中国大陆边境附近建设大型科技中心的决定的质疑。 2024 年 11 月 11 日，Eddie Tse 在香港高等法院前。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据《证人报》报道，高等法院周二作出判决，责令谢支付环境保护署和土木工程拓展署的法律费用，该署在司法复核被驳回之前已为诉讼程序做好了准备。高等法院法官拉塞尔·科尔曼在判决中表示，两个政府部门为此案聘请了六名大律师，称其“明显荒谬”，因此只判谢谢支付两名大律师的费用。社会工作者、环保组织拯救大屿山联盟召集人谢先生于2024年8月对环保部门兴建新田科技城的决定提出法律质疑。同年8月，法院批准司法复核，谢先生申请法律援助。然而，当年11月，法院批评政府拖延处理法律援助申请。去年1月，谢被指控向当局作出虚假陈述以获取老人津贴和公共住房，并因涉嫌欺诈被捕。后来，他因挑战政府而被拒绝提供法律援助。
新田。资料图片：香港政府一站通。去年四月，谢决定退出法律挑战，理由是他和他的家人受到骚扰和恐吓。法院驳回前区议员陈黛比接手司法覆核的申请，质疑因而被驳回。司法复核的受访者申请了法律费用，而谢则以公共利益为由寻求豁免。法官拉塞尔·科尔曼周二表示，由于司法审查在任何法律原则得以澄清之前就已终止，因此不属于公共利益诉讼费用减免的范围。牌照被吊销 去年7月，谢因在福利计划中诈骗政府16,780港元而被判处120小时社区服务。谢现年 69 岁，自 1993 年以来一直是注册社会工作者。在欺诈定罪后，社会工作者注册委员会（SWRB）吊销了他的社会工作者执照三年。

【原文 English Original】
A Hong Kong court has ordered environmental activist Eddie Tse to pay legal fees after he dropped a challenge against the government’s decision to build a huge technology hub near the city’s border with mainland China. Eddie Tse in front of Hong Kong’s High Court on November 11, 2024. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The High Court handed down judgment on Tuesday ordering Tse to pay the legal costs of the Environmental Protection Department and the Civil Engineering and Development Department, which had prepared for the proceedings before the judicial review was dismissed, The Witness reported. High Court judge Russell Coleman said in the judgment that the two government departments had engaged six barristers for the case, calling it “plainly absurd,” and therefore only granted costs for two barristers to be paid by Tse. Tse, a social worker and convenor of the environmental group Save Lantau Alliance, lodged a legal challenge against environmental authorities’ decision to build the San Tin Technopole in August 2024. The court granted leave for judicial review in August that year, and Tse applied for legal aid. However, in November that year, the court criticised the government over its delay in processing the legal aid application. In January last year, Tse was arrested on suspicion of fraud after being accused of making false statements to authorities to obtain an elderly allowance and public housing. He was later denied legal aid for his challenge against the government. San Tin. File photo: GovHK. In April last year, Tse decided to withdraw from the legal challenge, citing harassment and intimidation directed at him and his family. The court denied former district councillor Debby Chan’s application to take over the judicial review, and the challenge was consequently dismissed. The respondents to the judicial review applied for legal costs, while Tse sought a waiver on public interest grounds. Judge Russell Coleman said on Tuesday that because the judicial review was discontinued before any legal principles could be clarified, it fell outside the scope of public interest litigation cost waivers. Licence suspended In July last year, Tse was sentenced to 120 hours of community service for defrauding the government of HK$16,780 in welfare schemes. Tse, 69, had been a registered social worker since 1993. Following the fraud conviction, the Social Workers Registration Board (SWRB) suspended his social worker licence for three years.

content:
封面图片：图片联盟/SIPA|弗拉基米尔·普京、习近平和唐纳德·特朗普在深圳的会晤以领导人发表简短的“和平宣言”结束，然后回家。普京与习近平和特朗普并肩作战，旨在恢复俄罗斯作为不可或缺大国的地位，这一形象自 2022 年以来就已丧失。俄罗斯在继续对乌克兰发动战争的过程中，在外交上仍处于部分孤立状态。然而在深圳，中国将自己定位为世界事务的三个仲裁者之一。和平宣言并没有建立新的世界秩序。但它确实开始使这样的想法正常化：美国、中国和俄罗斯可以在没有欧洲、乌克兰或其他直接受影响国家参与的情况下讨论和平、能源、国际正义和核风险。其措辞也故意含糊其辞，提及联合国改革、稳定能源流动、抵制国际法院“滥用管辖权”以及减少核风险对话。这些都不需要时间表、核查机制、谈判授权或具体承诺。这使得俄罗斯、中国和美国可以随心所欲地使用“和平”、“改革”和“稳定”。毫无疑问，他们的定义与欧洲的定义截然不同。解决方案 欧洲各国政府应将深圳宣言视为一个警告，而不是一个突破。他们应该拒绝让莫斯科获得主要奖品：欧洲和乌克兰是大国模式，而不是参与者。
首先，欧洲各国政府应坚持认为，任何影响欧洲安全的讨论都应以欧洲国家和乌克兰为主体。任何有关结束俄罗斯在乌克兰战争的安排都不应越过基辅进行谈判。其次，欧洲各国政府应提出详细的反议程：加强集体安全和问责制的联合国改革；能源安全不使俄罗斯供应链合法化；对国际正义的明确立场；包括中国在内的减少核风险，但不奖励其核武库扩张。第三，欧洲各国政府应通过欧盟和北约进行协调。莫斯科将尝试利用欧盟成员国之间的分歧，分别与各国政府打交道。共同立场是对抗分而治之的最佳防御。背景普京、习近平和特朗普在深圳亚太经合组织会议期间举行的首次正式峰会没有产生什么实质性成果。在乌克兰、伊朗、军备控制、贸易或台湾问题上没有达成和解。然而，对于普京来说，这是一次公共关系的成功。与习近平和特朗普平等地亮相，强化了克里姆林宫对国内和全球南方受众的主张，即俄罗斯是世界政治的核心。乌克兰缺乏公众压力对莫斯科同样有价值，它可以提出大国讨价还价，而不是乌克兰主权，作为结束战争的框架。这反过来又使乌克兰成为欧洲安全秩序更大谈判中的一个项目。
此次峰会的重要性取决于以下因素：核对话能否达成议程、时间表和核查； “联合国改革”是加强还是削弱问责制；能源合作是否成为俄罗斯供应链依赖的掩护；深圳没有成为“新雅尔塔”，但这表明普京仍然渴望得到一个。来源

【原文 English Original】
Cover image: picture alliance / SIPA | Apaimages Problem Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump’s meeting in Shenzhen ended with the leaders issuing a short “declaration toward peace”—and going home. Putin, sitting alongside Xi and Trump, aimed to restore Russia as an indispensable great power, an appearance that has been lost since 2022. Russia remains partially isolated diplomatically as it continues its war against Ukraine. Yet in Shenzhen, the country projected itself as one of three arbiters of world affairs. The peace declaration did not create a new world order. But it did begin to normalise the idea that the US, China and Russia can discuss peace, energy, international justice and nuclear risk without Europe, Ukraine or other directly affected states at the table. Its language was also deliberately vague, with references to UN reform, stable energy flows, resistance to “jurisdiction abuse” by international courts and dialogue on nuclear-risk reduction. None of these require a timetable, verification mechanism, negotiating mandate or concrete commitment. This leaves Russia, China and the US free to use “peace,” “reform” and “stability” as they wish. No doubt their definitions would differ sharply from Europe’s. Solution European governments should treat the Shenzhen declaration as a warning, not a breakthrough. They should deny Moscow the main prize: a great-power format in which Europe and Ukraine are objects rather than participants. First, European governments should insist that any discussion affecting European security includes European states and Ukraine as principals. No arrangement on ending Russia’s war in Ukraine should be negotiated over Kyiv’s head. Second, European governments should offer a detailed counter-agenda: UN reform that strengthens collective security and accountability; energy security that does not legitimise Russian supply chains; a clear position on international justice; and nuclear-risk reduction that includes China without rewarding its arsenal expansion. Third, European governments should coordinate through the EU and NATO. Moscow will try to deal with capitals separately, exploiting differences among EU member states. A common position is the best defence against divide-and-rule. Context The first formal summit between Putin, Xi and Trump, on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen, produced little of substance. There were no settlements on Ukraine, Iran, arms control, trade or Taiwan. For Putin, however, it was a public relations success. Appearing as an equal alongside Xi and Trump reinforced the Kremlin’s claim, for domestic and global south audiences, that Russia is central to world politics. The absence of public pressure over Ukraine was equally valuable to Moscow, which could present great-power bargaining, rather than Ukrainian sovereignty, as the framework for ending the war. This, in turn, makes Ukraine one item in a larger bargain about Europe’s security order. The summit’s importance will depend on what follows: whether the nuclear dialogue gains an agenda, timetable and verification; whether “UN reform” strengthens or weakens accountability; whether energy cooperation becomes cover for Russian supply-chain dependence; and whether Ukraine is included as a sovereign participant. Shenzhen did not become a “new Yalta”, but it shows that Putin is still eager to get one. Source

title: A股全線暴跌 胡錫進直呼「虧得很痛」

content:
示意圖，圖為2025年4月25日，上海證券交易所新大樓內，顯示金融市場動態的屏幕概覽。(Hector Retamal/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月25日訊】（大紀元記者夏松報導）11月25日，A股全線暴跌，三大股指集體下跌，滬指失守3500點關口，創業板指跌幅超過4%，科技股成為重災區。全市場近5000隻個股下跌，投資者避險情緒明顯升溫。中共官媒《環球時報》前總編胡錫進發博文直呼，「我們今天都虧了，虧得很痛。」相關話題隨即登上微博熱搜，引發網民熱議。
截至收盤，滬指下跌2.03%，報3476.47點；深證成指下跌3.24%，報10086.36點；創業板指下跌4.19%，報2183.58點。滬深300指數下跌1.65%，報3898.24點；科創50指數大跌5.12%，報1186.14點。
滬深兩市全天成交額約1.38萬億元（人民幣，下同），較上一交易日減少約2720億元，市場在指數大幅下跌的同時，成交量明顯萎縮，顯示資金參與意願有所下降。
從個股表現來看，A股市場呈現普跌格局。收盤數據顯示，全市場僅586隻個股上漲，4926隻個股下跌，58隻個股漲停，49隻個股跌停，下跌個股占比接近九成，市場拋售壓力明顯。
行業板塊方面，科技成長股成為主要下跌力量。電子化學品、半導體、其它電子行業跌幅居前，分別下跌8.24%、7.89%及6.42%。電池板塊下跌6.12%，消費電子下跌5.92%，自動化設備下跌5.94%，通信設備下跌4.47%。
11月25日，與A股走勢相關的多個話題登上微博熱搜，其中包括「胡錫進說今天虧得很痛」。
胡錫進發博文稱，「我們今天都虧了，虧得很痛。其實，股民雖然罵著娘，但只要還沒有清倉的，就都還抱著反彈的希望，所以我想說：散戶股民是最對未來唱多的群體之一，他們用自己的真金白銀支撐了不斷後退的股市。」
視頻博主「達克鴨唐」發博文說，「老胡是真急了啊，這兩天都不長篇胡言了。」
大陸導演、編劇「鴻水（本名瞿繼鴻）」發博文說，「老胡也虧麻了，捨不得割肉的，是割不動了。」財經博主「可總yyds」說，「再給一次機會，老胡肯定不會入市了⋯⋯」
數碼博主「果仁兒科技」表示，「今天大盤一跌，老胡喊虧得很痛。沒清倉的散戶，一個個揣著念想，還在等反彈。這市場就是這樣，只要倉位還攥在手裡，幻想就不會熄火。嘴上罵得凶，心裡還在盼著翻本。說白了，不是看多行情，是捨不得自己套進去的真金白銀。 ​」
財經博主「葉艾茂」駁斥說，「胡錫進說股民沒清倉就還抱著反彈希望。我提醒老胡，你不要瞎說，天天下午很多人熬不住割肉，怎麼說還有希望？這個給量化錯誤物料，有毒！支持的請點讚！（大家都絕望了，你們懂的）」
財經博主「投魚問道」發博文說，「胡錫進說股民沒清倉就還抱著反彈希望，老胡真正踐行了這句格言：股民除了第一天入市想賺錢，後面都是想回本。剛才總體翻看了下，給人的感覺是，不管你啥時抄底，後面都會虧很不少。很多股，基本是一路跌，而且是陰跌，一直跌，漏了一般。」

content:
美国海军学院新闻图片 这些是根据海军和公开数据，截至 2026 年 11 月 23 日，美国海军在世界各地部署的航母打击群和两栖战备群的大致位置。如果 CSG 或 ARG 正在进行分类操作，图表会反映主力舰的位置。正在部署的总战力 286 (USS 228, USNS 58) 102 (USS 71, USNS 31) (46 FDNF, 56 轮换) 64 (56 部署, 8 本地) 在日本海军陆战队与查理连，营登陆队第 1 营，第 1 海军陆战队，第 31 海军陆战队远征队，在连队中缠斗2026 年 11 月 13 日，日本冲绳汉森营举行的格斗锦标赛。美国海军陆战队照片 USS Tripoli (LHA-7) 停泊在日本佐世保的港口。美国海军安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 隶属马金岛两栖待命大队，目前正在日本横须贺进行海军支援活动。 2026 年 11 月 9 日，新加坡海军陆战队第 13 远征部队第 211 海军陆战队战斗机攻击中队 (VMFA) 的飞行员小安东尼·科隆 (Anthony Colon Jr.) 在黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 上进行航空母舰资格考试时驾驶 F-35B 闪电 II 起飞。美国海军陆战队照片 两栖攻击舰马金岛号据船只观察员称，周五发现两艘船（LHD-8）和约翰·穆萨号（LPD-26）经过柔佛海峡。两艘船目前停靠在新加坡港口。马金岛两栖准备大队包括马金岛、安克雷奇号航空母舰 (LPD-23)、约翰·P·约翰号航空母舰
Murtha (LPD-26) 和登船的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队。2026 年 11 月 8 日，在佛罗里达州梅波特，分配给自由型濒海战斗舰圣路易斯号 (LCS-19) 的一级消防员大卫·罗宾逊 (David Robinson) 在该船从大沼泽港出发时收起系泊缆。美国海军照片 濒海战斗舰 USS 明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗号(LCS-21) 和圣路易斯号 (LCS-19) 被分配给美国南方司令部，但目前停泊在佛罗里达州梅波特海军基地的港口。2026 年 11 月 13 日，土耳其海军 SH-70 直升机在地中海“马维·巴利纳”演习的摄影演习中编队飞过阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰布尔克利号 (DDG-84)。在地中海作战的独立部署的导弹驱逐舰包括：美国海军奥斯卡·奥斯汀号（DDG-79），母港为罗塔海军基地。 USS Bulkeley (DDG-84)，母港为罗塔海军基地。 2026 年 11 月 21 日，红海，一名水手在阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰“冈萨雷斯”号 (DDG-66) 上夜间使用六分仪观测月亮。美国海军照片 有两艘导弹驱逐舰在红海作业：“杰森·邓纳姆”号 (DDG-109)，母港为佛罗里达州梅波特海军基地。“冈萨雷斯”号 (DDG-66)，母港位于弗吉尼亚州诺福克海军基地。在阿拉伯海，一名水手观察刘易斯和克拉克级干货船美国海军塞萨尔·查韦斯号 (T-AKE-14) 与尼米兹级航空母舰乔治·H·W·布什号并肩航行。

﻿ 以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。 2026 年 11 月 11 日，新加坡，隶属第 13 海军陆战队远征部队海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364（增援）的一名美国海军陆战队员正在准备一架 MV-22B 鱼鹰，以便在黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 上起飞。美国海军陆战队照片周五，两栖攻击舰马金岛号根据当地船舶观察员和 AIS 数据，两栖船坞运输舰 LHD-8（LHD-8）和两栖船坞运输舰 USS John P. Murtha（LPD-26）已驶入新加坡三巴旺。马金岛号和约翰·P·穆萨号与两栖运输船坞舰安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和已上船的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队组成了马金岛两栖待命大队。安克雷奇仍停靠在日本横须贺司令舰队活动中心。 2026 年 11 月 14 日，美国海军水手长三等大副马修·普里米蒂沃（左）和水手长二等大副杰伦·斯罗克莫顿在新加坡海上抛锚期间将千斤顶杆固定在独立型濒海战斗舰塔尔萨号（LCS-16）上。美国海军照片濒海战斗舰塔尔萨号（LCS-16）驶入新加坡周六出发，周一出发。塔尔萨隶属于第七驱逐舰中队（DESRON），该中队部署在东南亚前沿，是东南亚行动区指定舰艇的主要战术和作战指挥官。
在菲律宾马尼拉，澳大利亚总理安东尼·艾博内塞于 2026 年 11 月 15 日在菲律宾马尼拉参观澳大利亚皇家海军舰队加油船 HMAS Stalwart (A304)。澳大利亚国防军照片 澳大利亚皇家海军舰队加油船 HMAS Stalwart (A304) 对马尼拉进行港口访问。周日，正在出席东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）峰会的澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯（Anthony Albanese）访问了这艘船，会见了船员和在菲律宾的澳大利亚国防军人员。 Stalwart 正在进行区域部署。 2026 年 11 月 16 日，南海，美国海军燃气轮机系统技术员（机械）海员谢恩·文森特（来自肯塔基州）在南海将军区斑马训练期间，对阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰拉尔夫·约翰逊号 (DDG-114) 上的通道中的斑马配件进行注释。美国海军照片 驱逐舰拉尔夫·约翰逊号（DDG-114）于周日穿越吕宋海峡，周一在南海作业。拉尔夫·约翰逊（Ralph Johnson）前沿部署并分配到日本基地的DESRON 15。在越南海防，法国海军护卫舰FS Vendémiaire（F734）周一与越南海岸警卫队8004号近海巡逻船进行了联合搜救演习。此次演习是在法国护卫舰于11月12日开始访问海防后离开海防之后进行的。 Vendémiaire 总部位于新喀里多尼亚努美阿。
在菲律宾海 中国人民解放军海军辽宁舰仍部署在菲律宾海。该打击群最后一次被目击是在10月份，包括航母辽宁号（16）、巡洋舰鞍山号（101）和无锡号（104）以及驱逐舰淮南号（123）。此后随行船只可能发生了变化。在釜山，韩国皇家海军近海巡逻舰 HMS Spey (P234) 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日抵达韩国釜山进行港口访问。英国皇家海军照片 英国皇家海军近海巡逻舰 HMS Spey (P234) 周一抵达釜山进行港口访问。斯佩号和姊妹舰添马舰 (P233) 正在前沿部署

In Manila, Philippines Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese visits Royal Australian Navy fleet oiler HMAS Stalwart (A304) on Nov. 15, 2026, in Manila, Philippines. Australian Defense Force photo Royal Australian Navy fleet oiler HMAS Stalwart (A304) carried out a port visit to Manila. On Sunday , Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, who was in town for the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit, visited the ship to meet with the crew and Australian Defense Force personnel in the Philippines. Stalwart is conducting a regional presence deployment. US Navy photo Destroyer USS Ralph Johnson (DDG-114) was operating in the South China Sea as of Monday , having transited the Luzon Strait on Sunday . Ralph Johnson forward-deployed and assigned to Japan based DESRON 15. In Haiphong, Vietnam French Navy frigate FS Vendémiaire (F734) on Monday conducted a joint search and rescue exercise with Vietnam Coast Guard offshore patrol vessel 8004. The exercise followed the French frigate’s departure from Haiphong after a port visit that began on Nov. 12 . Vendémiaire is based in Noumea, New Caledonia. In the Philippine Sea The People’s Liberation Army Navy Liaoning CSG remains deployed in the Philippine Sea. The strike group was last visually sighted in October and included aircraft carrier CNS Liaoning (16) cruisers CNS Anshan (101) and CNS Wuxi (104) and destroyer CNS Huainan (123). The accompanying ships may have since changed. In Busan, South Korea Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS Spey (P234) arrived Nov. 16, 2026, in Busan, South Korea, for a port visit. Royal Navy photo Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS Spey (P234) arrived on Monday in Busan for a port visit. Spey and sister ship HMS Tamar (P233) are forward deployed to the Indo-Pacific. Near Honshu, Japan Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH-182) and Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri (F49) near Honshu, Japan, on Nov. 13, 2026. JMSDEF photo Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH-182) and Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri (F49) conducted the Japan-India Maritime Exercise (JAIMEX) 26 in waters south of Honshu from Nov. 13 to Saturday . The two ships carried out tactical maneuvering, communication and crossdeck drills. Sahyadri is making its way home after participating in Exercise Malabar 2026, which ran from Nov 5-12 in the waters off Yokosuka. title: The military lacks an ‘overarching plan’ to improve munition stockpiles—partly because it’s no one’s job
zh_title: 军方缺乏改善弹药库存的“总体计划”——部分原因是这不是任何人的工作
summary: 根据政府问责办公室周四发布的一份研究报告，国防部没有确定、实现或衡量其在实现长期弹药生产目标方面取得的进展的“总体计划”，该研究称军方对全球事件过于敏感，并且没有准备好预测自己的需求。美国政府问责局指出，除其他问题外，武器库存缺乏集中权力，武器库存已因伊朗战争而耗尽，对美国与中国发生潜在冲突的计划至关重要。问题的核心在于军队可以购买的东西和实际需要的东西之间的差异。
content:
根据政府问责办公室周四发布的一份研究报告，国防部没有确定、实现或衡量其在实现长期弹药生产目标方面取得的进展的“总体计划”，该研究称军方对全球事件过于敏感，并且没有准备好预测自己的需求。美国政府问责局指出，除其他问题外，武器库存缺乏集中权力，武器库存已因伊朗战争而耗尽，对美国与中国发生潜在冲突的计划至关重要。问题的核心在于军方可以购买的东西与实际需要的东西之间存在差异，政府问责局表示，这甚至可能导致弹药投资超出五角大楼的要求。该报告的作者写道：“虽然国防部正在采取措施关注弹药短缺问题，但它无法解决这些差距。” “国防部没有总体计划，也没有指定和授权的领导层来改善弹药库存并满足其弹药需求。由于没有确定长期目标、实现这些目标的战略以及衡量进展的指标，国防部无法确定其行动是否能够解决弹药短缺问题。”包括国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯在内的高级政府官员否认美国存在弹药短缺，尽管有报告和独立分析显示，伊朗冲突已经严重耗尽了弹药。关键武器，特别是备受追捧的爱国者拦截机，其制造时间可能超过两年。
但在对政府问责局研究的回应中，五角大楼官员同意军方需要制定一项长期计划来提高弹药生产的建议。五角大楼负责采购的代理副手大卫·卡德曼写道：“我们同意需要一个总体框架，更好地整合弹药需求、库存水平、生产、资源和长期目标。”他补充说，国防部“已经执行了政府问责局建议中的许多内容”。美国政府问责局的研究并未探讨特定弹药的库存，而是研究了五角大楼跟踪、预测和总体处理一系列武器（从炮弹到战斧导弹）的过程。 “重要的是，[这项研究]与当前的短缺无关，”战略与国际研究中心的高级顾问马克·坎西恩（Mark Cancian）撰写了大量有关弹药政策的文章。 “这关系到未来并决定长期库存、生产和弹药组合。”  国防官员强调需要“高低”弹药组合，即高科技、难以制造的武器和廉价武器之间的平衡。伊朗战争说明了美军对昂贵拦截机的依赖，这些拦截机投入了大量资金来击落廉价的沙赫德无人机，这些无人机的成本只有数万美元。
彭博资讯国防分析师韦恩·桑德斯表示：“当你拥有先进的能力，并且开始消耗先进的能力来击落快速补充的非先进能力时，这是一场我们赢不了的经济游戏。”“这开始转变为军事领域的一场革命，表明我们必须改变我们的学说，同时改变我们在美国的生产能力。”   美国政府问责局国防能力主管戴安娜·摩尔达夫斯基 (Diana Moldafsky) 在周五发给《防务一号》的一封电子邮件中指出，五角大楼已经发现了不足之处

【原文 English Original】
The Defense Department has no “overarching plan” to identify, achieve, or measure its progress toward long-term munition production goals, according to a Government Accountability Office study released on Thursday, which said the military was too reactive to global events and unprepared to forecast its own needs. The GAO cited—among other issues—a lack of centralized authority over weapons inventories, which have been depleted by the Iran war and are vital to U.S. plans for a potential conflict with China. At the center of the problem lies a discrepancy between what the military can buy and what it actually needs, which the GAO said could even result in munition investments that exceed the Pentagon’s requirements.  “While DOD is taking steps to focus on munitions shortages, it is not positioned to address these gaps,” the report’s authors wrote. “DOD does not have an overarching plan or designated and empowered leadership to improve munition inventories and meet its munitions requirements. By not identifying long-term goals, strategies to achieve them, and metrics to gauge progress, DOD cannot be sure that its actions will address its munition shortfalls. ” Top administration officials, including Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, have denied that the U.S. has a shortage in munitions, despite reports and independent analyses showing the Iran conflict has alarmingly drained key weapons, especially for highly-sought Patriot interceptors that can take more than two years to make. But in its response to the GAO study, Pentagon officials concurred with the recommendation that the military needed to develop a long-term plan to improve its munition production.  “We agree with the need for an overarching framework that better integrates munition requirements, inventory levels, production, resources, and long-term objectives,” wrote David Cadman, the Pentagon’s acting deputy for acquisitions, who added that the department “already executes many elements” of the GAO’s recommendation. The GAO study did not explore the inventories of specific munitions, but examined the processes by which an expansive list of weapons — from artillery shells to Tomahawk missiles — are tracked, forecast and generally addressed by the Pentagon. “The important thing is that [the study] is not about current shortages,” Mark Cancian, a senior adviser with the Center for Strategic and International Studies who has written extensively on munitions policy. “It's about the future and deciding long-term inventories, production, and munitions mixes.”  Defense officials have emphasized the need for a “high-low” mix of munitions—that is, a balance between high-tech, hard-to-make weapons and cheaper ones. The Iran war illustrated the U.S. military’s reliance on expensive interceptors, which were heavily expended to shoot down cheap Shahed drones that only cost tens of thousands of dollars.  “When you have an exquisite capacity, and you are starting to expend an exquisite capacity to knock down non-exquisite capabilities that are rapidly replenished, it is an economical game that we're not going to win,” said Wayne Sanders, a defense analyst with Bloomberg Intelligence. “This is starting to turn into one of those revolutions in military affairs to say we have to change our doctrine as well as we change our production capacity in the U.S.”   In an email to Defense One on Friday, the GAO’s director for defense capabilities, Diana Moldafsky, noted that the Pentagon had identified shortfalls before the conflict with Iran, but said that the war “made addressing those shortages more urgent.” “Our key point is that meeting DOD's munitions requirements will be challenging,” Moldafsky said. “A department-wide plan would help the department direct its resources towards its most critical munitions needs.”  Cancian said that Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine, and the consequent transfer of Patriots and other weapons to Kyiv, introduced concerns about the defense industrial base and its ability to respond to munition needs around the world. Meanwhile, the Pentagon has inked billions of dollars in multi-year “framework agreements” with top defense companies over the last year to help increase high-tech munition production, which require funding from Congress to come to fruition. The Trump administration also invoked the Defense Production Act earlier this year in an attempt to bolster munition supply chains. A Pentagon spokesperson declined to address the GAO study directly, or even to be quoted by name. But they said the military is “fully equipped to strike at the time and place of the President’s choosing…while preserving a deep, ready stockpile to defend our people and interests.” Part of the problem is that no one authority is really in charge of keeping arsenals topped off and ready, the report found.  The GAO identified several Pentagon offices and working groups, including individual service entities, responsible for managing munition inventories, but no one dedicated authority “that empowers the leadership to make decisions that improve munitions inventories department-wide and hold them accountable for the outcomes achieved, such as improving munitions inventory levels.” The study also said that the services maintain separate tools to track munition inventories, which then feed into a Pentagon system known as the Munitions Readiness Initiative. But researchers said the DOD has limited oversight over that tracking platform and hasn’t regularly reconciled it with service-level numbers. Citing an unnamed Pentagon official in its acquisitions and sustainment office, the GAO said “the office was reluctant to impose additional responsibilities on the services for maintaining data to meet MRI’s needs because they recognize that the services already face numerous responsibilities in managing their own munitions inventory data.” The Pentagon concurred with most of the GAO’s recommendations, but only partially agreed with one: that the data management plan be run out of the DOD’s digital and AI office. Cadman’s response said that the Pentagon’s acquisition and sustainment arm was best suited to develop it. ]]>

title: Metatek scales survey capacity to capture government partners
zh_title: Metatek 扩大调查能力以吸引政府合作伙伴
summary: Metatek Group（多伦多证券交易所股票代码：MTEK）正在扩大其调查能力，以满足各国政府不断增长的需求，以更好地了解其碳氢化合物和关键矿产资源。这家总部位于英国的地球物理技术公司表示，资源开发商仍将是其客户群的重要组成部分，但它看到主权政府的需求不断增长。各国正在投资地下测绘项目，以寻找石油、天然气、矿物、水和地热资源。 “各国越来越希望了解自己边界下的情况以及未来的机会可能在哪里
content:
Metatek Group（多伦多证券交易所股票代码：MTEK）正在扩大其调查能力，以满足各国政府不断增长的需求，以更好地了解其碳氢化合物和关键矿产资源。这家总部位于英国的地球物理技术公司表示，资源开发商仍将是其客户群的重要组成部分，但它看到主权政府的需求不断增长。各国正在投资地下测绘项目，以寻找石油、天然气、矿物、水和地热资源。 Metatek 创始人兼首席执行官马克·戴维斯 (Mark Davies) 表示：“各国越来越希望在做出重大投资决策之前了解本国境内的情况以及未来可能存在的机会。” “对于 Metatek 来说，现在的机会在于执行：增加我们可用的能力，并将其部署到大量且不断增长的工作流程中。”  最近的协议 Metatek 指出，最近的几份合同证明政府对其测量服务的需求不断增长。作为新加坡全国地热评估的一部分，Metatek 使用其全张量梯度计 (eFTG) 系统进行了机载和地面综合勘测。初步调查结果估计，该国的地热资源潜力是目前年用电量的 60 倍以上。
该公司还获得了菲律宾能源部颁发的机载地球科学合同，并与阿塞拜疆国有石油公司和尼日利亚国有能源公司签署了重要协议——后者是 Metatek 历史上最大的多年期合同。 洛克希德·马丁公司 10 月，Metatek 宣布与洛克希德·马丁公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：LMT）达成协议，制造和购买新型增强型 eFTG 仪器。该交易赋予 Metatek 七年从洛克希德·马丁公司购买新型 eFTG 系统的全球独家经营权。 “新的洛克希德·马丁公司协议巩固了这一地位，同时也为我们提供了增加未来产能的途径。今天的需求不是问题；我们的重点是确保我们拥有执行需求的系统和运营能力，”戴维斯补充道。市场时机 该公司表示，其进入公开市场时，对其机载地球物理测量服务的需求超出了其可用能力，其管理层表示，增加进一步的测量系统是其下一阶段增长的核心。 Metatek 表示，增长机会已经反映在其财务业绩中，其第三季度营收为 970 万美元（13.89 加元），比去年同期增长 29%。该公司股价周一在多伦多收于2.61加元，下跌2.43%。

【原文 English Original】
Metatek Group (TSX: MTEK) is expanding its survey capacity to capitalize on growing demand from governments seeking to better understand their hydrocarbon and critical mineral resources. The U.K.-based geophysical technology company says resource developers will remain an important part of its customer base, but it sees growing demand from sovereign governments. Countries are investing in subsurface mapping programs in search of oil, gas, mineral, water and geothermal resources.  “Countries increasingly want to understand what sits beneath their own borders and where future opportunities may exist before making major investment decisions,” said Mark Davies, Metatek’s founder and CEO. “For Metatek, the opportunity now is about execution: increasing the capacity we have available and deploying it against a substantial and growing pipeline of work.”  Recent agreements Metatek points to several recent contracts as evidence of growing government demand for its surveying services. As part of a nationwide geothermal assessment in Singapore, Metatek delivered integrated airborne and ground-based surveys using its Full Tensor Gradiometer (eFTG) system. Preliminary findings estimated the country’s geothermal resource potential at more than 60 times its current annual electricity consumption. The company was also awarded an airborne geoscience contract by the Philippines’ Department of Energy, and signed major agreements with Azerbaijan’s state oil company, and Nigeria’s state-owned energy company — the latter of which is the largest multi-year contract in Metatek’s history. Lockheed Martin In October, Metatek announced an agreement with Lockheed Martin (NYSE: LMT) for the manufacture and purchase of a new enhanced eFTG instrument. The deal gives Metatek seven years of global exclusivity in relation to the purchase of new eFTG systems from Lockheed Martin.  “The new Lockheed Martin agreement strengthens that position while also giving us a route to increase future capacity. Demand today is not the issue; our focus is making sure we have the systems and operational capability to execute against it,” added Davies.  Market timing The company says it entered the public markets at a point when demand for its airborne geophysical surveying services was beyond its available capacity, with its management saying the addition of further survey systems was central to its next stage of growth. Metatek says that growth opportunity has already been reflected in its financial performance, where it reported a third-quarter revenue of $9.7 million (C$13.89), up 29% from the same period a year earlier. The company’s shares closed at C$2.61 Monday in Toronto, down 2.43%.

title: Beijing slams US for ‘suppressing’ Chinese firms after Huawei conviction

summary: 周三，在美国陪审团裁定科技巨头华为窃取商业机密并就其在伊朗的工作向监管机构撒谎后，北京猛烈抨击美国“打压”中国企业。华为总部位于深圳。照片：华为。全球领先的电信设备制造商华为已成为唐纳德·特朗普总统政府的攻击目标，经过三个月的审判后，华为于周二在纽约联邦法院被定罪。这项裁决是在美国和中国的政治敏感时刻做出的，两国领导人试图投射特朗普所说的“f
content:
周三，在美国陪审团裁定科技巨头华为窃取商业机密并就其在伊朗的工作向监管机构撒谎后，北京猛烈抨击美国“打压”中国企业。华为总部位于深圳。照片：华为。全球领先的电信设备制造商华为已成为唐纳德·特朗普总统政府的攻击目标，经过三个月的审判后，华为于周二在纽约联邦法院被定罪。这项裁决是在美国和中国的政治敏感时期做出的，两国领导人上周在深圳会晤时试图展现特朗普所说的“奇妙”关系。陪审团裁定华为面临 12 项刑事罪名中的 10 项罪名成立，包括银行欺诈、合谋窃取商业机密以及合谋诈骗美国。中国周三予以回击，称“坚决反对美国打压和围堵中国企业，坚定支持中国企业维护合法权益”。特朗普政府长期以来一直声称华为存在代表中国政府从事间谍活动的风险，并此前敦促各国不要在新的 5G 移动网络中使用该公司的基础设施。 “没有任何人或公司可以凌驾于法律之上，”美国司法部长托德·布兰奇在定罪后的一份声明中表示。
“几十年来，华为及其三个子公司在谎言和盗窃的基础上在美国开展业务。”美国和中国国旗。资料图片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。华为周三驳回了这一判决，并在一份声明中表示，该判决“没有法律或事实依据”。 “我们将彻底审查相关判决，并采取一切必要的法律行动来捍卫我们的权益，”它补充道。 “必要的法律行动”然而，陪审团确实宣判华为无罪，该公司表示，此举“欢迎”，并补充说，它“证实了这些指控缺乏事实依据，并证明了我们在过去八年中的一贯立场。” “我们认为政府的其余指控同样没有法律或事实依据……我们将彻底审查相关判决，并采取一切必要的法律行动来捍卫我们的权益，”声明继续说道。这些指控部分涉及华为与伊朗政府的业务往来。美国司法部表示：“华为多次对其在伊朗业务的性质撒谎，错误地告诉银行、记者和美国政府，它没有协助伊朗政府、军队或情报部门。”

Beijing lashed out at the United States on Wednesday for “suppressing” Chinese companies, after a US jury found tech giant Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets and lying to regulators over its work in Iran. Huawei headquarters in Shenzhen. Photo: Huawei. Huawei, the world’s leading telecom equipment manufacturer, has been targeted by President Donald Trump’s administration, and was convicted on Tuesday in a New York federal court after a three-month trial. The ruling comes at a politically sensitive time for the United States and China, whose leaders sought to project what Trump called a “fantastic” relationship when they met in Shenzhen last week. Jurors found Huawei guilty of 10 of the 12 criminal counts facing it — including bank fraud, conspiracy to steal trade secrets and conspiracy to defraud the United States. China hit back on Wednesday, saying it “firmly opposes the US suppressing and containing Chinese enterprises and firmly supports Chinese enterprises in safeguarding their legitimate rights and interests.” Trump’s administration has long alleged a risk of Huawei spying on behalf of the Chinese government, and previously urged countries not to use the company’s infrastructure in new 5G mobile networks. “No person or company is above the law,” US Attorney General Todd Blanche said in a statement after the conviction. “For decades, Huawei and three of its subsidiaries conducted their business in the United States on the basis of lies and theft.” The US and Chinese flag. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. Huawei rejected the conviction on Wednesday, saying in a statement it was “without legal or factual merit.” “We will thoroughly review the relevant verdicts and take all necessary legal actions to defend our rights and interests,” it added. ‘Necessary legal actions’ The jury did, however, acquit Huawei of racketeering conspiracy and obstruction of justice, a move the company said it “welcomed,” adding that it “confirms that these allegations lack factual basis and vindicates our consistent position over the past eight years.” “We believe the government’s remaining charges are equally without legal or factual merit… We will thoroughly review the relevant verdicts and take all necessary legal actions to defend our rights and interests,” the statement continued. The charges in part involved Huawei’s business dealings with the government of Iran. “Huawei repeatedly lied about the nature of its business in Iran, falsely telling banks, journalists, and the US government that it did not assist Iran’s government, military, or intelligence community,” the DOJ said. “Huawei lied about its activities in Iran to banks to obtain billions of US dollars and access to US-dollar clearing services, which enabled Huawei to be a sophisticated participant in a global marketplace for telecommunications services — in part because of its lies.” The equipment manufacturer was also accused of attempting to recruit employees of US telecoms firms and obtaining technological information from them in the process. That data allegedly enabled Huawei to develop products similar to those of its competitors, which it then sold at lower prices, according to the original indictment. File photo: Wikipedia. “The misappropriated intellectual property included trade secret information and copyrighted works, such as source code and user manuals for internet routers, antenna technology, and robot testing technology,” the DOJ said in a release. Huawei even launched an internal program offering bonuses to employees who obtained industrial secrets from competitors, prosecutors claimed. “Today’s verdict sends an unmistakable message: America will defend its businesses, protect its workers, and safeguard its national security against corrupt foreign corporations that lie, cheat, and steal to get ahead,” Assistant Attorney General A. Tysen Duva said in a statement.

title: Tai Po fire: Wang Fuk Court residents who sold titles excluded from third owners’ meeting next month
zh_title: 大埔火警：宏福苑卖业居民下月第三次业主会议被排除
summary: 政府指定的遭受火灾的宏福苑管理员已宣布下个月举行第三次业主会议，但已出售业权的居民除外。 2026 年 8 月 20 日，宏福苑周边地区仍被警方封锁。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。合安管理公司周一宣布，宏福苑自去年11月致命大火以来的第三次业主大会将于12月6日在大埔社区中心举行。这场大火造成 168 人死亡，数千人流离失所，成为香港数十年来最致命的火灾之一。与过去两次见面不同
content:
政府指定的遭受火灾的宏福苑管理员已宣布下个月举行第三次业主会议，但已出售业权的居民除外。 2026 年 8 月 20 日，宏福苑周边地区仍被警方封锁。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。合安管理公司周一宣布，宏福苑自去年11月致命大火以来的第三次业主大会将于12月6日在大埔社区中心举行。这场大火造成 168 人死亡，数千人流离失所，成为香港数十年来最致命的火灾之一。与过去的两次会议不同的是，下个月的会议将在一个地点举行，这表明合安预计出席人数将会减少。过去两次会议是在四个场地进行转播，以容纳大量前宏福苑居民。消息公布后，一些根据政府回购计划出售公寓的居民被告知，他们将不再有资格参加业主会议。 HKFP看到，在通过在线系统发出的通知中，Hop On表示，未在土地注册处记录中列为公寓注册业主的居民将无法报名参加下个月的会议。政府表示，宏福苑共有1,984户业主，其中99.3%表示愿意根据回购计划出售业权，只有13户拒绝出售。
当局表示，他们计划最早于明年立法收购所有未售出的业权。2026 年 7 月 19 日，宏福苑居民参加在大埔社区中心举行的业主会议。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。居民正在签署正式销售协议，将其产权转让给政府，一些居民已经开始根据换屋安排选择新的政府补贴单位。但据一位吴姓居民表示，一些尚未正式转让产权的居民或许可以参加下个月的会议。吴周一告诉《香港新闻社》，她的家人原计划在本月底签署正式合同，但现在要等到下个月的会议之后。合安表示，会议议程将包括宏福苑财务状况报告、任命2026财年审计师的决定，以及可能出现的任何其他事务。

【原文 English Original】
The government-appointed administrator of fire-hit Wang Fuk Court has announced a third owners’ meeting next month, excluding residents who have sold their titles. The area surrounding Wang Fuk Court remains blocked by police force on August 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Hop On Management announced on Monday that the third Wang Fuk Court owners’ meeting since last November’s deadly blaze will be held on December 6 at the Tai Po Community Centre. The blaze killed 168 people and displaced thousands, making it one of Hong Kong’s deadliest fires in decades. In a departure from the past two meetings — which were broadcast across four venues to accommodate a large turnout of former Wang Fuk Court residents — next month’s meeting will take place at a single venue, signalling that Hop On anticipates lower attendance. Following the announcement, some residents who had sold their flats under a government buyback scheme were told they would no longer be eligible to attend the owners’ meeting. In a notice issued via an online system and seen by HKFP, Hop On said residents not listed as a flat’s registered owner in Land Registry records would be unable to sign up for next month’s meeting. The government has said 99.3 per cent of all 1,984 Wang Fuk Court homeowners have indicated they are willing to sell their titles under the buyback scheme, leaving only 13 households refusing to sell. Authorities have said they plan to introduce legislation as early as next year to acquire any unsold titles. Wang Fuk Court residents attend a flat owners meeting at Tai Po Community Centre on July 19, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Residents are in the process of signing formal sales agreements to transfer their titles to the government, and some have begun selecting new government-subsidised units under a flat-swap arrangement. But some residents who have yet to formalise their title transfer may be able to attend next month’s meeting, according to one resident surnamed Woo. Woo told HKFP on Monday that her family had planned to sign the formal contract at the end of this month, but would now wait until after next month’s meeting. Hop On said the meeting agenda will include a report on Wang Fuk Court’s financial status, a decision on the appointment of an auditor for the 2026 financial year, and any other business that may arise.

title: Mysterious MQ-25 Stingray-Like Chinese Drone Emerges At Little-Known Flight Test Center
zh_title: 神秘的MQ-25类似黄貂鱼的中国无人机出现在鲜为人知的飞行测试中心
summary: 卫星图像显示，中国浦城有一架不寻常的无人驾驶飞机，其配置与波音公司的舰载 MQ-25 Stingray 非常相似。虽然我们仍然不知道无人机的功能，但该设施本身似乎也成为中国不断扩大的无人驾驶飞机工业的一个日益重要的枢纽。 Vantor 向 TWZ 提供的宽视野卫星图像显示了 2026 年 4 月 23 日位于浦城的神秘无人机。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 这架无人机最初在浦城内府机场的卫星图像中被发现后引起了人们的关注。
content:
卫星图像显示，中国浦城有一架不寻常的无人驾驶飞机，其配置与波音公司的舰载 MQ-25 Stingray 非常相似。虽然我们仍然不知道无人机的功能，但该设施本身似乎也成为中国不断扩大的无人驾驶飞机工业的一个日益重要的枢纽。 Vantor 向 TWZ 提供的一张广角卫星图像显示了 2026 年 4 月 23 日在蒲城的神秘无人机。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 这架无人机最初引起了人们的关注，因为它在中国西北部陕西省蒲城内府机场的卫星图像中被发现，可通过苹果地图查看。无人机出现在跑道上的单独图像也可以通过必应地图获得。 TWZ 随后从 Vantor 获得了浦城的图像，显​​示了相关无人驾驶飞机。真是一个惊喜！苹果地图上发现三架无人机出现在蒲城。 CH-7、九天和类似MQ-25的无人机。 pic.twitter.com/rREqLuFAdU — Charles Xu (@CharlesXu091121) 2026 年 11 月 18 日再次出现在 bing 地图上！这次它出现在跑道上 pic.twitter.com/xLgZetmOZf — Charles Xu (@CharlesXu091121) 2026 年 11 月 19 日 除了不明飞行器之外，今年 4 月从蒲城拍摄的图像还揭示了似乎是 CH-7 隐形飞翼无人机和重型喷气动力九天母舰无人机的例子。 2026 年 4 月 23 日，一架 CH-7 停泊在蒲城。
卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 2026 年 4 月 23 日在蒲城的九天无人机母舰。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 与不明飞行器最明显的比较是波音的 MQ-25 Stingray。 MQ-25是一种舰载无人飞机，主要为美国海军飞机提供空中加油，扩大舰载机联队的航程和操作灵活性。它还为未来无人海军航空能力奠定了基础。范托称，就尺寸而言，这架身份不明的中国无人机翼展约为66英尺，长度为49英尺。相比之下，MQ-25 的翼展约为 75 英尺，长度约为 51 英尺。 MQ-25 黄貂鱼。波音公司的这款中国无人机似乎具有相似的总体设计类别，但现阶段存在一些值得注意的重要差异。最引人注目的之一是前机身。与MQ-25不同，MQ-25的前部具有相对扁平的铲状外观，中国飞机似乎有一个更传统的锥形机头。也许这可以包含一个容纳雷达设备的锥形天线罩。这个理论，而且它只是一个理论，可以通过机头与黄色底漆机身的不同颜色来支持。进气量也不同。
与 MQ-25 相关的异国情调的齐平进气道不同，中国设计有一个更传统的背部进气道，看起来呈锯齿状，有助于雷达信号和/或分成两个通道。另一种可能性是飞机有两个发动机，尽管基于明显的分叉进气道，这仍然是推测性的。左侧浦城图像中的无人机和 MQ-25 的并排视图，提供了它们入口的比较视图。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor/Boeing 尾部配置也可能很独特，具有横向展开的 V 型尾翼，如 MQ-25，但可能采用可见控制面，而不是全移动水平尾翼设计。综合起来，这些功能

【原文 English Original】
Satellite imagery has revealed an unusual uncrewed aircraft at Pucheng, China, with a configuration that bears very strong similarities to Boeing’s carrier-based MQ-25 Stingray . While we still have no idea about the function of the drone, the facility itself also appears to be an increasingly important hub for China’s expanding uncrewed aircraft industry . A wider-view satellite image provided to TWZ by Vantor shows the mystery drone at Pucheng on April 23, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor The drone initially attracted attention after being spotted in a satellite image of Pucheng Neifu Airport in Shaanxi Province, in northwestern China, available through Apple Maps. A separate image of the drone, where it appears on a runway, is also available through Bing Maps. TWZ subsequently obtained imagery of Pucheng from Vantor showing the uncrewed aircraft in question. what a suprise! Three UAV spotted at Pucheng on apple maps. CH-7, Jiutian and a MQ-25 like UAV. pic.twitter.com/rREqLuFAdU — Charles Xu (@CharlesXu091121) November 18, 2026 spotted again on bing maps! and it's on the runway this time pic.twitter.com/xLgZetmOZf — Charles Xu (@CharlesXu091121) November 19, 2026 As well as the unidentified aircraft, imagery from Pucheng dating from April of this year also reveals what appears to be a CH-7 stealthy flying-wing drone and an example of the heavyweight jet-powered Jiutian mothership drone . A CH-7 at Pucheng on April 23, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor A Jiutian drone mothership at Pucheng on April 23, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor The most obvious comparison for the unidentified aircraft is Boeing’s MQ-25 Stingray. The MQ-25 is a carrier-based uncrewed aircraft developed primarily to provide aerial refueling for U.S. Navy aircraft, extending the range and operational flexibility of carrier air wings. It also provides a foundation for future uncrewed naval aviation capabilities . In terms of dimensions, the unidentified Chinese UAV has a wingspan of approximately 66 feet and a length of 49 feet, according to Vantor. In contrast, the MQ-25 measures approximately 75 feet in wingspan and 51 feet in length. MQ-25 Stingray. Boeing The Chinese drone appears to occupy a similar general design category, but there are several important differences notable at this stage. One of the most noticeable is the forward fuselage. Unlike the MQ-25, whose forward section has a relatively flattened, shovel-like appearance, the Chinese aircraft appears to have a more conventional, tapered nose. Perhaps this could incorporate a conical radome housing radar equipment. That theory, and it is just a theory, could be supported by the different color of the nose compared to the yellow primer-painted airframe. The air intake is also different. Rather than the exotic, flush inlet associated with the MQ-25 , the Chinese design has a more conventional dorsal intake that appears serrated to help with radar signature and/or split into two channels. Another possibility is that the aircraft has two engines, although that remains speculative, based on the apparent bifurcated intake. A side-by-side look at the drone seen in the image of Pucheng, at left, and an MQ-25, offering comparative views of their inlets. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor/Boeing The tail configuration may also be distinctive, with a laterally flared V-tail, like the MQ-25, but possibly incorporating visible control surfaces instead of an all-moving tailplane design. Taken together, these features suggest an aircraft that shares some of the MQ-25’s general design philosophy but is not an attempt at a direct clone. Long-time Chinese aerospace observer and TWZ contributor Andreas Rupprecht , who has been following developments surrounding the aircraft, believes China could be following a development path similar to Boeing’s, potentially producing a carrier-based uncrewed aerial refueling platform that can also undertake intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) missions. “I think China is actually following the same path as Boeing here, and it’s heading towards a tanker that can also take on other roles as an ISR platform,” Rupprecht told us. A radar-equipped aircraft with substantial endurance could potentially perform surveillance and other sensor-related missions when not being used as a tanker. The potential development of a multirole uncrewed tanker at Pucheng would also fit into a much broader push by China to expand the role of uncrewed aircraft in its naval aviation forces. One of the most notable developments is the GJ-21 , a navalized derivative of the GJ-11 Sharp Sword stealth uncrewed combat air vehicle (UCAV). Featuring folding wings and provisions for catapult launches and arrested recoveries, the low-observable flying-wing design is intended to operate from China’s growing fleet of large-deck warships , including the Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan . In October 2026, Chinese state media reported that the GJ-21 had successfully completed its first takeoff and landing aboard the vessel, a significant milestone in the development of shipborne fixed-wing combat drones. GJ-21 carrier-based UCAV. via Chinese internet The GJ-21 effort is taking place alongside the introduction of China’s new catapult-equipped Fujian aircraft carrier, which has begun operating the J-35 stealth fighter, J-15T carrier-based fighter, and KJ-600 airborne early warning aircraft. Taken together, these developments point to an increasingly ambitious effort to integrate uncrewed aircraft into China’s future carrier air wings , potentially spanning stealthy strike platforms, surveillance systems, and other specialized support aircraft. The unidentified Pucheng aircraft could represent another, quite different part of that wider effort — or something else altogether. At the same time, this aircraft is roughly 20 percent dimensionally smaller than the MQ-25, which would mean it would have less fuel to give. It’s also worth noting that Boeing’s MQ-25 emerged from an unmanned combat air vehicle (UCAV) design that included low-observable features. Multirole UCAV concepts predating it also looked very similar. The MRE concept from Lockheed during the 1990s looks very similar to the MQ-25 we know today. (Lockheed Martin) In addition, Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), for instance, the FQ-42 Vengeance, and also the XQ-67 Off-Board Sensing Station share a similar overall design. With this in mind, and remembering its different nose section, this could just as easily be a true multirole UCAV or even a CCA, such as one designed for force protection of high-value aerial assets, and it may not even be carrier-capable. Rupprecht cautioned that the manufacturer of the mystery drone remains unidentified. However, one of the more interesting clues about the aircraft’s possible origins comes from Shenyang Aircraft Corporation (SAC). Rupprecht pointed to a propeller-driven demonstrator unveiled by SAC in 2025, which he believes could fit the development lineage of the larger aircraft now visible at Pucheng. The sub-scale propeller-driven demonstrator unveiled by SAC in 2025. The background reads (rough translation): “Rollout Ceremony for Final Assembly of Shenyang’s First ‘Surrogate Flight Test’ Pilot-Test Verification Platform UAV.” via Chinese internet A smaller, propeller-driven demonstrator could provide a relatively inexpensive way to investigate aerodynamic characteristics, autonomous flight controls, mission systems, and other technologies before progressing to a much larger aircraft. This piston-powered, propeller-driven aircraft with a broadly similar configuration to the MQ-25 was seen in a video flying, as well. 突然想起中国一家民营无人机公司，做过一款MQ-25活塞桨叶版 https://t.co/Y69dfzpLNS pic.twitter.com/IzU08PC8DK — 飞刀 (@chaoyinsukandao) November 18, 2026 Whether the Pucheng aircraft is related to this SAC demonstrator or if it’s an entirely separate program remains unknown. Beyond the external resemblance, there are no indications that they are linked, and the aircraft could just be a general test surrogate platform. The configuration isn’t totally novel in the advanced UAS world. The aircraft’s appearance is also interesting given the location where it has been spotted. Pucheng Neifu Airport is located in Shaanxi Province, and its surrounding aviation facilities include an area identified in Apple Maps as the National Aeronautics Industrial Base Pucheng General Aviation Industrial Park Guanliban. The industrial park has its own smaller runway, separate from the main airport infrastructure. A close-up of Pucheng with no drones visible, as of June 16, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 The site had remained relatively obscure to outside observers until roughly the past one to two years, according to Rupprecht. More recently, however, various aircraft manufacturers have apparently been conducting testing there. This raises the possibility that Pucheng is not simply an individual manufacturer’s flight-test location, but a facility used by multiple organizations developing and evaluating uncrewed aircraft. Rupprecht also raised the possibility that Pucheng could potentially be a specialized uncrewed aircraft testing facility associated with China’s Flight Test Establishment at Xi’an, commonly known as CFTE. “I cannot say (yet) whether this — and this is my theory — is effectively a branch of the CFTE at Xi’an, which is for crewed and this is a base for uncrewed ones,” Rupprecht explained. A satellite image provided to TWZ by Vantor provides an overview of Pucheng as of April 23, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor If Pucheng does serve as a shared testing location for multiple manufacturers, it could help explain the appearance of several otherwise unrelated UAV designs at the same site. Returning to the mystery drone, the combination of its apparent size, configuration, and possible connection to earlier Chinese demonstrator programs makes it an interesting development to watch. Regardless, for now, the imagery from Pucheng offers a glimpse of a potentially significant new Chinese uncrewed aircraft program. title: 蔡天凤碎尸案进展：前夫邝港智供认曾写信指证父亲邝球，欲以作证换取免诉

content: “28岁香港名媛蔡天凤遭前夫碎尸”案曾震惊社会，蔡天凤前夫邝港智、前夫父亲邝球、前夫兄长邝港杰被控谋杀及阻止合法埋葬尸体罪。11月25日，南都N视频记者从香港司法机构官网获悉，案件日前持续在香港高等法院开庭。案件已于当天完成45天的审讯流程，三名被告均已完成供述，控辩双方也已完成举证。案件将于11月27日进入结案陈词阶段。 11月24日的庭审中，邝港智承认，自己曾于2024年去信警方，希望通过作证换取豁免起诉。他解释称，当时希望向警方讲出真相，指证父亲邝球谋杀蔡天凤，但警方没有接纳其申请。25日的庭审中，邝港智进一步表示，他曾三度去信警方，希望成为控方证人。 邝港智称，2026年1月29日，警方派员与他会面并录取警诫供词。他当时以为录取的是一份不会损害自身权益的口供，但警方后来拒绝让他成为控方证人，并将这份口供用于指证他。他在庭上指责警方欺骗自己。 物证方面，控方24日引述法医证供，指出蔡天凤的伤势可能由钝器造成，并提及涉案村屋检获的圆头锤上验出邝港智的DNA，质疑他曾使用该锤袭击蔡天凤。邝港智否认碰过圆头锤，称自己没有见过该物品，并指圆头锤是由哥哥邝港杰购买的。他还称，锤上没有哥哥的指纹及DNA，令他感到费解。 控方随后展示蔡天凤生前使用的粉红色名牌手袋。手袋手柄有损坏，袋面亦有穿洞。控方认为，这些痕迹与蔡天凤在车内遭袭击时举起手袋抵挡的情况吻合。邝港智不同意这一说法，并质疑手袋有血迹，为何圆头锤上没有血迹。对于控方提出他曾清洗圆头锤的质疑，他亦予以否认。 25日庭审的另一焦点，是控方播放大埔龙尾村涉案村屋附近的监控片段，质疑邝港智此前关于案发当天的供述。 邝港智此前供称，2023年2月21日抵达涉案单位后，父亲邝球曾上车查看蔡天凤的情况，双方还谈及是否报警或召救护车。但控方播放的监控画面显示，邝球从另一辆七人车下车后，与邝港杰走向车辆后备厢取出胶箱，画面未显示邝球曾登上载有蔡天凤的车辆。 控方还根据闭路电视画面，质疑三人抵达涉案单位后很快便取出胶箱，认为三人可能早已商量好如何处理蔡天凤的遗体。邝港智否认知晓父亲和哥哥事先有任何谋划，称自己只知道将遗体搬进屋内，并不知道后续安排。 随着邝港智于11月25日完成作供，案件已完成45天的审讯流程，三名被告均已完成供述，控辩双方也已完成举证。法官建议将案件押后至11月27日，让控辩双方准备结案陈词。案件随后将进入结案陈词及陪审团商议阶段。 目前，邝港智及另外两名被告邝球、邝港杰均否认谋杀罪。庭上有关案发经过及各被告角色的说法，仍须由陪审团结合全部证据作出判断。 目前，邝港智及另外两名被告邝球、邝港杰均否认谋杀罪。庭上有关案发经过及各被告角色的说法，仍须由陪审团结合全部证据作出判断。

发表于 2026 年 11 月 25 日 05:02

北京—在媒体报道称华盛顿计划宣布对中国和其他国家征收新关税后，北京于11月25日敦促美国“维护贸易关系的稳定发展”。
有媒体报道称，华盛顿的新征税措施将影响中国、欧盟、日本和韩国等美国主要贸易伙伴。
当被问及华盛顿报道的计划时，中国外交部表示，关税战不符合“任何人的利益”。
外交部发言人郭家琨表示，“双方应在平等、尊重、互利的基础上协商解决有关问题”。
“所谓产能过剩是一个错误的前提。中方反对以此为政治操纵的借口，”郭在例行新闻发布会上对记者表示。
一些国家担心中国工业产能过剩 — — 据称北京生产的产品超过消费，导致市场泛滥 — — 可能会扰乱关键行业的全球供应链。
北京否认这些说法。
郭表示，中美双方应“共同努力，切实落实两国元首达成的重要共识，维护中美经贸关系稳定发展”。
中国国家主席习近平和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于 2025 年 10 月在贸易战中达成了脆弱的休战协议，但该休战协议将于 1 月份到期。法新社
