China’s foreign ministry said tariff wars were not in “anyone’s interest”, when asked about Washington’s reported plans.
Published Nov 25, 2026, 05:02 PM
Updated Nov 25, 2026, 05:14 PM
BEIJING – Beijing urged the United States on Nov 25 to “uphold the stable development” of trade relations, after media reports said Washington was planning to announce new tariffs on China and other countries.
Reports from media outlets said that Washington’s new levies would affect major US trading partners including China, the European Union, Japan and South Korea.
China’s foreign ministry said tariff wars were not in “anyone’s interest”, when asked about Washington’s reported plans.
“The two sides should resolve relevant issues through consultation on the basis of equality, respect and mutual benefit,” foreign ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said.
“The so-called overcapacity is a false premise. China opposes using it as a pretext for political manipulation,” Guo told reporters at a regular news briefing.
Some nations fear Chinese industrial overcapacity – the claim that Beijing produces more than it consumes, flooding markets – could disrupt global supply chains in critical industries.
Beijing rejects these claims.
Guo said China and the United States should “work together to effectively implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and uphold the stable development of China-US economic and trade relations”.
Chinese President Xi Jinping and US counterpart Donald Trump reached a tenuous truce in their trade war in October 2025, but this will expire in January. AFP

content:

中柬举行联合军演

第八次“金龙”演习将聚焦“联合反恐反海盗行动”。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 25 日，下午 04:06
更新于 2026 年 11 月 25 日 04:09
中国和柬埔寨于11月25日开始第八次“金龙”演习。金边表示，这是迄今为止规模最大的一次，在三个地点有近3000名人员。
演习重点是“联合反恐反海盗行动”和人道主义救援。这些演习将持续到 12 月中旬，包括陆地、海上和空中演习。
云朗海军基地的开放引起了美国对中国在那里扮演的角色的担忧。柬埔寨表示，演习不会威胁任何第三国，旨在“加强共同和平和人道主义救援”。
金边 — — 坚定的盟友中国和柬埔寨于 11 月 25 日开始联合军事演习，金边称这是迄今为止最大规模的一次联合军事演习，三个地点有近 3000 名人员参加。
中国国防部在一份声明中表示，第八次“金龙”演习将重点关注“联合反恐、反海盗行动”以及人道主义救援，并将持续到12月中旬。
开幕式在位于泰国湾柬埔寨南部海岸的云朗海军基地举行，中国对该基地的改造工程引起了美国的担忧。
华盛顿表示，该基地最初部分由美国资金建造，可以让中国在有争议的南海附近获得关键的战略地位，北京声称对南海几乎整个海域拥有主权。
柬埔寨领导人一再否认该基地可供任何单一外国势力使用，今年一月，一艘美国军舰曾停靠该基地。
柬埔寨首相洪马内8月宣布，拖延已久的与美国的联合军演将于2027年重启。
两国举行了长达七年的联合演习，但金边于 2017 年初取消了联合演习，而就在与中国举行首次金龙演习几个月后。
柬埔寨国防部长蒂西哈在11月25日的讲话中表示，与中国的演习“无意威胁或对任何第三国造成影响”。
相反，他表示演习是对国际社会“加强共同和平和人道主义救援”的贡献。
他说，这些行动涵盖了陆地、海上和空中的行动，涉及军舰、无人机、直升机、装甲车、火炮和指挥系统。
柬埔寨皇家武装部队 (RCAF) 高级军官 Pen Sokrethvithyea 表示，这次演习的规模比 2025 年的演习规模还要大，而 2025 年的演习规模被称为有史以来规模最大的一次。
他说，有超过 2,900 名人员参与其中，其中约 1,300 名中国人。
皇家空军表示，2025年有近900名中国军人和1300多名柬埔寨士兵参加。
中国国防部表示，2026年的演习旨在“加强政治互信，扩大军事交流”。法新社

China and Cambodia stage joint military drills
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
The eighth “Golden Dragon” exercises will focus on “joint counterterrorism and anti-piracy operations”.
Published Nov 25, 2026, 04:06 PM
Updated Nov 25, 2026, 04:09 PM
China and Cambodia began their eighth "Golden Dragon" drills on Nov 25. Phnom Penh said they are the largest yet, with nearly 3,000 personnel at three sites.
The exercises focus on "joint counterterrorism and anti-piracy operations" and humanitarian relief. They run until mid-December and include land, sea and air drills.
The Ream Naval Base opening drew US concern over China’s role there. Cambodia said the drills do not threaten any third country and aim to "strengthen shared peace and humanitarian relief".
PHNOM PENH – Staunch allies China and Cambodia began joint military exercises on Nov 25, which Phnom Penh said were the largest yet, featuring nearly 3,000 personnel across three locations.
The eighth “Golden Dragon” exercises will focus on “joint counterterrorism and anti-piracy operations” as well as humanitarian relief, and run until mid-December, China’s defence ministry said in a statement.
The opening ceremony was held at Ream Naval Base, located off Cambodia’s southern coast in the Gulf of Thailand, where Chinese renovations have raised US concerns.
Washington says the base – which was originally built partly with US funds – could give China a key strategic position near the disputed South China Sea, which Beijing claims almost in its entirety.
Cambodian leaders have repeatedly denied the base is for use by any single foreign power, and in January, a US warship made a port call there.
Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet announced in August that long-delayed joint military exercises with the United States would restart in 2027.
The two nations staged joint exercises for seven years before Phnom Penh scrapped them in early 2017, just months after holding its first Golden Dragon drills with China.
In remarks on Nov 25, Cambodian Defence Minister Tea Seiha said the exercises with China have “no intention of threatening or causing impact to any third country”.
Instead, he said the drills were a contribution to the international community “to strengthen shared peace and humanitarian relief”.
He said they covered operations on land, at sea and in the air, involving warships, drones, helicopters, armoured vehicles, artillery and command systems.
Royal Cambodian Armed Forces (RCAF) senior officer Pen Sokrethvithyea said they were bigger than 2025’s drills, which had been billed as the largest ever.
More than 2,900 personnel were involved, around 1,300 of them Chinese, he said.
In 2025, the RCAF said nearly 900 Chinese military personnel and more than 1,300 Cambodian soldiers took part.
The Chinese defence ministry said 2026’s exercises were aimed at “strengthening political mutual trust and expanding military exchanges”. AFP

content:
本月的 11 天里，硅谷给人的印象是，尽管困难重重，它最终还是要经历真正的耻辱时刻。首先，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认，他与一名涉嫌间谍的中国女商人欺骗了他的妻子，这让他的公司、它所支撑的人工智能行业以及国家安全面临风险。他深表歉意。随后有报道称，黄仁勋还与英伟达的一名高管有染，随后他辞职了。硅谷的一位巨头似乎正面临清算。但昨晚深夜，唐纳德·特朗普在 Truth Social 上发帖称，“我希望英伟达董事会重新聘用黄仁勋。”总统写道，这一结果“对于公司以及美国来说都是最好的事情”。这句话显然既是命令，又是愿望。今天上午，英伟达董事会宣布一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官。总统随后发布了一个表情包，即使对他来说也是怪诞的：一张看似人工智能生成的黄的图像，脸上受伤流血，举起拳头握紧红色胸罩，背景中飘扬着英伟达的旗帜——当然，这是模仿特朗普第一次暗杀企图后不久拍摄的照片。真是太羞耻了。 [阅读：A] 价值 5.7 万亿美元的面部植物 值得强调的是，黄的丑闻有多么严重。
他承认与一名中国女商人有关系，该女商人涉嫌将英伟达芯片走私到中国，从而规避美国的出口管制，同时他还在不知疲倦地游说放松限制，以防止美国芯片落入中国竞争者之手。对于像英伟达这样的公司来说，这是一个惊天动地的启示：英伟达基本上垄断了用于训练最先进人工智能模型的芯片。这使得该公司变得异常富有——今年早些时候，其估值达到创纪录的 5.7 万亿美元。反过来，黄仁勋利用这笔财富来支持人工智能经济的大部分，为各种数据中心和初创企业提供资金，作为一种财务支持。黄先生辞职后，华尔街经历了近期记忆中最糟糕的一周之一。自他辞职以来，有关第三次婚外情和滥用管理风格的进一步报道只会让黄的处境变得更糟。几乎任何其他行业发生类似丑闻都会导致普遍的政治谴责，并且该公司及其同行都试图与这位名誉扫地的前高管保持距离。但这里恰恰相反。据《纽约时报》报道，特朗普和副总统万斯周末敦促英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋的职位。
今天早上宣布这一消息后，特朗普几乎立即在《真相社交》上发帖，庆祝恢复“伟大爱国者和国宝”黄蜂的“正确和恰当”决定。硅谷的气氛十分热烈：消息传出后，该公司股价上涨了 30% 以上，投资者和科技高管爆发出热烈的掌声。对冲基金经理比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 在 X 上写道：“大众的智慧占了上风。”黄的直言不讳的支持者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 补充道：“错误已被纠正。”硅谷许多最有权势的人物似乎都被证明是正确的——毕竟，他们淡化并认为黄的愚蠢行为只是简单的错误和失常。事实上，整个事情——鲁莽和丑闻以及随后的有罪不罚——是科技界的常态。硅谷

【原文 English Original】
For 11 days this month, Silicon Valley gave the impression that it would finally, against all odds, subject itself to a genuine moment of shame. First, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having cheated on his wife with a Chinese businesswoman suspected of being a spy, putting his company, the AI industry it undergirds, and the nation’s security at risk. He apologized profusely. Then it was reported that Huang had had another affair, this one with an Nvidia executive, and he resigned. It seemed that one of Silicon Valley’s titans was facing a reckoning. But late last night, Donald Trump posted on Truth Social, “I hope the Board of Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang.” This outcome, the president wrote , “would be the best thing for the Company, and also, for the U.S.A.” Those words were evidently as much a command as they were a wish. This morning, Nvidia’s board of directors announced that it had unanimously voted to reinstate Huang as CEO. The president then posted a meme that, even for him, was grotesque: a seemingly AI-generated image of Huang, face bloodied from a wound, raising a fist clenching a red brassiere with an Nvidia flag waving in the background—modeled, of course, on the photo taken just after the first assassination attempt on Trump. So much for shame. [ Read:A ] $5.7 Trillion Face-Plant It’s worth underscoring just how damning Huang’s scandals were. He admitted to having a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman tied to a company that was suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China—thereby sidestepping U.S. export controls—at the same time that he was lobbying tirelessly to ease restrictions meant to keep American chips out of the hands of Chinese competition. For a company in Nvidia’s position, it was an earth-shattering revelation: Nvidia essentially has a monopoly on the chips used to train the most advanced AI models. That has made the firm spectacularly wealthy—earlier this year, it was valued at a record $5.7 trillion. Huang, in turn, used that wealth to underwrite much of the AI economy, funding all manner of data centers and start-ups as a sort of financial backstop. Huang’s resignation was followed by one of the worst weeks on Wall Street in recent memory. Further reports since his resignation—of a third affair and an abusive management style—only made Huang come off worse. A similar scandal in almost any other industry would result in universal political condemnation and an attempt, by both the company and its peers, to distance themselves from the disgraced former executive. But it’s just the opposite here. The New York Times has reported that Trump and Vice President Vance spent the weekend pushing Nvidia’s board to reinstate Huang. Almost immediately after this morning’s announcement, Trump posted on Truth Social to celebrate “the correct and proper” decision to restore Huang, a “Great Patriot and National Treasure.” The mood in Silicon Valley is ebullient: The company’s stock jumped by more than 30 percent on the news, and investors and tech executives have erupted in an ovation. “The wisdom of the crowd prevails,” the hedge-fund manager Bill Ackman wrote on X. Elon Musk, a vocal Huang supporter, added : “The mistake has been corrected.” Many of Silicon Valley’s most powerful characters seem vindicated—after all, they downplayed and dismissed Huang’s follies as simple mistakes and aberrations. In fact, the whole thing—recklessness and scandal followed by impunity—is the norm in the tech world. Silicon Valley has developed a reputation for generosity and forgiveness when it comes to its own sins. Musk has appeared to endorse racist and xenophobic conspiracy theories but sits on a multitrillion-dollar empire of businesses. Meta has been credibly accused of fueling ethnic violence, enabling the spread of misinformation, and harming children through addictive product design—the latter for which it agreed to a major settlement this summer—but remains among the largest companies in the world, and is structured such that Mark Zuckerberg basically cannot be fired. Almost exactly three years ago, Sam Altman was fired from OpenAI for being “not consistently candid” with the firm’s board of directors, only to be reinstated within days after Microsoft and other major investors rallied behind him. Now the entire AI industry is rushing headlong to build products that are jeopardizing the internet as we know it and, per AI executives’ own warnings, could destroy the planet. Meanwhile, Anthropic employees, post–public offering, are estimated to be worth more than the bottom third of U.S. households. Over the past week and a half, legions of tech CEOs came out in support of Huang. “America needs to have more Jensens,” Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas said last Monday. This morning, the investor Chamath Palihapitiya wrote on X that Nvidia’s decision “prevented a massive economic own goal.” Just business as usual for some of the wealthiest companies in the world. (Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.) Altman, asked last week about whether he thought Huang should return, demurred but said he felt “personal strong empathy” for his (soon-to-be) fellow ex-ex-CEO. This morning, Altman posted a single word: “Jensen!” Huang’s return underscores the most important and perhaps singular value driving Silicon Valley: winning. Today that means more chips and data centers, more powerful AI models, greater revenues, soaring stock prices and valuations. Integrity, candor, atonement, and consequences seem like secondary concerns. The repercussions of the industry’s failures—wild swings in the stock market, technologies that wreak havoc on other industries and individual lives, a corrosion of cultural decency—are for everyone else to manage. Personal victory also happens to be one of the president’s major motivations. Trump has aligned himself with every tech CEO he deems successful—Altman, Apple’s Tim Cook, and most of all Huang, who is once again arguably the most influential CEO in the world. Earlier this year, in a now infamous interview, Huang said that “you’re not talking to somebody who woke up a loser.” Today, Silicon Valley decided to embrace its once and future king, whatever mistakes he made. After just 11 days of losing, Huang woke up winning once again.

title: Hong Kong cinema takes spotlight at Taiwan’s Golden Horse film awards
zh_title: 香港电影在台湾金马奖上备受瞩目
summary: 周日，两部受香港民主运动启发的电影在台湾金马奖上获奖，其中一部获奖感言献给了“监狱里的人”。 2026 年 11 月 22 日，在台北举行的第 63 届台湾金马奖颁奖典礼上，香港女演员袁咏仪凭借电影《余韵》获得最佳女主角奖后摆姿势拍照。照片：I-Hwa Cheng/法新社。 《三只小猪》是一部黑色幽默电影，讲述了香港两个青少年偷猪头的故事，在这场被誉为华语电影的盛会上获得了最佳真人短片奖。
content:
周日，两部受香港民主运动启发的电影在台湾金马奖上获奖，其中一部获奖感言献给了“监狱里的人”。 2026 年 11 月 22 日，在台北举行的第 63 届台湾金马奖颁奖典礼上，香港女演员袁咏仪凭借电影《余韵》获得最佳女主角奖后摆姿势拍照。照片：I-Hwa Cheng/法新社。 《三只小猪》是一部黑色幽默电影，讲述了香港两名青少年偷猪头的故事，在这场被誉为华语奥斯卡的盛会上获得了最佳真人短片奖。 《出发的场景》探讨了一位香港电影制片人和他关系疏远的父亲之间的关系，该片赢得了最佳纪录片奖。故事背景是 2019 年该市发生大规模、有时甚至是暴力的民主抗议活动。次年，北京实施了一项国家安全法，批评者称该法压制了异议。香港随后于 2024 年颁布了一项本土法规，用于审判活动人士和抗议领袖。 《三只小猪》的代表罗安迪周日在台上代表导演锺锦尼和其他剧组人员发表获奖感言时表示：“也许我们的作品会在一瞬间被监狱里的人看到，成为他们心中微小而坚定的光芒，成为真正的陪伴。” “我想把这个奖项献给每一位曾经或仍在监狱里的‘小猪’。
我们将来还会见面的。”另一部香港电影《生来就好》（讲述了一名前囚犯在城里遇见了一位苦苦挣扎的年轻演员的故事）获得了最佳影片和最佳原创剧本奖。台湾导演徐震杰凭借《双喜》击败了日本资深导演田中宏之（专业名称为“萨布”），夺得最佳导演奖。自从一名台湾导演在 2018 年的获奖感言中表示支持台湾独立以来，“非常自豪”的中国导演和一线明星基本上回避了金马奖。北京声称自治民主的台湾是其领土的一部分，在两地政治紧张局势加剧之际，2019 年禁止演艺人员参加金马奖。尽管如此，许多香港明星还是出现在今年台北颁奖典礼的红地毯上。另请参阅：香港电影无视警告，在台湾金马奖上强势亮相 凭借《余韵》中的表演获得最佳女主角的袁安琪表示，她“非常自豪”能够成为“众多获奖的香港电影人之一”。台湾刘冠廷凭借《双喜》获得最佳男主角奖。香港演员兼男子组合成员江业生凭借《我们什么都不是》中的角色获得最佳男配角奖。台湾演员、两届金马奖得主舒淇凭借《女孩》获得最佳新人导演奖，这是她受自己童年启发的导演处女作。
首次担任颁奖典礼主持人的香港演员威尔·柯表示：“今年入围的影片来自各地……金马奖真是汇聚了各地的华语电影。”好莱坞明星赞达亚、杰森·莫玛惊喜现身，与《沙丘》搭档、金马主席张震一起通过视频亮相，共同颁奖。

【原文 English Original】
Two films inspired by Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement won gongs at Taiwan’s Golden Horse Awards on Sunday, with one acceptance speech dedicated to “those in prison”. Hong Kong actress Angela Yuen poses for photos after winning Best Leading Actress for the movie Afterpiece at Taiwan’s 63rd Golden Horse film awards ceremony, in Taipei on November 22, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng/AFP. “Three Little Pigs”, a dark-humour film about two teenagers in Hong Kong on a mission to steal a pig’s head, picked up the prize for best live action short film at the prestigious event, dubbed the Chinese-language Oscars. “Scenes from Departure”, which explores the relationship between a Hong Kong filmmaker and his estranged father, won best documentary feature. It is set against the backdrop of the city’s huge and sometimes violent pro-democracy protests in 2019. The following year, Beijing imposed a national security law that critics say has quelled dissent. Hong Kong then enacted a homegrown code in 2024, with both used to try activists and protest leaders. Andy Law, a representative for “Three Little Pigs” delivering an acceptance speech on behalf of director Chung Kam-nei and other crew members, said on stage on Sunday: “Maybe in one instant our work will be seen by those in prison, becoming a small yet unwavering light for them, and genuine companionship.” “I want to dedicate this award to every ‘little pig’ who has been or is still in prison. We’ll see each other in the future.” Another Hong Kong film, “We Are Born Good” — about a former prisoner who meets a struggling young actor in the city — won best film and best original screenplay. Taiwanese director Joseph Hsu Chen-chieh bagged the best director award for “Double Happiness”, beating veteran Japanese director Hiroyuki Tanaka, known professionally as Sabu. ‘Very proud’ Chinese directors and A-listers have largely shunned the Golden Horse Awards since a Taiwanese director voiced support for the island’s independence in an acceptance speech in 2018. Beijing, which claims self-ruled democratic Taiwan as part of its territory, banned entertainers from attending the event in 2019 at a time of rising political tensions between the two sides. Still, many Hong Kong stars were spotted on the red carpet for this year’s ceremony in Taipei. See also: Hong Kong films defy warnings with strong presence at Taiwan’s Golden Horse awards Angela Yuen, who won best leading actress for her performance in “Afterpiece”, said she was “very proud” to be among “many Hong Kong filmmakers who won awards”. Taiwan’s Liu Kuan-ting won best leading actor for “Double Happiness”. Hong Kong actor and boy band member Anson Kong Ip-sang picked up the prize for best supporting actor for his role in “We’re Nothing at All”. Taiwanese actor and two-time Golden Horse winner Shu Qi won best new director for “Girl”, her directorial debut inspired by her own childhood. “This year quite a lot of the nominated films come from everywhere… the Golden Horse Awards really bring together Chinese-language films from different places,” said Hong Kong actor Will Or, who made his debut as host of the ceremony. In a surprise appearance, Hollywood stars Zendaya and Jason Momoa joined via video to jointly present an award with their “Dune” co-star and Golden Horse chairman Chang Chen.

title: US blacklists Megaspeed, but leaves potential loophole for lower-performance chips
zh_title: 美国将 Megaspeed 列入黑名单，但为低性能芯片留下了潜在漏洞
summary: 由于担心先进人工智能加速器转移到中国，美国商务部已将 Megaspeed 及其六个附属实体添加到其实体名单中。然而，与之前增加涉嫌类似活动的公司不同的是，该部门没有对 Megaspeed 应用特殊外国直接产品规则 (FDPR)，这引发了人们对限制有效性的质疑。虽然这一遗漏可能会限制制裁的范围，但美国现有的出口管制仍应限制 Megaspeed 获得 AMD 和 Nvidia 的先进处理器。 F
content:
由于担心先进人工智能加速器转移到中国，美国商务部已将 Megaspeed 及其六个附属实体添加到其实体名单中。然而，与之前增加涉嫌类似活动的公司不同的是，该部门没有对 Megaspeed 应用特殊外国直接产品规则 (FDPR)，这引发了人们对限制有效性的质疑。虽然这一遗漏可能会限制制裁的范围，但美国现有的出口管制仍应限制 Megaspeed 获得 AMD 和 Nvidia 的先进处理器。据称是中国情报人员的 Megaspeed 前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 是黄仁勋丑闻的核心女性，该丑闻导致英伟达首席执行官辞职，然后在最近几天又恢复了公司负责人的职位。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc）
芯片制裁上的反复无常，中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体推动状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，拥有第六座大型晶圆厂，占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释 美国外交关系委员会研究员、曾在国家安全委员会处理出口管制问题的前拜登政府官员克里斯·麦奎尔 (Chris McGuire) 指出，无论是 Megaspeed 还是这六家工厂中的任何一家相关实体在实体名单上获得了所谓的脚注 4 指定。据麦奎尔称，商务部此前已将这一指定应用于因担心获得先进人工智能处理器而被列入黑名单的中国公司。 McGuire 声称，如果不应用实体清单特定的 FDPR，新的限制基本上不会影响 Megaspeed 采购 Nvidia 的 AI 处理器的能力，因为虽然这些处理器是在美国开发的，但绝大多数是由台湾的台积电生产的。虽然麦奎尔承认新的美国
11 月 19 日生效的出口管制已经要求向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印度尼西亚和巴西运送高端人工智能加速器需要获得许可证，但美国公司及其子公司可以豁免（即谷歌或微软可以为其在上述国家的数据中心获得基于 Rubin 的机器，但 Megaspeed 或其他本地企业不能），他质疑 Megaspeed 在没有脚注 4 的情况下添加到实体名单的理由。有必要指出的是，新的全国范围内的控制规定了许可证要求，而不是彻底禁止，而将 Megaspeed 添加到实体名单将使许可证申请被推定为拒绝，这就是为什么即使没有脚注 4，指定也具有实际效果的原因。同时，McGuire 表示，这种遗漏可能是监管疏忽，也可能是缩小限制范围的故意决定。未经工业与安全局 (BIS) 许可，实体名单上的公司通常无法采购受美国出口管理条例 (EAR) 约束的产品。此类许可证申请的审查将推定为拒绝，这肯定涉及 Megaspeed 及其相关实体。脚注 4 大幅扩大了 EAR 管辖的产品范围，将使用美国技术或使用美国技术制造的外国制造的商品包括在内。与此同时，先进的人工智能加速器

【原文 English Original】
The U.S. Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed and six affiliated entities to its Entity List due to concerns about diversion of advanced AI accelerators to China. However, unlike previous additions of companies suspected of similar activities, the department did not apply a special foreign direct product rule (FDPR) designation to Megaspeed, which raised questions about the effectiveness of the restrictions. While the omission potentially limits the scope of the sanctions, existing U.S. export controls should still restrict Megaspeed's access to advanced processors from AMD and Nvidia. Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang , allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset , is the woman at the heart of the Jensen Huang scandal, which saw Nvidia's CEO resign and then be reinstated as head of the company in recent days . Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Chris McGuire , a fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations and a former Biden administration official who dealt with export controls at the National Security Council, noted that neither Megaspeed nor any of the six associated entities received a so-called Footnote 4 designation on the Entity List. According to McGuire, the Department of Commerce had previously applied the designation to Chinese companies blacklisted over concerns about their access to advanced AI processors. McGuire claims that without the application of the Entity List-specific FDPR, the new restrictions will have essentially no effect on Megaspeed's ability to procure Nvidia's AI processors since, while they are developed in the U.S., the vast majority of them are produced by TSMC in Taiwan. While McGuire acknowledged that new U.S. export controls that took effect on November 19 already require licenses for shipments of high-end AI accelerators to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil, with exemptions for U.S.-based companies and their subsidiaries (i.e., Google or Microsoft can get Rubin-based machines for their data centers in the said countries, but Megaspeed or other local players cannot), he questioned the rationale behind Megaspeed's addition to the Entity List without Footnote 4. It is necessary to note that the new country-wide controls impose a license requirement, not an outright ban, whereas the addition of Megaspeed to the Entity List subjects license applications to a presumption of denial, which is a reason why the designation has practical effect even without Footnote 4. Meanwhile, McGuire suggested that the omission could be either a regulatory oversight or a deliberate decision to reduce the scope of restrictions. Companies on the Entity List typically cannot procure products subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) without a license from the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS). Such license applications are reviewed with a presumption of denial, and this certainly concerns Megaspeed and entities linked to it. Footnote 4 substantially expands the scope of products subject to the EAR to include foreign-made goods that use American technology or are made using American technologies. Meanwhile, advanced AI accelerators from AMD and Nvidia are already subject to a separate Advanced Computing FDPR (§734.9(h) of the EAR), which has worldwide geographical coverage irrespective of where the chips are made. In fact, BIS explicitly retained the worldwide scope of this provision in its November 19 amendments to the EAR. Therefore, Megaspeed's addition to the Entity List should effectively cut the company off from qualifying advanced AI accelerators even in the absence of Footnote 4. What the absence of Footnote 4 could mean, though, is that Megaspeed may retain access to certain foreign-made lower-performance AI GPUs, networking chips, and other data center hardware that falls outside the scope of the EAR. At this point, it remains unclear whether the Department of Commerce deliberately opted for a narrower set of restrictions. Meanwhile, Malaysia's Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry announced on Tuesday that it would advise all data center operators in the country against the provision of infrastructure, space, or services to the seven blacklisted entities, a move that could affect Megaspeed's ability to operate its existing AI infrastructure in Malaysia, regardless of the scope of U.S. export restrictions.

title: 黄仁勋回归后股民仍可起诉英伟达，负责诉讼的律师称索赔权利不受影响，但需关注一关键指标，咨询加入集体诉讼的股东数量激增
summary: 黄仁勋回归复职英伟达CEO的消息，在全球资本市场掀起巨浪。 在经历了黄仁勋回归当日的暴涨之后，美国AI产业链的好日子只停留了一天。24日美股半导体板块全线重挫，费城半导体指数跌近8%，美光科技跌11%，英伟达跌近6%。25日韩股下挫5%，三星电子大跌9%，软银重挫16%。 过山车一般的行情让投资者倍感煎熬，此前因黄仁勋离职事件发起集体诉讼的英伟达股东不禁发问：在瞬息万变的形势下，这起诉讼是否还有存在的合理性？黄仁勋的回归是否意味着已将此前的错误全部“清零”？ 负责其中部分诉讼
content: 黄仁勋回归复职英伟达CEO的消息，在全球资本市场掀起巨浪。 在经历了黄仁勋回归当日的暴涨之后，美国AI产业链的好日子只停留了一天。24日美股半导体板块全线重挫，费城半导体指数跌近8%，美光科技跌11%，英伟达跌近6%。25日韩股下挫5%，三星电子大跌9%，软银重挫16%。 过山车一般的行情让投资者倍感煎熬，此前因黄仁勋离职事件发起集体诉讼的英伟达股东不禁发问：在瞬息万变的形势下，这起诉讼是否还有存在的合理性？黄仁勋的回归是否意味着已将此前的错误全部“清零”？ 负责其中部分诉讼的美国联邦律师刘龙珠对红星新闻记者表示，黄仁勋回归完全不影响投资者的索赔权利，因为“将来的事情还没有发生，诉讼本身针对的就是过去已经发生的事情”。 刘龙珠表示，诉讼针对的是黄仁勋和英伟达董事会过去“对重大信息不披露”和“对外传递错误信息”的实质错误。 刘龙珠告诉记者，近期咨询加入集体诉讼的英伟达股东越来越多，现在到了近1000人的规模，“诉讼案件会一直做下去，坚定地向前走，但是诉讼的策略会有所调整。” 刘龙珠表示，诉讼的一个关键的指标是看“从11月9日起90天内（英伟达）股价的波动情况”。如果后续英伟达股价一路看涨，对于一直坚持没有卖出的投资者来说亏损幅度减小，的确会影响到“索赔规模和金额的计算方式”。那么，如果英伟达后续抹平此前“腰斩”的全部跌幅，投资者还能否收到赔偿？对此刘龙珠表示，需要看情况精确计算。 当地时间11月23日，黄仁勋重返位于圣克拉拉的英伟达公司总部，受到员工的热烈欢迎。 黄仁勋复职带火2.8万元迪奥夹克 中国官网多个尺寸已售罄 据多方报道确认，黄仁勋复职所穿深蓝色夹克的品牌为迪奥。记者通过 迪奥官方客服 也获得确认， 黄仁勋复职当天所穿 的深蓝色夹克就是该品牌的产品。 图 / 迪奥中国官网截图 迪奥中国官网显示 ， 这款 “ 深蓝色 夹克 ”的描述为“深蓝色棉质华达呢面料， Dior Moulures 图案刺绣拉链衬衫”， 100% 棉，意大利制造， 售价为 28000 元人民币，目前多 个 尺寸已经售罄；在得物平台上，同款标价 16892 元。 这不是黄仁勋第一次穿这件夹克。今年 6 月访问首尔时，他就已经穿过该件外套。 这不是黄仁勋第一次穿这件夹克。今年 6 月访问首尔时，他就已经穿过该件外套。

【看中国2026年11月25日讯】（看中国记者辛静报导）美国关税政策再添变数。据外媒报导，川普政府最快可能于本周公布针对“结构性产能过剩”的301条款调查结果，并研议对中国、欧盟等16个经济体提高进口关税。对此，行政院发言人李慧芝表示，台湾政府持续与美方保持密切联系，即使美方公布调查报告并提出建议税率，后续仍须经过公听会等程序，才能确定最终关税安排。李慧芝指出，台湾政府有信心，301条款调查的最终结果将会反映先前的谈判成果。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
《华尔街日报》报导，知情人士透露，美国贸易代表葛里尔最快可能于本周公布一项历时数月的关税调查结果，调查重点涉及中国、欧盟及其他14个经济体的产业补贴措施。美国贸易代表署此次公布调查结果，可能成为美国进一步提高关税的讯号，意味着数十个国家未来恐将面临更高的进口关税。
中央社11月25日报导，对此，李慧芝11月25日指出，参照美方先前针对强迫劳动问题展开的301条款调查，公布报告只是整个程序中的一个环节，并不代表最终税率已经拍板。台湾将持续与美方沟通，若有进一步进展，政府会适时对外说明。
她强调，台美双方先前已签署对等贸易协定（ART）及投资合作备忘录（MOU），台湾取得15%的对等关税税率，而且不与其他关税叠加，享有相对优惠的待遇。
针对美方目前进行的“结构性产能过剩”及“强迫劳动”两项301条款调查，李慧芝表示，政府有信心，最终调查结果将充分反映台美双方先前的谈判成果。

summary: 黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日抵达日本横须贺舰队活动司令部。美国海军照片 两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 和两栖运输船坞号 USS 约翰·P·默斯 a (LPD-26) 于周二从新加坡三巴旺出发，前往印度洋。根据当地船舶观察员和 AIS 数据，马金岛号和约翰·P·默塔号随第 13 海军陆战队远征部队的部队出发，正在通过马六甲海峡向北航行。 AIS数据显示两艘船当时位于马六甲以南的马六甲海峡
content:
黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日抵达日本横须贺舰队活动司令部。美国海军照片 两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 和两栖运输船坞号 USS 约翰·P·默斯 a (LPD-26) 于周二从新加坡三巴旺出发，前往印度洋。根据当地船舶观察员和 AIS 数据，马金岛号和约翰·P·默塔号随第 13 海军陆战队远征部队的部队出发，正在通过马六甲海峡向北航行。 AIS数据显示，两艘船于晚上10点位于马来西亚首都吉隆坡以南的马六甲海峡。当地时间，美国海军拉帕汉诺克号舰队加油船 (T-AO-204)。马金岛、约翰·P·穆萨、两栖运输船坞舰安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和已登船的第 13 远征远征队组成了马金岛两栖准备大队。安克雷奇及其第 13 海军陆战队远征部队分队目前驻扎在日本横须贺司令舰队活动司令部 (CFAY)。据 USNI News 此前报道，ARG 于 9 月 28 日从圣地亚哥出发。第13远征部队的海军陆战队空地特遣部队包括第13远征部队指挥分队、作为地面作战分队的第2/4营登陆队和作为其后勤分队的第13战斗后勤营。航空中队包括海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364（增援）和海军陆战队战斗机攻击中队 (VMFA) 211，其中包括 MV-22B 鱼鹰、CH-53、AH-1Z 毒蛇和 F-35B 闪电 II。
ARG 于 10 月初驶入夏威夷进行港口访问，然后穿越太平洋。安克雷奇于 10 月 21 日至 22 日对关岛进行了短暂访问，然后重新加入 ARG，并于 10 月 26 日驶入 CFAY 进行港口访问。所有三艘 ARG 舰艇均于 11 月 7 日从 CFAY 出发，与约翰·P·穆萨号和安克雷奇号一起参加“马拉巴尔 2026”演习的海上阶段，这是澳大利亚、日本、印度和美国“四方”伙伴关系下的年度海军演习。演习于 11 月 5 日至 12 日在横须贺及其周边地区举行。印度海军什瓦里克级隐形多用途护卫舰INS Sahyadri (F 49)、日本海上自卫队日向级直升机驱逐舰JS Ise (DDH 182)、最上级护卫舰JS Mogami (FFM 1)、澳大利亚皇家海军安扎克级护卫舰HMAS Stuart (FFH 153)和美国海军圣安东尼奥级两栖运输舰2026 年马拉巴尔演习期间，美国海军安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和约翰·P·穆萨 (LPD-26) 号船坞编队在西太平洋航行，2026 年 11 月 7 日。美国海军照片 与约翰·P·穆萨和安克雷奇一起参加演习的有日本海上自卫队直升机驱逐舰 JS 伊势 (DDH-182)、护卫舰 JS 最上(FFM-1)、一艘日本海上自卫队潜艇、印度海军护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F49)、澳大利亚皇家海军护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH153)、一架美国海军 P-8A 海神海上巡逻机和一架日本海上自卫队 P-1 MPA。演习活动包括海军炮火、反水面战演习和反潜战演习。伊势和约翰·P.

Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) pulls in to Commander, Fleet Activities, Yokosuka, Japan, Oct. 26, 2026. US Navy photo Amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) and amphibious transport dock USS John P. Murth a (LPD-26) departed Tuesday from Sembawang, Singapore, and are heading toward the Indian Ocean. Makin Island and John P. Murtha , embarked with elements of the 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit, are transiting north through the Malacca Strait, according to local ship spotters and AIS data. AIS data shows the two ships were in the Malacca Strait south of Malaysia’s capital of Kuala Lumpur at 10 p.m. local time with fleet oiler USNS Rappahannock (T-AO-204). Makin Island , John P. Murtha , amphibious transport dock USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and the embarked 13th MEU form the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group. Anchorage and its embarked 13th MEU elements are currently at Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka (CFAY), Japan. The ARG departed from San Diego on Sept. 28, USNI News previously reported . The 13th MEU’s Marine Air-Ground Task Force includes the 13th MEU command element, Battalion Landing Team 2/4 as the Ground Combat Element and Combat Logistics Battalion 13 as its logistic element. The aviation squadrons are Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 364 (Reinforced) and Marine Fighter Attack Squadron (VMFA) 211, which includes MV-22B Ospreys, CH-53s, AH-1Z Vipers and F-35B Lightning IIs. The ARG pulled into Hawaii for a port visit in early October before transiting the Pacific. Anchorage made a short visit to Guam from Oct. 21-22 before rejoining the ARG, which pulled into CFAY on Oct. 26 for a port visit. All three ARG ships departed Nov. 7 from CFAY with John P. Murtha and Anchorage participating in the sea phase of Exercise Malabar 2026, an annual naval exercise under the “Quad” partnership of Australia, Japan, India and the U.S. The exercise ran from Nov. 5-12 in and around Yokosuka. Indian Navy Shivalik-class stealth multi-role frigate INS Sahyadri (F 49), Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Hyuga-class helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH 182), Mogami-class frigate JS Mogami (FFM 1), Royal Australian Navy Anzac-class frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH 153) and U.S. Navy San Antonio-class amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) sail in formation in the Western Pacific Ocean during Exercise Malabar 2026, Nov. 7, 2026. US Navy photo Participating in the drills alongside John P. Murtha and Anchorage were Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH-182), frigate JS Mogami (FFM-1), a JMSDF submarine, Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri (F49), Royal Australian Navy frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH153), a U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon Maritime Patrol Aircraft and a JMSDF P-1 MPA. Exercise activities included naval gunfire, anti-surface warfare drills and anti-submarine warfare drills. Ise and John P. Murtha carried out reciprocal visit, board, search, and seizure (VBSS) drills . Following completion of Malabar 2026, John P. Murtha headed out to the Philippine Sea to join Makin Island . Anchorage anchored offshore at Yokosuka on Nov. 13 and docked into CFAY on Nov. 16, taking the space vacated by departing submarine tender USS Frank Cable (AS-40), according to local ship spotters . Makin Island and John P. Murtha transited the South China Sea and pulled into Sembawang, Singapore on Friday for a port visit. The Navy nor the Pentagon has said whether Anchorage will join Makin Island and John P. Murtha . Makin Island and John P. Murtha are heading towards the Indian Ocean. Makin Island and John P. Murtha are expected to relieve the Boxer ARG in the Middle East. The Boxer ARG, which includes amphibious assault ship USS Boxer (LHD-4), amphibious dock landing ship USS Comstock (LSD-45) and amphibious transport dock USS Portland (LPD-27) and the embarked 11th MEU, deployed out from the West Coast in March, USNI News reported , putting it at eight months deployed. Boxer and Comstock were operating in U.S. Central Command as of Monday while Portland was operating in U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations, according to the USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker .

title: China’s Naval Developments Set For The Spotlight At Zhuhai Airshow
zh_title: 中国海军发展成为珠海航展的焦点
summary: 中国人民解放军海军表示，正在准备在即将于珠海举行的第十六届中国国际航空航天博览会上进行重要亮相，军舰、舰载机、先进武器系统和无人平台将成为重点展示。扩大后的海军部分将包括在海湾另一边的高栏港设立一个新的海事装备展区，这标志着解放军海军首次在此次活动中设立这样的专门展示区。珠海已成为国际防务、航空领域最重要的赛事之一
content:
中国人民解放军海军表示，正在准备在即将于珠海举行的第十六届中国国际航空航天博览会上进行重要亮相，军舰、舰载机、先进武器系统和无人平台将成为重点展示。扩大后的海军部分将包括在海湾另一边的高栏港设立一个新的海事装备展区，这标志着解放军海军首次在此次活动中设立这样的专门展示区。珠海已成为国际国防和航空航天史上最重要的活动之一，成为中国快速发展的航空和军事工业的主要公开展示地。两年一度的中国国际航空航天展览会（俗称中国航展）于 1996 年首次举办，为展示中国一些最先进的军事硬件提供了难得的机会，其中包括在其他地方很少如此详细展示的飞机和系统。虽然该活动也是中国航空航天工业向潜在国际客户推广其产品的主要平台，但它日益成为展示新军事能力和提供难以评估的项目的重要场所。
第十五届中国国际航空航天展览会（又称 2024 年中国航展）于 2024 年 11 月 15 日在中国广东省珠海市中国国际航空航天展览中心举行。摄影：VCG/VCG via Getty Images 前几届已经取得了一些特别重大的进展。 2016 年的展会上，J-20 隐形战斗机首次公开飞行亮相，而 2018 年的展会则以不同寻常的方式展示了这架飞机，包括展示其装载空对空导弹的内部武器舱。 2022年的展会上，歼20首次在珠海进行静态展示，同时还有运20重型运输机、直20直升机以及在展会上进行首次飞行演示的运20空中加油机。最近，2024 年的展会特别引人注目的是 J-35A 隐形战斗机的公开亮相和具有弹射能力的 J-15T 舰​​载战斗机的出现。一架 J-15T 舰​​载战斗机在 2024 年中国航展上进行飞行表演。CFOTO/Future Publishing via Getty Images 今年的展览定于 12 月 7 日至 13 日举行，除其他外，将展示中国海军的广泛能力，特别强调其舰载航空能力的快速发展，这一点我们过去已经详细讨论过。
预计将亮相的最引人注目的飞机包括 J-15T 舰载战斗机、作战型 J-35 隐形战斗机、KJ-600 舰载机载预警和控制 (AEW&C) 飞机、Z-20 直升机的几种海军型号，也许最重要的是新型 JL-15 舰载教练机，它是陆基 JL-10 的发展型。JL-15 舰载教练机的照片突出显示了制动钩和弹射器发射杆。虽然我们之前在珠海见过 J-15T，但如果它配备国产 WS-10H2 发动机，将会引起特别的兴趣。这样的配置将让人们更仔细地了解中国舰载侧卫衍生产品的最新演变

【原文 English Original】
China’s People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) says it’s preparing a major presence at the upcoming 16th China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition in Zhuhai, with warships , carrier-based aircraft , advanced weapons systems, and uncrewed platforms set to feature prominently. The expanded naval component will include a new maritime equipment exhibition area at Gaolan Port, located just on the other side of the bay, marking the first time the PLAN has established such a dedicated display at the event. Zhuhai has become one of the most important events on the international defence and aerospace calendar, serving as China’s principal public showcase for its rapidly developing aviation and military industries. First held in 1996, the biennial China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition, commonly known as Airshow China, provides an unusual opportunity to see some of the country’s most advanced military hardware, including aircraft and systems that are rarely shown in such detail elsewhere. While the event also serves as a major platform for China’s aerospace industry to promote its products to potential international customers , it has increasingly become an important venue for revealing new military capabilities and offering glimpses of programs that are otherwise difficult to assess. A general view of the 15th China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition, or Airshow China 2024, at the China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition Center on November 15, 2024, in Zhuhai, Guangdong Province of China. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images Previous editions have produced some particularly significant developments. The 2016 show saw the J-20 stealth fighter make its first public flying appearance , while the 2018 edition provided an unusually revealing look at the aircraft, including a demonstration of its internal weapons bays, loaded with air-to-air missiles . The 2022 exhibition featured the J-20 on static display for the first time at Zhuhai, alongside the Y-20 heavy transport aircraft, Z-20 helicopter, and YY-20 aerial refueling tanker, which made its first flying demonstration at the event. More recently, the 2024 exhibition was particularly notable for the public debut of the J-35A stealth fighter and the appearance of the catapult-capable J-15T carrier-based fighter. A J-15T carrier-based fighter conducts a flight demonstration at Airshow China 2024. CFOTO/Future Publishing via Getty Images This year’s exhibition, scheduled to take place from December 7 to 13, will showcase, among others, a broad range of the PLAN’s capabilities, with a particularly notable emphasis on the rapid evolution of its carrier aviation capabilities, something we have addressed in detail in the past . Among the most noteworthy aircraft expected to feature are the J-15T carrier-based fighter, the operational J-35 stealth fighter, the KJ-600 carrier-based airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) aircraft, several naval variants of the Z-20 helicopter, and, perhaps most significantly, the new JL-15 carrier-capable trainer, a development of the land-based JL-10 . A photo of the JL-15 carrier-capable trainer with the arrestor hook and catapult launch bar highlighted. Chinese internet via X While we have seen the J-15T at Zhuhai before, the aircraft will be of particular interest if it is shown with the indigenous WS-10H2 engine. Such a configuration would offer a closer look at the latest evolution of China’s carrier-based Flanker derivative and its ongoing transition toward a more domestically supported carrier aviation ecosystem. The appearance of the J-35 would be another major highlight. The aircraft represents a significant step in the PLAN’s carrier aviation ambitions, bringing a fifth-generation stealth fighter capability into the carrier air wing. Its presence would provide another opportunity to examine the progress of China’s next-generation naval fighter program. Back in 2014, Zhuhai saw the public debut of the FC-31 fighter demonstrator. At the time, it was still a land-based concept, and export was the main talking point, although there was already speculation about a naval variant, today’s J-35. A People’s Liberation Army Navy J-35 fighter during trials from the carrier Fujian last year. Chinese internet via X Meanwhile, the KJ-600 is arguably one of the most important developments in the PLAN’s carrier aviation ecosystem. The twin-engine turboprop aircraft is designed to provide airborne early warning and battle management capabilities, something that would transform the situational awareness and coordination available to China’s carrier strike groups. One of the first high-definition photos of the KJ-600 carrier-based airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) aircraft. Chinese internet via X Several variants of the Z-20 family are also expected to feature, reflecting the growing importance of helicopters in carrier operations, including airborne anti-submarine warfare, utility, and other maritime support missions. You can read more about the Z-20 family and other Chinese rotary-wing developments in this previous TWZ deep-dive on the topic . A Z-20F, the anti-submarine warfare variant of the naval Z-20 family. Three more naval Z-20s are seen in the hangar behind, including a Z-20J shipborne transport and assault variant. Chinese internet via X Perhaps the most intriguing aircraft on the list, however, is the JL-15. The JL-15 is derived from the Hongdu JL-10, also exported as the L-15 Falcon, a twin-engine advanced jet trainer and lead-in fighter trainer. The navalized development was initially reported to be designated JL-10J, but is now confirmed as being the JL-15. A tailhook-equipped mockup was spotted alongside the aircraft carrier Fujian in 2024. However, its operational status remains unclear, and China is known to have encountered difficulties with its earlier JL-9G naval trainer, whose tailhook was reportedly deleted following structural problems. Regarding the rumoured JL-10J carrier-capable jet trainer, another hint was spotted next to the carrier Fujian: It appears to be an unfinished JL-10J mockup stored on the dockside . So question is: Two tails as shown in the latest CG or just one like the regular JL-10? pic.twitter.com/BM8W8MRGWK — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) March 19, 2024 Its appearance would provide a particularly interesting indication of how China is thinking about training its next generation of carrier-based pilots. A carrier-capable development of the JL-10 would be an important addition to the emerging carrier aviation ecosystem, bridging the gap between conventional jet training and the demanding requirements of operating from an aircraft carrier. The JL-15 also makes an interesting comparison with the U.S. Navy’s somewhat stuttering efforts to introduce a new training jet for its carrier pilots. The U.S. Navy’s Undergraduate Jet Training System (UJTS) program is intended to replace its aging fleet of T-45 Goshawk trainers, but the acquisition effort has encountered considerable difficulties. Earlier this month, we described how Sierra Nevada Corporation (SNC) withdrew its proposed clean-sheet Freedom Jet from the competition, citing concerns over the Navy’s insistence on firm-fixed-price production commitments before the aircraft’s design had sufficiently matured. This leaves the Beechcraft M-346N , based on Leonardo’s established M-346 Master , as the only publicly known remaining contender . The program has also experienced schedule slippage, with the initial contract award now expected in the fourth quarter of Fiscal Year 2027. Perhaps more significant is the difference in the two services’ approaches to carrier aviation training. The U.S. Navy has removed the requirement for its next-generation jet trainer to be capable of operating from an actual aircraft carrier, including carrier qualification and simulated carrier touch-and-goes at land-based facilities. Instead, it increasingly relies on advanced simulation, virtualized training, and assisted carrier landing technologies to prepare pilots for the demands of carrier operations. The JL-15, by contrast, is intended to support carrier-based pilot training. A dedicated carrier-capable trainer could offer China a more direct pathway for preparing pilots for operations aboard its increasingly sophisticated — and expanding — carrier fleet. Taken together, the PLAN aircraft being lined up for Zhuhai this year illustrate the increasingly sophisticated and integrated nature of China’s carrier aviation ambitions . As well as the aircraft carriers and their embarked aircraft, these ambitions also require other surface and subsurface vessels to operate effectively. Uncrewed systems will form another important part of the display. The exhibition will include aerial drones, uncrewed underwater vehicles, and other autonomous platforms, reflecting the PLAN’s growing interest in the potential of uncrewed warfare. Chinese media reports suggest that the WZ-2 uncrewed helicopter will receive its public debut at Zhuhai, while the PLAN may well also want to capitalize on its recent announcement that it had successfully launched and recovered a GJ-21 stealthy flying-wing uncrewed combat air vehicle (UCAV) aboard the Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan . GJ-21. Chinese internet via X A chance to see the GJ-21 up close would be a huge deal, but there are many other naval drone options that could be revealed in more detail. There are likely to be more navalized collaborative combat aircraft (CCA) concepts and developments, especially since the adoption of the electromagnetic aircraft launch system (EMALS) catapult opens up a huge range of possibilities for uncrewed aircraft operating as part of a carrier air wing. Potentially, these could include the mysterious MQ-25-like drone that we recently discussed , the role of which remains unclear. On top of that, constant CCA testing at locations such as Malan suggests there could be much more to discuss than just the systems officially highlighted. Many other naval drones will surely be on display as well, including lower-end attritable concepts. Beyond static displays, China’s navy plans to organize flight demonstrations, formation flights, and simulated operational exercises. Its stated aim is to highlight not only the capabilities of individual platforms but also their ability to operate together in complex maritime environments. Photos have emerged showing apparent rehearsals for the display, presenting examples of the J-15, J-35, and KJ-600 to represent Beijing’s broader carrier air wing ecosystem. Two J-15s, two J-35s, and a KJ-600 purportedly taking part in a rehearsal for a formation fly-over at Zhuhai. Chinese internet via X It is not immediately clear which versions of the J-15 are participating in this formation flight: they could be J-15Ts, but another possibility is the electronic warfare version, the J-15DT , that we have profiled in the past. Regardless, they highlight how China’s carrier aviation ambitions are increasingly focused on catapult-assisted takeoff but arrested recovery (CATOBAR) operations, which offer many advantages . The J-15DT electronic warfare version of the Chinese carrier Flanker is outfitted for operations aboard catapult-equipped flattops like the Fujian . Chinese internet via X For the first time, the exhibition will also include a substantial surface fleet component, making use of the docks at the nearby Gaolan Port. Among the vessels expected to be featured are the Type 075 amphibious assault ship, the Type 055 guided-missile destroyer, and the Type 054A guided-missile frigate. Their presence will offer a public-facing showcase of China’s increasingly sophisticated surface fleet and its expanding range of maritime capabilities. It should also be recalled that it was at Gaolan Port where at least one Chinese uncrewed surface vessel , a distinctive trimaran craft, was first spotted. The Type 055 guided-missile destroyer Nanchang sails during the naval exercise Joint Sea-2021 on October 19, 2021, in the Western part of the Pacific Ocean. Photo by Sun Zifa/China News Service via Getty Images The broader messaging surrounding the exhibition is also notable. According to the PLAN, this year’s displays will place greater emphasis on operational readiness and training, with active-duty equipment that regularly participates in exercises and maritime security missions taking precedence over purely exhibition-oriented displays. This should underscore how Beijing has rapidly spun up its naval capabilities, introducing new and more capable equipment that is increasingly capable of more sustained out-of-area operations. The expanded naval presence at Zhuhai looks set to provide a substantial public showcase of China’s ongoing naval modernization. As well as the combination of the J-15T, J-35, KJ-600, and Z-20 variants, the JL-15 points to an increasingly comprehensive carrier aviation enterprise. And, judging by previous editions of the show, there will almost certainly be more novelties on display as well.
